tools.name: List gist commits
tools.description: Lists all commits for a specified gist.

tools.name: List gist forks
tools.description: Lists all forks for a given github gist id.

tools.name: List gists for a user
tools.description: Lists public gists for a specified github user.

tools.name: List gists for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists gists for the authenticated user, with optional filtering by update time and pagination.

tools.name: List github actions caches for a repository
tools.description: Lists github actions caches for a repository, with options to filter by git reference or cache key, and to sort and paginate results.

tools.name: List GitHub Pages builds
tools.description: Lists github pages builds for a repository; github pages must be enabled on the repository for builds to be listed.

tools.name: List global security advisories
tools.description: Lists github's global security advisories, filterable by various attributes including id, type, ecosystem, severity, and dates.

tools.name: List installation requests for the authenticated app
tools.description: Lists pending installation requests made by users or organizations for the authenticated github app.

tools.name: List instances of a code scanning alert
tools.description: Lists all instances of a specific code scanning alert, optionally filtered by git ref; requires code scanning to be enabled on the repository.

tools.name: List issue comments
tools.description: Lists comments for a specified issue in a github repository.

tools.name: List issue comments for a repository
tools.description: Lists issue comments, including those on pull requests, for an accessible repository.

tools.name: List issue events
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all events for a specific issue within a github repository.

tools.name: List issue events for a repository
tools.description: Lists all issue events (e.g., closed, reopened, assigned) for a specified repository.

tools.name: List issues for user
tools.description: Lists github issues for the authenticated user across visible repositories, with filtering by user relationship, state, labels, an iso 8601 `since` timestamp (yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz), and sorting options; pull requests are typically included.

tools.name: List jobs for a workflow run
tools.description: Lists jobs for a specific workflow run in a github repository.

tools.name: List jobs for a workflow run attempt
tools.description: Lists jobs, including details like id, status, and steps, for a specific attempt of a github actions workflow run.

tools.name: List labels for an issue
tools.description: Lists all labels for a specified issue in a github repository.

tools.name: List labels for a repository
tools.description: Retrieves all labels for a specified, existing github repository.

tools.name: List labels for a self-hosted runner for an organization
tools.description: Lists all labels assigned to a specific self-hosted runner within a github organization, which are used to route workflows.

tools.name: List labels for a self-hosted runner for a repository
tools.description: Lists all labels assigned to a specific self-hosted runner registered with the given repository.

tools.name: List labels for issues in a milestone
tools.description: Lists all labels for issues within a specific milestone in a repository.

tools.name: List machine types for a codespace
tools.description: Lists available machine types for a specific, accessible codespace, enabling it to be transitioned to a new hardware configuration.

tools.name: List matching references
tools.description: Lists all git references (branches or tags) in a repository that start with the provided partial reference path (e.g., `heads/my-feature` or `tags/v1.2`).

tools.name: List milestones
tools.description: Lists milestones, which track progress for groups of issues and pull requests, for an existing repository, allowing filtering by state and sorting.

tools.name: List notifications for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists notifications for the authenticated user, sorted by most recent update, with filtering and pagination options.

tools.name: List organization events for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists events within a specified organization that were performed by the authenticated user, whose `username` (path parameter) must match the api request credentials.

tools.name: List organization members
tools.description: Lists public and concealed members of a github organization; viewing concealed members requires authenticated user to be an organization member.

tools.name: List organization projects
tools.description: Lists projects for a specified github organization, optionally filtering by state and supporting pagination.

tools.name: List organization repositories
tools.description: Retrieves a list of repositories for a specified github organization, allowing filtering by type and sorting.

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: Lists github organizations for the authenticated user, sorted by id in ascending order.

tools.name: List organization secrets
tools.description: Lists github actions secrets available for a specified organization.

tools.name: List organizations for a user
tools.description: Lists public organizations for a specified github user; the `username` must be a valid github handle.

tools.name: List organizations for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists organizations the authenticated github user is a member of, returning details for each organization.

tools.name: List organization variables
tools.description: Lists all github actions variables for a specified organization.

tools.name: List organization webhooks
tools.description: Lists all webhooks for a specified github organization; the organization must exist.

tools.name: List organization fine-grained permissions
tools.description: Retrieves all fine-grained permissions for a specified github organization, essential for creating or updating custom roles.

tools.name: List organization issues assigned to the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists issues for the authenticated user within a specified github organization, with options to filter by involvement type, state, labels, and to sort results.

tools.name: List org level codespaces secrets
tools.description: Lists all codespaces secrets available for a specified organization, which must exist.

tools.name: List package versions for an organization package
tools.description: Lists all versions for a specified package, if it exists and is owned by the given github organization.

tools.name: List organization repositories with Github Actions enabled
tools.description: Lists repositories in an organization with github actions enabled, for use when the organization's policy restricts actions to a specific list of repositories rather than enabling it for all.

tools.name: List org resource access tokens
tools.description: Lists approved fine-grained personal access tokens (pats) with access to resources in a github organization, optionally filtering by owner, repository, permissions, or last usage time.

tools.name: List org resources with personal tokens
tools.description: Retrieves a list of an organization's fine-grained personal access token requests (pending, approved, or denied), with options for filtering and sorting.

tools.name: List organization Dependabot secrets without values
tools.description: Lists all dependabot secrets (metadata like names, creation/update timestamps, but not their encrypted values) for a specified organization, which must exist.

tools.name: List outside collaborators for an organization
tools.description: Lists outside collaborators for a github organization, with options to filter (e.g., by 2fa status) and paginate results.

tools.name: List owned package versions
tools.description: Lists all versions for an existing package owned by the authenticated user, identified by its type and name.

tools.name: List packages for an organization
tools.description: Lists github packages for an organization, noting specific interpretations for package type and visibility parameters.

tools.name: List packages for a user
tools.description: Lists packages for a specified github user, filterable by package type and visibility.

tools.name: List packages for the authenticated user's namespace
tools.description: Lists packages of a specific type and visibility within the authenticated user's namespace on github.

tools.name: List package versions for a package owned by a user
tools.description: Lists all versions of a public package owned by a specific github user, identified by package type, package name, and username.

tools.name: List pending team invitations
tools.description: Lists all pending membership invitations for a specified team within an organization.

tools.name: List project cards
tools.description: Lists all project cards for a given `column id`, which must correspond to an existing project column.

tools.name: List project collaborators
tools.description: Fetches a list of collaborators for a specified, existing github project.

tools.name: List project columns
tools.description: Lists all of a github project's columns (e.g., 'to do', 'in progress'); project id must identify a valid, accessible project.

tools.name: List public email addresses for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists the public email addresses for the authenticated user.

tools.name: List public events
tools.description: Lists public github events, which may be delayed by up to 5 minutes, with support for pagination.

tools.name: List public events for a network of repositories
tools.description: Retrieves public events (up to 90 days old, newest first) for a github repository network, including the repository and its forks.

tools.name: List public events for a user
tools.description: Retrieves a list of public events for a specified github user, in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: List public events received by a user
tools.description: Lists public events for a specified github user (e.g., activities in repositories they watch or are involved in); the target user's profile must be public, and if blocked by the authenticated user, a 404 error is returned.

tools.name: List public gists
tools.description: Lists public gists from github, optionally filtering by a 'since' timestamp and supporting pagination; results are generally newest first.

tools.name: List public keys for a user
tools.description: Lists the verified public ssh keys for a specified github user.

tools.name: List public organization events
tools.description: Lists public events for a specified github organization, which must exist.

tools.name: List public organization members
tools.description: Lists users who have publicly declared their membership in a specified, existing github organization.

tools.name: List public repositories
tools.description: Lists all public repositories on github; use the `since` parameter with a repository id from a previous result for pagination.

tools.name: List pull requests
tools.description: Lists pull requests for a specified github repository with ai-friendly filtering.

tools.name: List pull requests associated with a commit
tools.description: Lists pull requests for a commit; returns merged prs that introduced the commit if on the default branch, or open prs including the commit if on other branches.

tools.name: List pull requests files
tools.description: Lists all files (including additions, modifications, and removals) associated with a specific pull request in a github repository.

tools.name: List reactions for a commit comment
tools.description: Lists reactions for a specific commit comment; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: List reactions for an issue
tools.description: Lists reactions for a specific, existing issue within an accessible github repository, optionally filtering by content type.

tools.name: List reactions for an issue comment
tools.description: Lists reactions for a specific issue comment in a github repository, optionally filtering by content type.

tools.name: List reactions for a pull request review comment
tools.description: Lists reactions for a pull request review comment in a repository, optionally filtering by reaction type.

tools.name: List reactions for a release
tools.description: Lists all reactions, or optionally filters reactions by a specific content type, for a given github release.

tools.name: List reactions for a team discussion
tools.description: Lists reactions for an existing team discussion within an organization.

tools.name: List reactions for a team discussion comment
tools.description: Lists reactions for a specific comment in a team discussion within an organization, optionally filtering by content type.

tools.name: List release assets
tools.description: Lists assets (e.g., compiled binaries, source code archives) for a specific github release, identified by `release id` which must be valid for an existing release in the repository.

tools.name: List releases
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all releases (published, draft, and prerelease) for a specified repository.

tools.name: List repo access by token
tools.description: Lists repositories in an organization that a fine-grained personal access token (`pat request id`) has requested access to; must be performed by a github app.

tools.name: List repo codespaces for authenticated user
tools.description: Lists codespaces the authenticated user can access within a specified, existing repository.

tools.name: List repo dev container configs for user
tools.description: Lists the `devcontainer.json` configurations available in a specified repository for use with github codespaces.

tools.name: List repo secrets without values
tools.description: Lists all codespaces secrets available in a specific repository, without their encrypted values.

tools.name: List repos accessible to app installation
tools.description: Lists repositories an app installation can access; 'total count' in response is zero if none are accessible.

tools.name: List repositories accessible to the user access token
tools.description: Lists repositories accessible to the authenticated user through a specific github app installation (identified by `installation id`).

tools.name: List repositories for a user
tools.description: Lists public repositories for a specified github user, who must have an existing account.

tools.name: List repositories for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists repositories for the authenticated user; using 'type' with 'visibility' or 'affiliation' api parameters (not in this model) can cause a 422 error.

tools.name: List repositories starred by a user
tools.description: Lists repositories a valid and existing github user has starred.

tools.name: List repositories starred by the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists repositories the authenticated user has starred, optionally sorted and paginated, including star creation timestamps via 'application/vnd.github.star+json' media type.

tools.name: List repositories watched by a user
tools.description: Lists repositories a given github user is watching; the username must be a valid and existing github user handle.

tools.name: List repositories watched by the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists repositories the authenticated user is watching (subscribed to for notifications).

tools.name: List repository activities
tools.description: Lists activities for a github repository, ensuring the repository exists and is accessible.

tools.name: List repository collaborators
tools.description: Lists collaborators for a specified repository, provided it exists and is accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: List repository contributors
tools.description: Lists contributors to a specified repository, sorted by number of contributions in descending order; the repository must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: List repository events
tools.description: Lists chronological events (e.g., code pushes, issue activities, pr actions, forks) for a specified, existing github repository.

tools.name: List repository invitations
tools.description: Retrieves all pending (unaccepted or undeclined) collaboration invitations for a specified github repository.

tools.name: List authenticated user's repository invitations
tools.description: Lists all pending repository invitations for the authenticated user.

tools.name: List repository issues
tools.description: Lists issues (which include pull requests) for a specified, existing github repository, with options for filtering, sorting, and pagination.

tools.name: List repository languages
tools.description: Lists the programming languages used in a github repository, returning a byte count for each language.

tools.name: List repository notifications for the authenticated user
tools.description: Retrieves notifications for the authenticated user from a specified repository, to which the user must have access.

tools.name: List repository organization secrets
tools.description: Lists names of organization-level secrets shared with the specified repository; actual secret values are not returned and visibility depends on token access.

tools.name: List repository organization variables
tools.description: Lists organization variables accessible to a specific repository; the repository must exist.

tools.name: List repository projects
tools.description: Lists projects associated with a specific repository.

tools.name: List repository rule suites
tools.description: Lists rule suite evaluations for a repository, allowing filtering by ref (non-wildcard), time period, actor, and result.

tools.name: List repository secrets
tools.description: Lists metadata for all secrets in a github repository, excluding their encrypted values.

tools.name: List repository secrets without decrypting
tools.description: Lists metadata (e.g., name, creation/update dates) for all dependabot secrets in a repository; secret values are not included.

tools.name: List repository tags
tools.description: Lists tags for a specified github repository.

tools.name: List repository teams
tools.description: Lists all teams with explicit permission to access the specified repository; the repository must exist.

tools.name: List repository variables
tools.description: Lists plain text key-value variables for github actions workflows within a specific, accessible repository.

tools.name: List repository webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves a list of webhooks for a repository, which must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: List repository workflows
tools.description: Lists all github actions workflows for a specified repository, which must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: List repos with ghactions cache usage
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of github actions cache usage statistics for repositories within an existing github organization.

tools.name: List review comments in a repository
tools.description: Lists all review comments on all pull requests within a specified repository.

tools.name: List review comments on a pull request
tools.description: Lists all review comments on a specific pull request within a github repository.

tools.name: List reviews for a pull request
tools.description: Lists submitted reviews chronologically for a specific pull request within a github repository.

tools.name: List runner applications for an organization
tools.description: Lists downloadable github actions runner application binaries, used for setting up self-hosted runners, for an existing github organization.

tools.name: List runner applications for a repository
tools.description: Lists available self-hosted runner application binaries for a specific repository, including their os, architecture, and download url.

tools.name: List secrets for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists all codespaces secrets accessible to the authenticated user for use within github codespaces.

tools.name: List selected repos for secret access
tools.description: Lists repositories within a specified organization that have been granted access to a particular dependabot secret.

tools.name: List selected repositories for an organization secret
tools.description: Lists repositories within an organization that have explicit access to a specific organization secret, which must have its visibility set to 'selected'.

tools.name: List selected repositories for an organization variable
tools.description: Lists repositories in an organization that can access a specific organization variable; supports pagination and returns an empty list if no repositories have been granted access.

tools.name: List selected repositories for a user secret
tools.description: Lists repositories that have access to the specified user secret for the authenticated user's codespaces, provided the user has codespaces access.

tools.name: List self hosted runners for an organization
tools.description: Lists self-hosted runners for a github organization, optionally filtering by name and paginating results, providing details for each runner such as os, status, and labels.

tools.name: List self hosted runners for a repository
tools.description: Lists all self-hosted runners configured for a repository.

tools.name: List social accounts for a user
tools.description: Lists social media accounts publicly linked to an existing github user's profile.

tools.name: List social accounts for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists all social media accounts linked to the authenticated user's github profile.

tools.name: List stargazers
tools.description: Lists users who have starred the specified github repository, which must exist.

tools.name: List starred gists
tools.description: Retrieves a list of gists starred by the authenticated user.

tools.name: List subscriptions for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists the authenticated user's active github marketplace subscriptions.

tools.name: List stubbed subscriptions for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists the authenticated user's stubbed (test/example data, not live) github marketplace subscriptions, useful for development or testing.

tools.name: List tag protection states for a repository
tools.description: Lists all active tag protection rules for a repository, defining patterns to prevent matching tags from being created or deleted; requires repository admin permissions.

tools.name: List team members
tools.description: Lists members of a specific team within an organization, including members of child teams.

tools.name: List team projects
tools.description: Lists github projects accessible to a specific team within an organization.

tools.name: List team repositories
tools.description: Lists repositories accessible to a specific team within a github organization.

tools.name: List teams
tools.description: Lists teams for a specified github organization.

tools.name: List teams for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists all teams across all organizations to which the authenticated user belongs, supporting pagination.

tools.name: List teams assigned to an organization role
tools.description: Lists teams assigned to a specific role within a github organization.

tools.name: List the people a user follows
tools.description: Lists github users that a valid github `username` is following, supporting pagination.

tools.name: List people the authenticated user follows
tools.description: Lists people the authenticated user follows.

tools.name: List timeline events for an issue
tools.description: Lists chronological events (e.g., comments, commits, label changes) for a specific issue in a github repository.

tools.name: List token access repositories
tools.description: Lists repositories in an organization accessible by a specific fine-grained personal access token; this action is for github apps.

tools.name: List user projects
tools.description: Retrieves a list of projects for a specified github user, optionally filtering by state and supporting pagination; the username must be a valid github handle.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Retrieves all github users (individuals and organizations) in chronological order of their sign-up date.

tools.name: List users blocked by an organization
tools.description: Lists users blocked by a specified github organization.

tools.name: List users blocked by the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists users blocked by the authenticated user, returning an empty list if no users are blocked.

tools.name: List users assigned org role
tools.description: Lists users assigned to a specific role within a github organization.

tools.name: List watchers
tools.description: Retrieves a list of users watching a specific repository; the repository must be accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: List workflow run artifacts
tools.description: Lists artifacts (e.g., build outputs, test results) for a specific workflow run in a github repository.

tools.name: List workflow runs for a repository
tools.description: Lists workflow runs for a repository, allowing filtering by actor, branch, event, status, creation date, check suite id, or head sha; the repository must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: List workflow runs for a workflow
tools.description: Lists runs for a specified, existing workflow (identified by id or filename like `main.yml`) in a github repository, with filtering options.

tools.name: Lock an issue
tools.description: Locks an existing github issue's conversation, preventing further comments; an optional reason can be specified.

tools.name: Manage access control for organization codespaces
tools.description: Sets the codespaces access control policy for a github organization, determining which members can use them.

tools.name: Manage custom properties for org repos
tools.description: Creates or updates values for an organization's predefined custom properties across multiple repositories (up to 30).

tools.name: Manage secrets in selected repositories with proper access
tools.description: Lists repositories within an organization that have been explicitly granted access to a specific organization secret.

tools.name: Map a commit author
tools.description: Updates git author information (name and/or email) for an `author id` obtained during a repository import, to correctly attribute commits.

tools.name: Mark a thread as done
tools.description: Marks the github notification thread (identified by `thread id`) as done or read for the authenticated user, effectively archiving it.

tools.name: Mark a thread as read
tools.description: Marks an existing github notification thread, identified by its `thread id`, as read.

tools.name: Mark notifications as read
tools.description: Marks notifications as read or unread, optionally for those updated at or before a `last read at` timestamp.

tools.name: Mark repository notifications as read
tools.description: Marks notifications in a repository as read; if 'last read at' is specified, notifications updated after this timestamp are not marked as read.

tools.name: Merge a branch
tools.description: Merges a head branch or commit sha into a base branch in a repository; fails if there are merge conflicts requiring manual resolution.

tools.name: Merge a pull request
tools.description: Merges an open and mergeable pull request in a repository, optionally specifying merge commit details, a merge method, and a required head sha for safety.

tools.name: Get GitHub API root
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves github rest api root endpoint details; use `github api root` instead.

tools.name: Move a project card
tools.description: Moves a project card to a specified position, optionally into a new column.

tools.name: Move a project column
tools.description: Moves a column within a github project (classic) to a new position; `position` can be 'first', 'last', or 'after:<target column id>', where `target column id` must reference an existing column in the same project.

tools.name: Ping an organization webhook
tools.description: Sends a 'ping' event to a specified, existing organization webhook to test its configuration and ensure it correctly receives events.

tools.name: Ping a repository webhook
tools.description: Pings an existing webhook on a repository to test its configuration and reachability by github.

tools.name: Privately report a security vulnerability
tools.description: Privately reports a security vulnerability for a repository; specify either `severity` or `cvss vector string`, but not both.

tools.name: Pulls check if merged
tools.description: Deprecated: use `check if a pull request has been merged` instead. checks if a github pull request has been merged, indicated by a 204 http status (merged) or 404 (not merged/found).

tools.name: Create a pull request
tools.description: Deprecated: use `create a pull request` instead. creates a pull request, requiring existing `base` and `head` branches.

tools.name: Create a review for a pull request
tools.description: Deprecated: use `create a review for a pull request` for creating pull request reviews; supports `pending` for drafts and comment positioning.

tools.name: Create a review comment for a pull request
tools.description: Deprecated: creates a review comment on a pull request's diff. use `create a review comment for a pull request` instead.

tools.name: Get a pull request
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves details of a specific pull request; prefer using the `get a pull request` action.

tools.name: List pull requests
tools.description: (deprecated: use `list pull requests`) lists pull requests for a specified github repository with ai-friendly filtering.

tools.name: Redeliver a delivery for an organization webhook
tools.description: Redelivers a specific webhook delivery for a webhook within an organization, to resend an event that previously failed or was not processed.

tools.name: Redeliver a delivery for a repository webhook
tools.description: Redelivers a specific, previously made webhook delivery (`delivery id`) for a repository's webhook (`hook id`).

tools.name: Remove a custom property for an organization
tools.description: Deletes a custom property, specified by `custom property name`, from an existing organization (`org`) for which the property is currently defined, preventing its future assignment to repositories.

tools.name: Remove a label from an issue
tools.description: Removes a label currently applied to a specific issue in a repository.

tools.name: Remove all labels from an issue
tools.description: Removes all labels from a specified issue in a github repository; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Remove all organization roles for a team
tools.description: Revokes all organization roles for a team in an organization; this is destructive and succeeds even if the team initially has no roles.

tools.name: Remove all organization roles for a user
tools.description: Revokes all assigned organization-level roles from a specified user (who must be a member of the organization) within a github organization, without removing the user from the organization or affecting repository-specific roles.

tools.name: Remove an organization member
tools.description: Removes a user, who must currently be a member, from a github organization, revoking their membership and access rights.

tools.name: Remove an organization role from a team
tools.description: Revokes an organization role that a team currently possesses within an organization.

tools.name: Remove an organization role from a user
tools.description: Removes a custom organization role from a user within a github organization, provided the organization exists, the user is a member, and the role id corresponds to a valid custom role in that organization.

tools.name: Remove app access restrictions
tools.description: Removes all github app access restrictions from a protected branch in a repository; the branch must have protection rules configured, and this action does not alter user or team restrictions.

tools.name: Remove a project from a team
tools.description: Removes a project from a team within an organization; this action requires the project to be currently associated with the team.

tools.name: Remove a repository collaborator
tools.description: Removes a collaborator from a specified github repository, provided the repository exists and the user is an existing collaborator.

tools.name: Remove a repository from an app installation
tools.description: Removes a repository from a github app installation for the authenticated user, given a valid `installation id` and the `repository id` of a repository currently linked to that installation; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Remove a repository from a team
tools.description: Disassociates a repository from a team; team members may lose access permissions, but the repository and team are not deleted.

tools.name: Remove a selected repository from a user secret
tools.description: Removes a selected repository's access to a user's codespaces secret; the secret must exist and the repository must have previously been granted access.

tools.name: Remove assignees from an issue
tools.description: Removes specified assignees from a github issue; requires push access, and invalid removal attempts are silently ignored.

tools.name: Remove custom label from repo runner
tools.description: Removes a custom label from a repository's self-hosted runner; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Remove custom label from self hosted runner
tools.description: Removes a currently assigned custom label (`name`) from a self-hosted runner (`runner id`) in an organization (`org`).

tools.name: Remove custom labels from self hosted repo runner
tools.description: Removes all custom labels from a self-hosted runner registered at the repository level, leaving only its default labels and any labels inherited from its runner group or organization.

tools.name: Remove interaction restrictions for an organization
tools.description: Removes all interaction restrictions from public repositories in the specified github organization, allowing all users to resume interactions.

tools.name: Remove interaction restrictions for a repository
tools.description: Removes all interaction restrictions for a repository, enabling all users to comment, open issues, and create pull requests by lifting any existing temporary interaction limits.

tools.name: Remove user public repo interaction restrictions
tools.description: Removes all interaction restrictions (limitations on comments, issues, or pull requests) from all public repositories owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: Remove org dev env secret by name
tools.description: Deletes a github codespaces secret from an organization by its name; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Remove org secret by name
tools.description: Permanently removes a specific dependabot secret, by its `secret name`, from the github `org`, making it unavailable to dependabot for that organization.

tools.name: Remove outside collaborator from an organization
tools.description: Removes a user, who must be an outside collaborator, from the specified github organization, revoking their access to all its repositories.

tools.name: Remove public org membership
tools.description: Makes an authenticated user's public membership in an organization private (without removing them from the organization); the user must currently be a public member of that organization.

tools.name: Removerepofromorgdevenvsecret
tools.description: Removes a repository's access to an organization-level codespaces secret, if it was previously granted.

tools.name: Remove selected repo from org secret
tools.description: Revokes a specific repository's access to an organization-level dependabot secret, applicable only when the secret has 'selected' visibility and the specified repository currently has access.

tools.name: Remove requested reviewers from a pull request
tools.description: Removes currently assigned user logins and/or team slugs from a github pull request's list of requested reviewers.

tools.name: Remove selected repository from an organization secret
tools.description: Removes a specific repository's access to an organization-level secret; the repository must have been previously granted access to this secret.

tools.name: Remove selected repository from an organization variable
tools.description: Removes a repository's access to an organization variable, if the variable's visibility is 'selected' and the repository is in its access list.

tools.name: Remove status check contexts
tools.description: Removes specified status check contexts (passed in the request body as an array of strings) from a protected branch in a repository.

tools.name: Remove status check protection
tools.description: Removes status check protection from a branch, disabling required status checks for merging pull requests; will only have an effect if status check protection is currently configured on the branch.

tools.name: Remove team access restrictions
tools.description: Removes all team-based access restrictions from a specified protected branch; the branch must be protected and have existing team restrictions for this action to change settings.

tools.name: Remove team membership for a user
tools.description: Removes a user from a specific team within an organization; this action fails if team synchronization with an identity provider (idp) is enabled, and may delete the team if the user is its last member and the team is not nested.

tools.name: Remove user access restrictions
tools.description: Removes active user-level access restrictions from a specified protected branch, enabling users with repository write access to push or merge if no other team or app restrictions apply.

tools.name: Remove user as a collaborator
tools.description: Removes a user as a collaborator from an organization project; the user must already be a collaborator on the specified project.

tools.name: Remove users from codespaces access for an organization
tools.description: Removes selected users from github codespaces billing access for an existing organization.

tools.name: Rename a branch
tools.description: Renames an existing branch in a github repository; the new name must be unique and adhere to github's naming conventions, and the current branch name cannot contain wildcard characters.

tools.name: Render a markdown document
tools.description: Renders markdown to html; for 'gfm' mode, provide 'context' (owner/repo) to correctly link issues, pull requests, and user mentions.

tools.name: Replace all repository topics
tools.description: Replaces all topics of a repository.

tools.name: Replace org secret visibility to selected
tools.description: Sets an existing dependabot organization secret's visibility to 'selected' and replaces the full list of repositories that can access it with the ids provided.

tools.name: Replace repository access for an org Codespaces secret
tools.description: Replaces the list of repositories that can access an existing organization-level codespaces secret with the provided valid repository ids owned by the organization.

tools.name: Create a repository for the authenticated user
tools.description: Deprecated: use 'create a repository for the authenticated user' instead. creates a new repository for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Create a fork
tools.description: (deprecated: use `create a fork` instead) creates a fork of a specified repository.

tools.name: Create an organization repository
tools.description: Deprecated: use `create an organization repository` instead. creates a new repository in the specified organization.

tools.name: Create or update file contents
tools.description: Deprecated: use `create or update file contents` instead; creates or replaces a file in a repository.

tools.name: Get the weekly commit activity
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get the weekly commit activity` instead. fetches weekly commit statistics (additions/deletions) for a repository; less reliable for over 10,000 commits.

tools.name: Get a commit
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get a commit`. retrieves a specific commit from a repository by its owner, name, and a valid commit reference (sha, branch, or tag), supporting pagination for large diffs.

tools.name: Get repository content
tools.description: Deprecated: gets repository file content or directory metadata; use `get repository content` instead.

tools.name: Get all contributor commit activity
tools.description: (deprecated: use `getallcontributorcommitactivity`) fetches commit activity (total commits, weekly additions/deletions/commits) for all repository contributors; retry if github returns 202.

tools.name: List branches
tools.description: (deprecated: use 'list branches' instead) lists branches for an existing github repository, with an option to filter by protection status.

tools.name: List repository collaborators (deprecated)
tools.description: (deprecated: use `listrepositorycollaborators`) lists repository collaborators, especially for organization-owned repositories including team members from child teams; requires repository access and potentially `read:org`/`repo` scopes for organization repos.

tools.name: List commits
tools.description: Deprecated: use `list commits` instead; lists repository commits, including gpg/s/mime signature verification details if available.

tools.name: List repository contributors
tools.description: Deprecated: use `list repository contributors`. lists repository contributors, sorted by contributions; repository must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: List repositories for the authenticated user
tools.description: Deprecated: use `list repositories for the authenticated user` to list the authenticated user's repositories.

tools.name: List organization repositories
tools.description: Deprecated: lists repositories for a github organization; use `list organization repositories` instead.

tools.name: List repositories for a user
tools.description: Deprecated: lists public repositories for the specified github user; use `list repositories for a user` instead.

tools.name: Request a github pages build
tools.description: Manually triggers a github pages build for a repository if github pages is enabled, useful for deployments not automatically built or for retrying failed builds.

tools.name: Request reviewers for a pull request
tools.description: Requests user and/or team reviewers for an open pull request in a repository; requires `owner`, `repo`, `pull number`, and at least one of `reviewers` or `team reviewers`.

tools.name: Rerequest a check run
tools.description: Triggers a re-run of a specific check run in a github repository, which resets its status to 'queued', clears its conclusion, and triggers the `check run` webhook with `rerequested`.

tools.name: Rerequest a check suite
tools.description: Triggers a new run of an existing check suite within a repository, useful for re-running checks without new code.

tools.name: Re-run a job from a workflow run
tools.description: Re-runs a specific job and any dependent jobs from a github actions workflow run in the specified repository, optionally enabling debug logging.

tools.name: Rerun a workflow
tools.description: Re-runs a specific github actions workflow run identified by its owner, repository, and run id, optionally enabling debug logging.

tools.name: Rerun failed jobs from a workflow run
tools.description: Re-runs all failed jobs and their dependent jobs from a specified workflow run if the run contains previously failed jobs.

tools.name: Reset a token
tools.description: Invalidates the provided oauth `access token` and generates a new one for the github oauth app identified by `client id`, used for token compromise or security rotation.

tools.name: Restore a package for an organization
tools.description: Restores a package in an organization, provided it was deleted within the last 30 days.

tools.name: Restore a package for a user
tools.description: Restores a user-owned package previously deleted from github packages, if restorable under github's data retention policy (typically within 30 days of deletion).

tools.name: Restore a package for the authenticated user
tools.description: Restores a package deleted by the authenticated user within the last 30 days, if its namespace and version are still available.

tools.name: Restore a package version for the authenticated user
tools.description: Restores a package version that was deleted by the authenticated user within the last 30 days.

tools.name: Restore package version for an organization
tools.description: Restores a package version for an organization, provided it was deleted within the last 30 days.

tools.name: Restore package version for a user
tools.description: Restores a specific, user-owned package version if it was deleted within the last 30 days and its original namespace and version name are still available.

tools.name: Retrieve repo public key for encryption
tools.description: Gets a repository's public key, used to encrypt secrets for dependabot.

tools.name: Review access with personal token
tools.description: Approves or denies a pending fine-grained personal access token request for organization resources; must be performed by a github app.

tools.name: Review Custom Deployment Rules For Workflow Run
tools.description: Approves or rejects pending custom deployment protection rules for a workflow run by posting a review with `environment name` (str), `state` (str: 'approved'/'rejected'), and optional `comment` (str) in the request body, targeting a run with rules awaiting review.

tools.name: Review pending deployments for a workflow run
tools.description: Approves or rejects pending deployments for a specific workflow run that are in a 'waiting' state within specified, configured environments.

tools.name: Review resource requests with fine grained tokens
tools.description: Approves or denies fine-grained personal access token requests for an organization; any specified `pat request ids` must refer to currently pending requests.

tools.name: Revoke an installation access token
tools.description: Revokes the github app's current installation access token, immediately invalidating it for api authentication.

tools.name: Search code
tools.description: Searches code file contents and paths on the default branch of github repositories using a query string; searches only files under 384kb, returns max 1000 results by best match, and is optimized for precision.

tools.name: Search commits
tools.description: Finds commits on github using a query string (q) supporting keywords and qualifiers, with options for sorting and pagination.

tools.name: Search issues and pull requests
tools.description: Searches github for issues and pull requests. use qualifiers to scope searches: `repo:owner/name` for specific repos, `org:orgname` for organizations, `user:username` for personal repos, `assignee:@me` for your assignments. combine with `is:issue`, `is:pr`, `state:open`, `label:"name"` filters.

tools.name: Search labels
tools.description: Searches for labels within a github repository by keywords in their names or descriptions.

tools.name: Search repositories
tools.description: Deprecated: use `search repositories`; this version finds repositories by criteria, including text match metadata and pagination. example: `q="tetris language:assembly", sort="stars"`

tools.name: Search repositories
tools.description: Searches github repositories using a flexible query (keywords, qualifiers) with sorting, ordering, and pagination.

tools.name: Search topics
tools.description: Finds topics on github using keywords and qualifiers with github's search syntax, supporting pagination.

tools.name: Search users
tools.description: Searches for users on github by criteria like username, email, location, followers, or repository associations, using a flexible query string `q`.

tools.name: List global security advisories
tools.description: tags = ["openworldhint", "readonlyhint", "mcpignore"] the text describes how to find global security advisories with specific parameters. by default, it excludes malware advisories, which can be included by setting the `type` parameter to `malware`. more on advisory types at github docs.<<DEPRECATED use list_global_security_advisories>>

tools.name: Set admin branch protection
tools.description: Enables administrator enforcement on a branch, making existing protection rules also apply to administrators; branch protection rules must already be configured.

tools.name: Set app access restrictions
tools.description: Replaces the list of github apps permitted to push to a protected branch; the branch must already be protected and apps must be installed with 'contents' permission.

tools.name: Set a repository subscription
tools.description: Sets the authenticated user's notification subscription for a repository.

tools.name: Set a thread subscription
tools.description: Sets whether a github notification thread is ignored (muted) or unignored (unmuted), for a `thread id` that must identify an existing notification thread.

tools.name: Set default workflow permissions for an organization
tools.description: Updates an organization's default github token permissions for workflows and whether github actions can approve pull requests; note that allowing actions to approve pull requests (`can approve pull request reviews: true`) is a security risk.

tools.name: Set default workflow permissions for a repository
tools.description: Sets the default permissions for the github token within a repository and configures whether github actions can approve pull requests.

tools.name: Set GitHub Actions permissions for an organization
tools.description: Sets the github actions permissions policy for an organization, specifying which repositories can run actions and which actions/workflows are allowed; if 'selected' is chosen for either, manage the specific lists via other endpoints.

tools.name: Set github actions permissions for a repository
tools.description: Sets github actions permissions for a repository, enabling/disabling actions and defining the policy for allowed actions and reusable workflows.

tools.name: Set interaction restrictions for an organization
tools.description: Limits interactions (comments, new issues, prs) in an organization's public repositories by user type and duration, typically to mitigate high traffic or unwanted activity.

tools.name: Set interaction restrictions for a repository
tools.description: Temporarily limits which github users (e.g., existing users, contributors only) can interact (comment, open issues, create pull requests) in a repository for a specified duration.

tools.name: Set interaction restrictions for your public repositories
tools.description: Sets or updates temporary interaction restrictions for all public repositories owned by the authenticated user, overriding any repository-specific limits.

tools.name: Set labels for an issue
tools.description: Replaces all existing labels on a github issue with a new set of labels.

tools.name: Set allowed actions and workflows for an organization
tools.description: Sets the github actions permissions for an existing organization, specifying allowed github-owned actions, verified creator actions, and action/workflow patterns from public repositories.

tools.name: Set custom labels for a self-hosted runner for an organization
tools.description: Sets the custom labels for a self-hosted runner in an organization; this operation does not affect default system-assigned labels (e.g., 'self-hosted', 'linux', 'x64').

tools.name: Set primary email visibility
tools.description: Sets the visibility ('public' or 'private') of the authenticated user's primary email address on github, if one is configured.

tools.name: Set repo allowed actions
tools.description: Sets allowed github actions and reusable workflows for a repository, managing permissions for github-owned, verified creator, or specific pattern-matched actions/workflows (note: `patterns allowed` applies only to public repositories).

tools.name: Set selected repositories for an organization secret
tools.description: Replaces the list of repositories that can access an organization secret; only effective if the secret's visibility is 'selected'.

tools.name: Set selected repositories for an organization variable
tools.description: Replaces the list of repositories that can access an organization-level variable; the variable's visibility must be 'selected'.

tools.name: Set selected repositories for a user secret
tools.description: Defines the list of repositories permitted to access a specific codespaces secret for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Set status check contexts
tools.description: Replaces required status check contexts for a protected branch, requiring admin permissions; an empty `contexts` array removes all checks.

tools.name: Set team access restrictions
tools.description: Sets team push access for a protected branch by replacing all current teams with a new list of valid team slugs (provided in the request body); an empty list of slugs removes all team restrictions.

tools.name: Set user access restrictions
tools.description: Replaces the list of users with push access to a protected branch using a request body (not in this schema) containing an array of github usernames; this enables branch protection if not already active.

tools.name: Set workflow access level outside repository
tools.description: Sets the access level for workflows outside a repository to use actions and reusable workflows within that repository.

tools.name: Star a gist
tools.description: Stars a github gist identified by `gist id`; this action is idempotent and returns a 204 no content status upon success, even if the gist is already starred.

tools.name: Star a repository for the authenticated user
tools.description: Stars an existing and accessible repository for the authenticated user; this action is idempotent and succeeds even if the repository is already starred.

tools.name: Start a codespace for the authenticated user
tools.description: Initiates the startup process for an existing github codespace (identified by `codespace name`) if it's in a startable state like 'available' or 'stopped'.

tools.name: Stop a codespace for an organization user
tools.description: Stops a codespace, which must be currently running, for a specified member of an organization.

tools.name: Stop a codespace for the authenticated user
tools.description: Stops a running or available codespace for the authenticated user, pausing its execution and billing.

tools.name: Submit a review for a pull request
tools.description: Finalizes a pending pull request review (identified by `review id`) with a required `event` (approve, request changes, comment) and an optional `body`.

tools.name: Sync a fork branch with the upstream repository
tools.description: Synchronizes a branch in a forked github repository with its upstream counterpart, assuming the repository is a fork, the branch exists, an upstream is configured, and the merge is conflict-free.

tools.name: Test the push repository webhook
tools.description: Triggers a simulated push event to test a repository's push webhook; a test event is only delivered if the webhook is subscribed to 'push' events, otherwise, it returns 204 no content without sending a post.

tools.name: Transfer a repository
tools.description: Initiates a repository transfer to a new owner (who must accept the request); if the new owner is an organization, it must be configured to allow transfers.

tools.name: Unblock a user
tools.description: Unblocks a github user, provided they are currently blocked by the authenticated user.

tools.name: Unblock a user from an organization
tools.description: Unblocks a user from an organization, allowing renewed interaction with its resources, provided the user is currently blocked (otherwise, a 404 error may occur).

tools.name: Unfollow a user
tools.description: Unfollows an existing github user; this action is idempotent, succeeding even if the authenticated user is not currently following them.

tools.name: Unlock an issue
tools.description: Unlocks a currently locked github issue in the specified repository, allowing new comments and interactions.

tools.name: Unlock an organization repository
tools.description: Unlocks an organization repository previously locked by a github migration.

tools.name: Unlock a user repository
tools.description: Unlocks a repository (`repo name`) that was locked as part of a user migration (`migration id`), making it usable or deletable; this action requires the repository to be currently locked.

tools.name: Unstar a gist
tools.description: Removes a star from the specified gist; the action is idempotent and will not error if the gist was not previously starred by the user.

tools.name: Unstar a repository
tools.description: Removes the authenticated user's star from a specified repository, which must already be starred by the user.

tools.name: Update a check run
tools.description: Updates an existing check run for a specific commit in a repository, allowing modifications to its status, conclusion, output, and other details.

tools.name: Update a code scanning alert
tools.description: Updates a specific code scanning alert in a github repository, primarily to change its state (e.g., 'open' or 'dismissed').

tools.name: Update a code scanning default setup configuration
tools.description: Updates the default setup configuration for code scanning in a repository; github advanced security must be enabled for the repository.

tools.name: Update a codespace for the authenticated user
tools.description: Updates an existing github codespace's machine type, display name, or recent folders for the authenticated user; machine type changes take effect on the next start.

tools.name: Update a commit comment
tools.description: Changes the body of an existing commit comment.

tools.name: Update a custom organization role
tools.description: Updates an existing custom role in an organization by modifying its name, description, or permissions; at least one of these fields must be provided.

tools.name: Update a deployment branch policy
tools.description: Updates the name pattern of an existing deployment branch policy for a specific environment in a repository.

tools.name: Update a discussion
tools.description: Updates the title and/or body of a specific team discussion within an organization.

tools.name: Update a discussion comment
tools.description: Updates the body of a comment in a team's discussion within an organization.

tools.name: Update a gist
tools.description: Updates a gist's description, and/or its files (including content, filename changes, or deletion).

tools.name: Update a gist comment
tools.description: Updates an existing comment on a specified gist.

tools.name: Update a label
tools.description: Updates an existing label's name, color, or description within a specified repository.

tools.name: Update a milestone
tools.description: Updates a milestone in a repository, identified by `owner`, `repo`, and `milestone number`, by allowing modification of its `title`, `state`, `description`, or `due on`; at least one of these four attributes must be provided to perform an update.

tools.name: Update an environment variable
tools.description: Updates an existing environment variable's name and/or value in a specific github repository environment; requires providing either a new name or a new value.

tools.name: Update an existing project card
tools.description: Updates an existing project card's note and/or archived status, identified by its `card id`.

tools.name: Update an existing project column
tools.description: Updates the name of an existing column, identified by `column id`, in a github project (classic).

tools.name: Update an issue
tools.description: Updates an existing github issue's title, body, state, milestone, labels, or assignees; `state reason` is only processed if `state` also changes, and use `null` or `[]` to clear applicable fields.

tools.name: Update an issue comment
tools.description: Updates an existing comment on an issue or pull request within a specified repository.

tools.name: Update an organization
tools.description: Updates an organization's settings; changing security-related fields requires admin, owner, or security manager permissions.

tools.name: Update an organization variable
tools.description: Updates an existing github actions organization variable's name, value, or visibility (`all`, `private`, `selected`), requiring `selected repository ids` with valid repository ids if visibility is `selected`.

tools.name: Update an organization webhook
tools.description: Updates the configuration (url, content type, secret, ssl verification), subscribed events, active status, or name of an existing webhook for a specified organization.

tools.name: Update a project
tools.description: Updates an existing github project's attributes if the github projects feature is enabled and at least one modifiable field is provided.

tools.name: Update a pull request
tools.description: Updates an existing pull request, allowing changes to attributes like title, body, state, base branch, and maintainer modification settings.

tools.name: Update a pull request branch
tools.description: Updates an open pull request's head branch by merging the latest changes from its base branch, if mergeable and repository merging is enabled; operates asynchronously.

tools.name: Update a reference
tools.description: Updates a git reference (e.g., a branch or tag) to a specific commit sha, creating the reference if it doesn't exist; use `force` for non-fast-forward updates.

tools.name: Update a release
tools.description: Updates an existing release in a github repository, allowing modification of its attributes; if linking a discussion, the `discussion category name` must refer to an existing category in the repository.

tools.name: Update a release asset
tools.description: Updates the name, label, or state of a release asset in a github repository, requiring at least one of these properties to be provided for modification.

tools.name: Update a repository
tools.description: Updates settings for an existing github repository, such as name, description, visibility, merge strategies, and security configurations.

tools.name: Update a repository invitation
tools.description: Updates an active repository invitation to modify the invited user's permissions; the specified repository and invitation must exist.

tools.name: Update a repository ruleset
tools.description: Updates an existing repository ruleset, identified by `ruleset id` for a given repository, allowing partial updates to its configuration such as name, target, enforcement, bypass actors, conditions, and rules.

tools.name: Update a repository variable
tools.description: Updates the name and/or value of an existing github actions variable in a repository.

tools.name: Update a repository webhook
tools.description: Updates the url, content type, secret, ssl verification, events, or active status for an existing repository webhook, specified by `owner`, `repo`, and `hook id`.

tools.name: Update a review comment for a pull request
tools.description: Updates the body of an existing review comment on a pull request.

tools.name: Update a review for a pull request
tools.description: Updates the body text of an existing pull request review.

tools.name: Update a team
tools.description: Updates a team's settings (e.g., name, description, privacy, parent team) within a github organization, identified by its slug and organization name.

tools.name: Update a webhook configuration for an organization
tools.description: Updates the configuration (url, content type, secret, ssl verification) for an existing webhook within a specified organization.

tools.name: Update a webhook configuration for a repository
tools.description: Updates the configuration (e.g., payload url, content type, secret, ssl verification) for an existing webhook in a specified repository.

tools.name: Update branch protection
tools.description: Updates the protection settings for an existing branch in a repository, which must not contain wildcard characters.

tools.name: Update git lfs preference
tools.description: Sets the git large file storage (lfs) preference for a repository, typically before initiating a source import.

tools.name: Update information about a github pages site
tools.description: Updates the configuration for a github pages site (e.g., custom domain, https, build type, source); requires github pages to be enabled for the repository, and if `build type` is 'workflow', a corresponding github actions workflow must be configured.

tools.name: Update pull request review protection
tools.description: Updates pull request review protection settings (e.g., required approvals, review dismissal, bypass allowances) for a branch; branch protection features must be available for the repository.

tools.name: Update repository preferences for check suites
tools.description: Updates repository preferences for automatic check suite creation on code pushes, allowing configuration for specific github apps that must be installed on the repository with `checks:write` permission.

tools.name: Update resource access with tokens
tools.description: Revokes organization access for the personal access tokens identified by `pat ids`; this action must be performed by a github app, and `pat ids` must be valid and associated with the organization.

tools.name: Update status check protection
tools.description: Updates required status checks for a branch, optionally requiring it to be up-to-date before merging.

tools.name: Update the authenticated user
tools.description: Updates the authenticated user's github profile; a new public email must be verified, and existing private emails remain private even if specified.

tools.name: Update token org access
tools.description: Revokes a fine-grained personal access token's access to an organization, usable only by github apps when the token has existing access to that organization.

tools.name: Upload an analysis as sarif data
tools.description: Uploads a gzipped and base64 encoded sarif file to a github repository for a specific commit and reference; use `checkout uri` if sarif paths are absolute.

tools.name: Get the authenticated user
tools.description: [deprecated] retrieves the authenticated user's information; use `get the authenticated user` instead.

tools.name: Get a user
tools.description: Deprecated: use the `getauser` action to retrieve a github user's public profile by username.

tools.name: Get contextual information for a user
tools.description: Retrieves contextual hovercard information for a github user. (deprecated: please use the `get contextual information for a user` action instead).

tools.name: List followers of the authenticated user
tools.description: Deprecated: lists users following the authenticated github user; use `list followers of the authenticated user` instead.

tools.name: List public email addresses for the authenticated user
tools.description: Deprecated: use `listpublicemailaddressesfortheauthenticateduser` instead; lists public email addresses for the authenticated user.

tools.name: List social accounts for a user
tools.description: Deprecated: lists social media accounts for an existing github user; use 'list social accounts for a user' instead.

tools.name: Verify dev container permissions accepted
tools.description: Verifies if the authenticated user has accepted permissions for a specific devcontainer configuration in a repository, typically to ensure awareness before a codespace is created or used.

triggers.name: Commit Event
triggers.description: Triggered when a new commit is pushed to a repository.

triggers.name: Follower Changes
triggers.description: Triggers when there are changes in GitHub followers.

triggers.name: Issue Added Event
triggers.description: Triggered when a new issue is added to the repository.

triggers.name: Label Added Event
triggers.description: Triggered when a new label is added to a pull request.

triggers.name: Pull Request Event
triggers.description: Triggered when a pull request is opened, closed, or synchronized.

triggers.name: Star Added Event
triggers.description: Triggered when a new star is added to the repository.

name: Google Calendar
description: Google Calendar is a time management tool providing scheduling features, event reminders, and integration with email and other apps for streamlined organization

tools.name: Insert Calendar into List
tools.description: Inserts an existing calendar into the user's calendar list.

tools.name: Update Calendar List Entry
tools.description: Updates an existing entry on the user\'s calendar list.

tools.name: Delete Calendar
tools.description: Deletes a secondary calendar. use calendars.clear for clearing all events on primary calendars.

tools.name: Update Calendar
tools.description: Updates metadata for a calendar.

tools.name: Clear Calendar
tools.description: Clears a primary calendar. this operation deletes all events associated with the primary calendar of an account.

tools.name: Create Event
tools.description: Creates an event on a google calendar, needing rfc3339 utc start/end times (end after start) and write access to the calendar. by default, adds the organizer as an attendee unless exclude organizer is set to true.

tools.name: Delete event
tools.description: Deletes a specified event by `event id` from a google calendar (`calendar id`); this action is idempotent and raises a 404 error if the event is not found.

tools.name: Create a calendar
tools.description: Creates a new, empty google calendar with the specified title (summary).

tools.name: Get Event Instances
tools.description: Returns instances of the specified recurring event.

tools.name: List Events
tools.description: Returns events on the specified calendar.

tools.name: Move Event
tools.description: Moves an event to another calendar, i.e., changes an event's organizer.

tools.name: Watch Events
tools.description: Watch for changes to events resources.

tools.name: Find event
tools.description: Finds events in a specified google calendar using text query, time ranges (event start/end, last modification), and event types; ensure `timemin` is not chronologically after `timemax` if both are provided.

tools.name: Find free slots
tools.description: Finds free/busy time slots in google calendars for specified calendars within a defined time range (defaults to the current day utc if `time min`/`time max` are omitted), enhancing busy intervals with event details; `time min` must precede `time max` if both are provided.

tools.name: Query Free/Busy Information
tools.description: Returns free/busy information for a set of calendars.

tools.name: Get Google Calendar
tools.description: Retrieves a specific google calendar, identified by `calendar id`, to which the authenticated user has access.

tools.name: Get current date and time
tools.description: Gets the current date and time, allowing for a specific timezone offset.

tools.name: List ACL Rules
tools.description: Retrieves the list of access control rules (acls) for a specified calendar, providing the necessary 'rule id' values required for updating specific acl rules.

tools.name: List Google Calendars
tools.description: Retrieves calendars from the user's google calendar list, with options for pagination and filtering.

tools.name: Patch Calendar
tools.description: Partially updates (patches) an existing google calendar, modifying only the fields provided; `summary` is mandatory and cannot be an empty string, and an empty string for `description` or `location` clears them.

tools.name: Patch Event
tools.description: Updates specified fields of an existing event in a google calendar using patch semantics (array fields like `attendees` are fully replaced if provided); ensure the `calendar id` and `event id` are valid and the user has write access to the calendar.

tools.name: Quick Add Event
tools.description: Parses natural language text to quickly create a basic google calendar event with its title, date, and time, suitable for simple scheduling; does not support direct attendee addition or recurring events, and `calendar id` must be valid if not 'primary'.

tools.name: Remove attendee from event
tools.description: Removes an attendee from a specified event in a google calendar; the calendar and event must exist.

tools.name: List Settings
tools.description: Returns all user settings for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Watch Settings
tools.description: Watch for changes to settings resources.

tools.name: Sync Events
tools.description: Synchronizes google calendar events, performing a full sync if no `sync token` is provided or if a 410 gone error (due to an expired token) necessitates it, otherwise performs an incremental sync for events changed since the `sync token` was issued.

tools.name: Update ACL Rule
tools.description: Updates an access control rule for the specified calendar.

tools.name: Update Google event
tools.description: Updates an existing event by `event id` in a google calendar; this is a full put replacement, so provide all desired fields as unspecified ones may be cleared or reset.

triggers.name: Attendee Response Changed
triggers.description:
Polling trigger that fires when any attendee's RSVP changes to
    accepted, declined, or tentative. Returns attendee info and current status.

triggers.name: Event Canceled or Deleted
triggers.description:
Triggers when a Google Calendar event is cancelled or deleted.
    Returns minimal data: event_id, summary (if available), and cancellation timestamp.

triggers.name: Event Starting Soon
triggers.description:
Triggers when a calendar event is within a configured number of minutes from starting.
    Includes countdown window, start time, and event metadata.

triggers.name: Calendar Event Changes
triggers.description:
**SOON TO BE DEPRECATED** - Use Calendar Event Sync (polling trigger) instead.
    Real-time webhook trigger for calendar event changes. Returns event metadata only.
    For full event data, use Calendar Event Sync (polling trigger).

triggers.name: Event Created
triggers.description:
Polling trigger that fires when a new calendar event is created.
    Returns event ID, summary, start/end times, and organizer info.

triggers.name: Calendar Event Sync
triggers.description:
Polling trigger that returns full event data including details, attendees, and metadata.
    For real-time notifications with basic info, use Calendar Event Changes (webhook).

triggers.name: Event Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when an existing Google Calendar event is modified. Returns the event ID,
    change type, and the specific fields that changed with their previous and new values.
