name: Notion
description: Notion centralizes notes, docs, wikis, and tasks in a unified workspace, letting teams build custom workflows for collaboration and knowledge management

tools.name: Add multiple content blocks (bulk, user-friendly)
tools.description: Efficiently adds multiple standard content blocks to a notion page in a single api call with automatic markdown parsing. the 'content' field in notionrichtext blocks now automatically detects and parses markdown formatting including headers (# ## ###), bold (**text**), italic (*text*), strikethrough (~~text~~), inline code (`code`), links ([text](url)), and more. ideal for bulk content creation, ai agents, and replacing multiple individual add page content calls. supports automatic text formatting, content splitting, and up to 100 blocks per request.

tools.name: Add content to Notion page
tools.description: Deprecated: appends a single content block to a notion page or a parent block (must be page, toggle, to-do, bulleted/numbered list, callout, or quote); invoke repeatedly to add multiple blocks.

tools.name: Append complex blocks (advanced, full control)
tools.description: Appends complex blocks with full notion block structure to a parent block or page. use for advanced scenarios requiring precise control: code blocks, tables, embeds, nested children within blocks, or when working with pre-built notion block objects. requires full notion api block schema - use add multiple page content for simpler content creation.

tools.name: Archive Notion Page
tools.description: Archives (moves to trash) or unarchives (restores from trash) a specified notion page.

tools.name: Create comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to a notion page (via `parent page id`) or to an existing discussion thread (via `discussion id`); cannot create new discussion threads on specific blocks (inline comments).

tools.name: Create Notion Database
tools.description: Creates a new notion database as a subpage under a specified parent page with a defined properties schema; use this action exclusively for creating new databases.

tools.name: Create Notion page
tools.description: Creates a new empty page in a notion workspace.

tools.name: Delete a block
tools.description: Archives a notion block, page, or database using its id, which sets its 'archived' property to true (like moving to "trash" in the ui) and allows it to be restored later.

tools.name: Duplicate page
tools.description: Duplicates a notion page, including all its content, properties, and nested blocks, under a specified parent page or workspace.

tools.name: Fetch Notion Block Children
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of direct, first-level child block objects along with contents for a given parent notion block or page id; use block ids from the response for subsequent calls to access deeply nested content.

tools.name: Fetch Notion block metadata
tools.description: Fetches metadata for a notion block (or page, as pages are blocks) using its valid uuid; if the block has children, use fetch block contents to fetch their contents.

tools.name: Fetch comments
tools.description: Fetches unresolved comments for a specified notion block or page id.

tools.name: Fetch Notion Data
tools.description: Fetches notion items (pages and/or databases) from the notion workspace, use this to get minimal data about the items in the workspace with a query or list all items in the workspace with minimal data

tools.name: Fetch Database
tools.description: Fetches a notion database's structural metadata (properties, title, etc.) via its `database id`, not the data entries; `database id` must reference an existing database.

tools.name: Fetch database row
tools.description: Retrieves a notion database row's properties and metadata; use fetch block contents for page content blocks.

tools.name: Get About Me
tools.description: Retrieves the user object for the bot associated with the current notion integration token, typically to obtain the bot's user id for other api operations.

tools.name: Get about user
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific notion user, such as their name, avatar, and email, based on their unique user id.

tools.name: Get page property
tools.description: Call this to get a specific property from a notion page when you have a valid `page id` and `property id`; handles pagination for properties returning multiple items.

tools.name: Insert row database
tools.description: Creates a new page (row) in a specified notion database.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users (excluding guests) from the notion workspace; the number of users returned per page may be less than the requested `page size`.

tools.name: Query database
tools.description: Queries a notion database for pages (rows), where rows are pages and columns are properties; ensure sort property names correspond to existing database properties.

tools.name: Retrieve Comment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific comment by its id. use when you have a comment id and need to fetch its details.

tools.name: Retrieve Database Property
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific property object of a notion database. use when you need to get details about a single database column/property.

tools.name: Search Notion page
tools.description: Searches notion pages and databases by title; an empty query lists all accessible items, useful for discovering ids or as a fallback when a specific query yields no results.

tools.name: Update block
tools.description: Updates an existing notion block's textual content or type-specific properties (e.g., 'checked' status, 'color'), using its `block id` and the specified `block type`.

tools.name: Update Page
tools.description: Tool to update the properties, icon, cover, or archive status of a page. use when you need to modify existing page attributes.

tools.name: Update row database
tools.description: Updates or archives an existing notion database row (page) using its `row id`, allowing modification of its icon, cover, and/or properties; ensure the target page is accessible and property details (names/ids and values) align with the database schema and specified formats.

tools.name: Update database schema
tools.description: Updates an existing notion database's title, description, and/or properties; at least one of these attributes must be provided to effect a change.

triggers.name: All Page Events
triggers.description: Triggers when any Notion page is created or updated across the workspace.

triggers.name: New Comment
triggers.description: Triggers when a new comment is added to a specified Notion block or page.

triggers.name: New Page
triggers.description: Triggers when a new page is added to a Notion database.

triggers.name: Page Added to Page
triggers.description: Fires when a new subpage (a `child_page` type block) is added under a specified parent Notion page.

triggers.name: Page Updated
triggers.description: Triggers when any block within a specified Notion page is updated.

name: Google Sheets
description: Google Sheets is a cloud-based spreadsheet tool enabling real-time collaboration, data analysis, and integration with other Google Workspace apps

tools.name: Add Sheet to Spreadsheet
tools.description: Adds a new sheet (worksheet) to a spreadsheet. use this tool to create a new tab within an existing google sheet, optionally specifying its title, index, size, and other properties.

tools.name: Aggregate Column Data
tools.description: Searches for rows where a specific column matches a value and performs mathematical operations on data from another column.

tools.name: Append Dimension
tools.description: Tool to append new rows or columns to a sheet, increasing its size. use when you need to add empty rows or columns to an existing sheet.

tools.name: Batch get spreadsheet
tools.description: Retrieves data from specified cell ranges in a google spreadsheet; ensure the spreadsheet has at least one worksheet and any explicitly referenced sheet names in ranges exist.

tools.name: Batch update spreadsheet
tools.description: Updates a specified range in a google sheet with given values, or appends them as new rows if `first cell location` is omitted; ensure the target sheet exists and the spreadsheet contains at least one worksheet.

tools.name: Batch Update Values by Data Filter
tools.description: Tool to update values in ranges matching data filters. use when you need to update specific data in a google sheet based on criteria rather than fixed cell ranges.

tools.name: Clear Basic Filter
tools.description: Tool to clear the basic filter from a sheet. use when you need to remove an existing basic filter from a specific sheet within a google spreadsheet.

tools.name: Clear spreadsheet values
tools.description: Clears cell content (preserving formatting and notes) from a specified a1 notation range in a google spreadsheet; the range must correspond to an existing sheet and cells.

tools.name: Create Chart in Google Sheets
tools.description: Create a chart in a google sheets spreadsheet using the specified data range and chart type.

tools.name: Create a Google Sheet
tools.description: Creates a new google spreadsheet in google drive using the provided title.

tools.name: Create spreadsheet column
tools.description: Creates a new column in a google spreadsheet, requiring a valid `spreadsheet id` and an existing `sheet id`; an out-of-bounds `insert index` may append/prepend the column.

tools.name: Create spreadsheet row
tools.description: Inserts a new, empty row into a specified sheet of a google spreadsheet at a given index, optionally inheriting formatting from the row above.

tools.name: Delete Dimension (Rows/Columns)
tools.description: Tool to delete specified rows or columns from a sheet in a google spreadsheet. use when you need to remove a range of rows or columns.

tools.name: Delete Sheet
tools.description: Tool to delete a sheet (worksheet) from a spreadsheet. use when you need to remove a specific sheet from a google sheet document.

tools.name: Execute SQL on Spreadsheet
tools.description: Execute sql queries against google sheets tables. supports select, insert, update, and delete operations with familiar sql syntax. tables are automatically detected and mapped from the spreadsheet structure.

tools.name: Find worksheet by title
tools.description: Finds a worksheet by its exact, case-sensitive title within a google spreadsheet; returns a boolean indicating if found and the complete metadata of the entire spreadsheet, regardless of whether the target worksheet is found.

tools.name: Format cell
tools.description: Applies text and background cell formatting to a specified range in a google sheets worksheet.

tools.name: Get sheet names
tools.description: Lists all worksheet names from a specified google spreadsheet (which must exist), useful for discovering sheets before further operations.

tools.name: Get Spreadsheet by Data Filter
tools.description: Returns the spreadsheet at the given id, filtered by the specified data filters. use this tool when you need to retrieve specific subsets of data from a google sheet based on criteria like a1 notation, developer metadata, or grid ranges.

tools.name: Get spreadsheet info
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive metadata for a google spreadsheet using its id, excluding cell data.

tools.name: Get Table Schema
tools.description: This action is used to get the schema of a table in a google spreadsheet, call this action to get the schema of a table in a spreadsheet before you query the table. analyze table structure and infer column names, types, and constraints. uses statistical analysis of sample data to determine the most likely data type for each column. call this action after calling the list tables action to get the schema of a table in a spreadsheet.

tools.name: Insert Dimension in Google Sheet
tools.description: Tool to insert new rows or columns into a sheet at a specified location. use when you need to add empty rows or columns within an existing google sheet.

tools.name: List Tables in Spreadsheet
tools.description: This action is used to list all tables in a google spreadsheet, call this action to get the list of tables in a spreadsheet. discover all tables in a google spreadsheet by analyzing sheet structure and detecting data patterns. uses heuristic analysis to find header rows, data boundaries, and table structures.

tools.name: Look up spreadsheet row
tools.description: Finds the first row in a google spreadsheet where a cell's entire content exactly matches the query string, searching within a specified a1 notation range or the first sheet by default.

tools.name: Query Spreadsheet Table
tools.description: This action is used to query a table in a google spreadsheet, call this action to query a table in a spreadsheet. execute sql-like select queries against spreadsheet tables. supports where conditions, order by, limit clauses. call this action after calling the get table schema action to query a table in a spreadsheet.

tools.name: Search Developer Metadata
tools.description: Tool to search for developer metadata in a spreadsheet. use when you need to find specific metadata entries based on filters.

tools.name: Search Spreadsheets
tools.description: Search for google spreadsheets using various filters including name, content, date ranges, and more.

tools.name: Set Basic Filter
tools.description: Tool to set a basic filter on a sheet in a google spreadsheet. use when you need to filter or sort data within a specific range on a sheet.

tools.name: Create sheet from JSON
tools.description: Creates a new google spreadsheet and populates its first worksheet from `sheet json`, which must be non-empty as its first item's keys establish the headers.

tools.name: Copy Sheet to Another Spreadsheet
tools.description: Tool to copy a single sheet from a spreadsheet to another spreadsheet. use when you need to duplicate a sheet into a different spreadsheet.

tools.name: Append Values to Spreadsheet
tools.description: Tool to append values to a spreadsheet. use when you need to add new data to the end of an existing table in a google sheet.

tools.name: Batch Clear Spreadsheet Values
tools.description: Tool to clear one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet. use when you need to remove data from specific cells or ranges while keeping formatting and other properties intact.

tools.name: Batch Clear Values By Data Filter
tools.description: Clears one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet using data filters. the caller must specify the spreadsheet id and one or more datafilters. ranges matching any of the specified data filters will be cleared. only values are cleared -- all other properties of the cell (such as formatting, data validation, etc..) are kept.

tools.name: Batch Get Spreadsheet Values by Data Filter
tools.description: Tool to return one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet that match the specified data filters. use when you need to retrieve specific data sets based on filtering criteria rather than entire sheets or fixed ranges.

tools.name: Update Sheet Properties
tools.description: Tool to update properties of a sheet (worksheet) within a google spreadsheet, such as its title, index, visibility, tab color, or grid properties. use this when you need to modify the metadata or appearance of a specific sheet.

tools.name: Update Spreadsheet Properties
tools.description: Tool to update properties of a spreadsheet, such as its title, locale, or auto-recalculation settings. use when you need to modify the overall configuration of a google sheet.

triggers.name: New Rows in Google Sheet
triggers.description:
Simple polling trigger that monitors Google Sheets for new rows.
    Detects when new rows are added and returns the complete row data.
    Perfect for triggering any workflow based on new sheet entries.

triggers.name: New Sheet Added in Google Spreadsheet
triggers.description: Polling trigger that detects when a new sheet is added to a Google Spreadsheet.

name: Slack
description: Slack is a channel-based messaging platform. With Slack, people can work together more effectively, connect all their software tools and services, and find the information they need to do their best work — all within a secure, enterprise-grade environment.

tools.name: Set snooze duration
tools.description: Deprecated: turns on do not disturb mode for the current user, or changes its duration. use `set dnd duration` instead.

tools.name: Add a custom emoji to a Slack team
tools.description: Deprecated: adds a custom emoji to a slack workspace given a unique name and an image url. use `add emoji` instead.

tools.name: Add an emoji alias
tools.description: Adds an alias for an existing custom emoji in a slack enterprise grid organization.

tools.name: Add a remote file
tools.description: Adds a reference to an external file (e.g., google drive, dropbox) to slack for discovery and sharing, requiring a unique `external id` and an `external url` accessible by slack.

tools.name: Add a star to an item
tools.description: Stars a channel, file, file comment, or a specific message in slack.

tools.name: Add call participants
tools.description: Registers new participants added to a slack call.

tools.name: Add emoji
tools.description: Adds a custom emoji to a slack workspace given a unique name and an image url; subject to workspace emoji limits.

tools.name: Add reaction to message
tools.description: Adds a specified emoji reaction to an existing message in a slack channel, identified by its timestamp; does not remove or retrieve reactions.

tools.name: Archive a public or private channel
tools.description: Archives a slack public or private channel, making it read-only; the primary 'general' channel cannot be archived.

tools.name: Archive a Slack conversation
tools.description: Archives a slack conversation by its id, rendering it read-only and hidden while retaining history, ideal for cleaning up inactive channels; be aware that some channels (like #general or certain dms) cannot be archived and this may impact connected integrations.

tools.name: Post message to channel
tools.description: Deprecated: posts a message to a slack channel, direct message, or private channel. use `send message` instead.

tools.name: Close conversation channel
tools.description: Closes a slack direct message (dm) or multi-person direct message (mpdm) channel, removing it from the user's sidebar without deleting history; this action affects only the calling user's view.

tools.name: Create a reminder
tools.description: Creates a slack reminder with specified text and time; time accepts unix timestamps, seconds from now, or natural language (e.g., 'in 15 minutes', 'every thursday at 2pm').

tools.name: Create a Slack user group
tools.description: Creates a new user group (often referred to as a subteam) in a slack workspace.

tools.name: Create channel
tools.description: Initiates a public or private channel-based conversation

tools.name: Create a channel-based conversation
tools.description: Creates a new public or private slack channel with a unique name; the channel can be org-wide, or team-specific if `team id` is given (required if `org wide` is false or not provided).

tools.name: Customize URL unfurl
tools.description: Customizes url previews (unfurling) in a specific slack message using a url-encoded json in `unfurls` to define custom content or remove existing previews.

tools.name: Customize URL unfurling in messages
tools.description: Deprecated: customizes url previews (unfurling) in a specific slack message. use `customize url unfurl` instead.

tools.name: Delete file comment
tools.description: Deletes a specific comment from a file in slack; this action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete a file by ID
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing file from a slack workspace using its unique file id; this action is irreversible and also removes any associated comments or shares.

tools.name: Delete a public or private channel
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specified public or private channel, including all its messages and files, within a slack enterprise grid organization.

tools.name: Delete scheduled chat message
tools.description: Deletes a pending, unsent scheduled message from the specified slack channel, identified by its `scheduled message id`.

tools.name: Delete a Slack reminder
tools.description: Deletes an existing slack reminder, typically when it is no longer relevant or a task is completed; this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete a message from a chat
tools.description: Deletes a message, identified by its channel id and timestamp, from a slack channel, private group, or direct message conversation; the authenticated user or bot must be the original poster.

tools.name: Delete user profile photo
tools.description: Deletes the slack profile photo for the user identified by the token, reverting them to the default avatar; this action is irreversible and succeeds even if no custom photo was set.

tools.name: Disable a Slack user group
tools.description: Disables a specified, currently enabled slack user group by its unique id, effectively archiving it by setting its 'date delete' timestamp; the group is not permanently deleted and can be re-enabled.

tools.name: Enable a user group
tools.description: Enables a disabled user group in slack using its id, reactivating it for mentions and permissions; this action only changes the enabled status and cannot create new groups or modify other properties.

tools.name: Share file public url
tools.description: Enables public sharing for an existing slack file by generating a publicly accessible url; this action does not create new files.

tools.name: End a call
tools.description: Ends an ongoing slack call, identified by its id (obtained from `calls.add`), optionally specifying the call's duration.

tools.name: End snooze
tools.description: Ends the current user's snooze mode immediately.

tools.name: End DND session
tools.description: Ends the authenticated user's current do not disturb (dnd) session in slack, affecting only dnd status and making them available; if dnd is not active, slack acknowledges the request without changing status.

tools.name: End snooze mode immediately
tools.description: Deprecated: ends the current user's snooze mode immediately. use `end snooze` instead.

tools.name: Fetch bot user information
tools.description: Fetches information for a specified, existing slack bot user; will not work for regular user accounts or other integration types.

tools.name: Fetch conversation history
tools.description: Fetches a chronological list of messages and events from a specified slack conversation, accessible by the authenticated user/bot, with options for pagination and time range filtering.

tools.name: Fetch team information
tools.description: Deprecated: fetches comprehensive metadata about the current slack team. use `fetch team info` instead.

tools.name: Get Do Not Disturb status for users
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves a user's current do not disturb status. use `get team dnd status` instead.

tools.name: Fetch item reactions
tools.description: Fetches reactions for a slack message, file, or file comment, requiring one of: channel and timestamp; file id; or file comment id.

tools.name: Retrieve conversation replies
tools.description: Retrieves replies to a specific parent message in a slack conversation, using the channel id and the parent message's timestamp (`ts`).

tools.name: Fetch team info
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive metadata about the current slack team, or a specified team if the provided id is accessible.

tools.name: Fetch workspace settings information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed settings for a specific slack workspace, primarily for administrators in an enterprise grid organization to view or audit workspace configurations.

tools.name: Find channels
tools.description: Find channels in a slack workspace by any criteria - name, topic, purpose, or description.

tools.name: Lookup users by email
tools.description: Retrieves the slack user object for an active user by their registered email address; fails with 'users not found' if the email is unregistered or the user is inactive.

tools.name: Find users
tools.description: Find users in a slack workspace by any criteria - email, name, display name, or other text. includes optimized email lookup for exact email matches.

tools.name: Get channel conversation preferences
tools.description: Retrieves conversation preferences (e.g., who can post, who can thread) for a specified channel, primarily for use within slack enterprise grid environments.

tools.name: Get reminder information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing slack reminder specified by its id; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Get remote file
tools.description: Retrieve information about a remote file added to slack.

tools.name: Get team DND status
tools.description: Retrieves a user's current do not disturb status.

tools.name: Retrieve user presence
tools.description: Retrieves a slack user's current real-time presence (e.g., 'active', 'away') to determine their availability, noting this action does not provide historical data or status reasons.

tools.name: Create conversation
tools.description: Deprecated: initiates a public or private channel-based conversation. use `create channel` instead.

tools.name: Invite users to a Slack channel
tools.description: Invites users to an existing slack channel using their valid slack user ids.

tools.name: Invite users to channel
tools.description: Invites users to a specified slack channel; this action is restricted to enterprise grid workspaces and requires the authenticated user to be a member of the target channel.

tools.name: Invite user to workspace
tools.description: Invites a user to a slack workspace and specified channels by email; use `resend=true` to re-process an existing invitation for a user not yet signed up.

tools.name: Invite user to workspace and channels
tools.description: Deprecated: invites a user to a slack workspace and specified channels by email. use `invite user to workspace` instead.

tools.name: Join conversation by channel id
tools.description: Joins an existing slack conversation (public channel, private channel, or multi-person direct message) by its id, if the authenticated user has permission.

tools.name: Leave conversation channel
tools.description: Leaves a slack conversation given its channel id; fails if leaving as the last member of a private channel or if used on a slack connect channel.

tools.name: List accessible conversations for a user
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves conversations accessible to a specified user. use `list conversations` instead.

tools.name: List all channels
tools.description: Lists conversations available to the user with various filters and search options.

tools.name: List conversations
tools.description: Deprecated: lists conversations available to the user with various filters and search options. use `list channels` instead.

tools.name: List all Slack team users with pagination
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves a paginated list of all users in a slack workspace. use `list all users` instead.

tools.name: List all users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all users, including comprehensive details, profile information, status, and team memberships, in a slack workspace; data may not be real-time.

tools.name: List all users in a user group
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all user ids within a specified slack user group, with an option to include users from disabled groups.

tools.name: List conversations
tools.description: Retrieves conversations accessible to a specified user (or the authenticated user if no user id is provided), respecting shared membership for non-public channels.

tools.name: List Slack files
tools.description: Lists files and their metadata within a slack workspace, filterable by user, channel, timestamp, or type; this action returns metadata only, not file content.

tools.name: List reminders
tools.description: Lists all reminders with their details for the authenticated slack user; returns an empty list if no reminders exist.

tools.name: List remote files
tools.description: Retrieve information about a team's remote files.

tools.name: List scheduled messages
tools.description: Retrieves a list of pending (not yet delivered) messages scheduled in a specific slack channel, or across all accessible channels if no channel id is provided, optionally filtered by time and paginated.

tools.name: List scheduled messages in a channel
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves a list of pending (not yet delivered) messages scheduled in a specific slack channel. use `list scheduled messages` instead.

tools.name: List team remote files
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieve information about a team's remote files. use `list remote files` instead.

tools.name: List pinned items in a channel
tools.description: Retrieves all messages and files pinned to a specified channel; the caller must have access to this channel.

tools.name: List starred items
tools.description: Lists items starred by a user.

tools.name: List starred items
tools.description: Deprecated: lists items starred by a user. use `list starred items` instead.

tools.name: List team custom emojis
tools.description: Retrieves all custom emojis for the slack workspace (image urls or aliases), not standard unicode emojis; does not include usage statistics or creation dates.

tools.name: List user groups
tools.description: Lists user groups in a slack workspace, including user-created and default groups; results for large workspaces may be paginated.

tools.name: List user reactions
tools.description: Lists all reactions added by a specific user to messages, files, or file comments in slack, useful for engagement analysis when the item content itself is not required.

tools.name: List user reminders with details
tools.description: Deprecated: lists all reminders with their details for the authenticated slack user. use `list reminders` instead.

tools.name: List admin users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of admin users for a specified slack workspace.

tools.name: Set user presence
tools.description: Manually sets a user's slack presence, overriding automatic detection; this setting persists across connections but can be overridden by user actions or slack's auto-away (e.g., after 10 mins of inactivity).

tools.name: Mark reminder as complete
tools.description: Marks a specific slack reminder as complete using its `reminder` id; **deprecated**: this slack api endpoint ('reminders.complete') was deprecated in march 2023 and is not recommended for new applications.

tools.name: Open DM
tools.description: Opens or resumes a slack direct message (dm) or multi-person direct message (mpim) by providing either user ids or an existing channel id.

tools.name: Open or resume direct or multi-person messages
tools.description: Deprecated: opens or resumes a slack direct message (dm) or multi-person direct message (mpim). use `open dm` instead.

tools.name: Pin an item to a channel
tools.description: Pins a message to a specified slack channel; the message must not already be pinned.

tools.name: Remove participants from call
tools.description: Deprecated: registers participants removed from a slack call. use `remove call participants` instead.

tools.name: Register a new call with participants
tools.description: Deprecated: registers a new call in slack using `calls.add` for third-party call integration. use `start call` instead.

tools.name: Register new call participants
tools.description: Deprecated: registers new participants added to a slack call. use `add call participants` instead.

tools.name: Remove remote file
tools.description: Removes the slack reference to an external file (which must have been previously added via the remote files api), specified by either its `external id` or `file` id (one of which is required), without deleting the actual external file.

tools.name: Remove a star from an item
tools.description: Removes a star from a previously starred slack item (message, file, file comment, channel, group, or dm), requiring identification via `file`, `file comment`, `channel` (for channel/group/dm), or both `channel` and `timestamp` (for a message).

tools.name: Remove user from conversation
tools.description: Removes a specified user from a slack conversation (channel); the caller must have permissions to remove users and cannot remove themselves using this action.

tools.name: Remove call participants
tools.description: Registers participants removed from a slack call.

tools.name: Remove reaction from item
tools.description: Removes an emoji reaction from a message, file, or file comment in slack.

tools.name: Rename a conversation
tools.description: Renames a slack channel, automatically adjusting the new name to meet naming conventions (e.g., converting to lowercase), which may affect integrations using the old name.

tools.name: Rename an emoji
tools.description: Renames an existing custom emoji in a slack workspace, updating all its instances.

tools.name: Rename a Slack channel
tools.description: Renames a public or private slack channel; for enterprise grid workspaces, the user must be a workspace admin or channel manager.

tools.name: Retrieve a user's identity details
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's and their team's identity, with details varying based on oauth scopes (e.g., `identity.basic`, `identity.email`, `identity.avatar`).

tools.name: Retrieve call information
tools.description: Retrieves a point-in-time snapshot of a specific slack call's information.

tools.name: Retrieve conversation information
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a slack conversation by id (e.g., name, purpose, creation date, with options for member count/locale), excluding message content; requires a valid channel id.

tools.name: Get conversation members
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of active member ids for a specified slack public channel, private channel, direct message (dm), or multi-person direct message (mpim).

tools.name: Retrieve user DND status
tools.description: Retrieves a slack user's current do not disturb (dnd) status to determine their availability before interaction; any specified user id must be a valid slack user id.

tools.name: Retrieve detailed file information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed metadata and paginated comments for a specific slack file id; does not download file content.

tools.name: Retrieve detailed user information
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive information for a valid slack user id, excluding message history and channel memberships.

tools.name: Retrieve message permalink
tools.description: Retrieves a permalink url for a specific message in a slack channel or conversation; the permalink respects slack's privacy settings.

tools.name: Retrieve remote file info
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieve information about a remote file added to slack. use `get remote file` instead.

tools.name: Retrieve team profile details
tools.description: Retrieves all profile field definitions for a slack team, optionally filtered by visibility, to understand the team's profile structure.

tools.name: Retrieve user profile information
tools.description: Retrieves profile information for a specified slack user (defaults to the authenticated user if `user` id is omitted); a provided `user` id must be valid.

tools.name: Unarchive conversation
tools.description: Deprecated: reverses conversation archival. use `unarchive channel` instead.

tools.name: Revoke a file's public url
tools.description: Revokes a slack file's public url, making it private; this is a no-op if not already public and is irreversible.

tools.name: Schedule message
tools.description: Schedules a message to a slack channel, dm, or private group for a future time (`post at`), requiring `text`, `blocks`, or `attachments` for content; scheduling is limited to 120 days in advance.

tools.name: Schedule message in chat
tools.description: Deprecated: schedules a message to a slack channel, dm, or private group for a future time. use `schedule message` instead.

tools.name: Search Messages
tools.description: Deprecated: searches messages in a slack workspace using a query with optional modifiers. use `search messages` instead.

tools.name: Search messages
tools.description: Workspace‑wide slack message search with date ranges and filters. use `query` modifiers (e.g., in:#channel, from:@user, before/after:yyyy-mm-dd), sorting (score/timestamp), and pagination.

tools.name: Send ephemeral message
tools.description: Sends an ephemeral message to a user in a channel.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Posts a message to a slack channel, direct message, or private group; requires content via `text`, `blocks`, or `attachments`.

tools.name: Send a message to a Slack channel
tools.description: Deprecated: posts a message to a slack channel, direct message, or private group. use `send message` instead.

tools.name: Send an ephemeral message
tools.description: Deprecated: sends an ephemeral message to a user in a channel. use `send ephemeral message` instead.

tools.name: Set a conversation's purpose
tools.description: Sets the purpose (a short description of its topic/goal, displayed in the header) for a slack conversation; the calling user must be a member.

tools.name: Set DND duration
tools.description: Turns on do not disturb mode for the current user, or changes its duration.

tools.name: Set profile photo
tools.description: This method allows the user to set their profile image.

tools.name: Set conversation read cursor
tools.description: Marks a message, specified by its timestamp (`ts`), as the most recently read for the authenticated user in the given `channel`, provided the user is a member of the channel and the message exists within it.

tools.name: Set Slack user profile information
tools.description: Updates a slack user's profile, setting either individual fields or multiple fields via a json object.

tools.name: Set conversation topic
tools.description: Sets or updates the topic for a specified slack conversation.

tools.name: Set the user's profile image
tools.description: Deprecated: this method allows the user to set their profile image. use `set profile photo` instead.

tools.name: Share a me message in a channel
tools.description: Sends a 'me message' (e.g., '/me is typing') to a slack channel, where it's displayed as a third-person user action; messages are plain text and the channel must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: Share a remote file in channels
tools.description: Shares a remote file, which must already be registered with slack, into specified slack channels or direct message conversations.

tools.name: Start call
tools.description: Registers a new call in slack using `calls.add` for third-party call integration; `created by` is required if not using a user-specific token.

tools.name: Start real time messaging session
tools.description: Initiates a slack rtm session providing a single-use websocket url (valid 30s) for event streaming; does not set initial presence status.

tools.name: Unarchive a public or private channel
tools.description: Unarchives a specified public or private slack channel that is currently archived, using its channel id.

tools.name: Unarchive channel
tools.description: Reverses conversation archival.

tools.name: Unpin message from channel
tools.description: Unpins a message, identified by its timestamp, from a specified channel if the message is currently pinned there; this operation is destructive.

tools.name: Update Slack user group
tools.description: Updates an existing slack user group, which must be specified by an existing `usergroup` id, with new optional details such as its name, description, handle, or default channels.

tools.name: Update an existing remote file
tools.description: Updates metadata or content details for an existing remote file in slack; this action cannot upload new files or change the fundamental file type.

tools.name: Update a Slack message
tools.description: Updates a slack message, identified by `channel` id and `ts` timestamp, by modifying its `text`, `attachments`, or `blocks`; provide at least one content field, noting `attachments`/`blocks` are replaced if included (`[]` clears them).

tools.name: Update call information
tools.description: Updates the title, join url, or desktop app join url for an existing slack call identified by its id.

tools.name: Update user group members
tools.description: Replaces all members of an existing slack user group with a new list of valid user ids.

tools.name: Upload or create a file in Slack
tools.description: Uploads a file to slack, requiring either `content` (for text) or `file` (for binary data), optionally sharing it in specified `channels` or as a reply via `thread ts`.

triggers.name: New Channel Created Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a new channel is created in Slack.

triggers.name: Reaction Added Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a reaction is added to a message in Slack.

triggers.name: Reaction Removed Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a reaction is removed from a message.

triggers.name: New Bot Message Received Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a new bot message is posted to a Slack channel.

triggers.name: New Direct Message Received Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a new direct message (DM) is sent to a user in Slack.

triggers.name: New Private Channel Message Received Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a new message is posted to a private channel in Slack.

triggers.name: New Message Received Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a new message is posted to a Slack channel.

triggers.name: New Multi-Person Direct Message Received Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a new message is posted to a multi-person direct message in Slack.

triggers.name: Thread Reply Received Trigger
triggers.description:
Triggered when reply is added to a message in a thread.
    Excludes the parent message_replied event by design (ts != thread_ts check).

name: Supabase
description: Supabase is an open-source backend-as-a-service providing a Postgres database, authentication, storage, and real-time subscription APIs for building modern applications

tools.name: Create project api key
tools.description: Creates a 'publishable' or 'secret' api key for an existing supabase project, optionally with a description; 'secret' keys can have customized jwt templates.

tools.name: Delete an API key from the project
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific api key (identified by `id`) from a supabase project (identified by `ref`), revoking its access.

tools.name: Get a third-party integration
tools.description: Retrieves the detailed configuration for a specific third-party authentication (tpa) provider, identified by `tpa id`, within an existing supabase project specified by `ref`.

tools.name: List third-party auth integrations for project
tools.description: Lists all configured third-party authentication provider integrations for an existing supabase project (using its `ref`), suitable for read-only auditing or verifying current authentication settings.

tools.name: Delete third party auth config
tools.description: Removes a third-party authentication provider (e.g., google, github) from a supabase project's configuration; this immediately prevents users from logging in via that method.

tools.name: Update an API key for the project
tools.description: Updates an existing supabase project api key's `description` and/or `secret jwt template` (which defines its `role`); does not regenerate the key string.

tools.name: Beta activate custom hostname for project
tools.description: Activates a previously configured custom hostname for a supabase project, assuming dns settings are verified externally.

tools.name: Activate vanity subdomain for project
tools.description: Activates a vanity subdomain for the specified supabase project, requiring subsequent dns configuration for the subdomain to become operational.

tools.name: Authorize user through OAuth
tools.description: Generates a supabase oauth 2.0 authorization url for user redirection, requiring a pre-registered `client id` and a `redirect uri` that matches one of its pre-registered uris.

tools.name: Check vanity subdomain availability
tools.description: Checks if a specific vanity subdomain is available for a supabase project; this action does not reserve or assign the subdomain.

tools.name: Enable project database webhooks
tools.description: Enables database webhooks for the supabase project `ref`, triggering real-time notifications for insert, update, or delete events.

tools.name: Get project SSL enforcement configuration
tools.description: Retrieves the ssl enforcement configuration for a specified supabase project, indicating if ssl connections are mandated for its database.

tools.name: Get current vanity subdomain config
tools.description: Fetches the current vanity subdomain configuration, including its status and custom domain name, for a supabase project identified by its reference id.

tools.name: Beta get project's custom hostname config
tools.description: Retrieves a supabase project's custom hostname configuration, including its status, ssl certificate, and ownership verification, noting that availability may depend on the project's plan.

tools.name: Retrieve network bans for project
tools.description: Retrieves the list of banned ipv4 addresses for a supabase project using its unique project reference string; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Retrieve project network restrictions
tools.description: Retrieves the current network restriction settings (e.g., ip whitelists) for a supabase project using its reference id; this is a read-only operation for auditing or verifying network security.

tools.name: Get project pgsodium config
tools.description: Retrieves the pgsodium configuration, including the root encryption key, for an existing supabase project identified by its `ref`.

tools.name: Beta remove a read replica
tools.description: Irreversibly initiates the removal of a specified read replica from an existing supabase project, confirming only the start of the process, not its completion.

tools.name: Remove project network bans
tools.description: Removes specified ipv4 addresses from a supabase project's network ban list, granting immediate access; ips not currently banned are ignored.

tools.name: Execute project database query
tools.description: Executes a given sql query against the project's database; use for advanced data operations or when standard api endpoints are insufficient, ensuring queries are valid postgresql and sanitized. use the get table schemas or generate type script types tool to retrieve the table schema, then base your query on it.

tools.name: Setup read replica for project
tools.description: Provisions a read-only replica for a supabase project in a specified, supabase-supported aws region to enhance read performance and reduce latency.

tools.name: Beta update project network restrictions
tools.description: Updates and applies network access restrictions (ipv4/ipv6 cidr lists) for a supabase project, which may terminate existing connections not matching the new rules.

tools.name: Upgrade the project's PostgreSQL version
tools.description: Initiates an asynchronous upgrade of a supabase project's postgresql database to a specified `target version` from a selected `release channel`, returning a `tracking id` to monitor status; the `target version` must be available in the chosen channel.

tools.name: Update pgsodium root key
tools.description: Critically updates or initializes a supabase project's pgsodium root encryption key for security setup or key rotation, requiring secure backup of the new key to prevent irreversible data loss.

tools.name: Create a database branch
tools.description: Creates a new, isolated database branch from an existing supabase project (identified by `ref`), useful for setting up separate environments like development or testing, which can optionally be linked to a git branch.

tools.name: Create a function
tools.description: Creates a new serverless edge function for a supabase project (identified by `ref`), requiring valid javascript/typescript in `body` and a project-unique `slug 1` identifier.

tools.name: Create an organization
tools.description: Creates a new supabase organization, which serves as a top-level container for projects, billing, and team access.

tools.name: Create new project
tools.description: Creates a new supabase project, requiring a unique name (no dots) within the organization; project creation is asynchronous.

tools.name: Create SSO provider configuration
tools.description: Creates a new saml 2.0 single sign-on (sso) provider for a supabase project, requiring either `metadata xml` or `metadata url` for saml idp configuration.

tools.name: Create a new third-party auth integration
tools.description: Call this to add a new third-party authentication method (oidc or jwks) to a supabase project for integrating external identity providers (e.g., for sso); the api may also support `custom jwks` if sent directly.

tools.name: Reverify custom hostname
tools.description: Re-verifies dns and ssl configurations for an existing custom hostname associated with a supabase project.

tools.name: Delete branch by id
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specific, non-default database branch by its `branch id`, without affecting other branches.

tools.name: Delete an edge function by slug
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific edge function (by `function slug`) from a supabase project (by `ref`); this action is irreversible and requires prior existence of both project and function.

tools.name: Delete custom hostname config
tools.description: Deletes an active custom hostname configuration for the project identified by `ref`, reverting to the default supabase-provided hostname; this action immediately makes the project inaccessible via the custom domain and requires subsequent updates to client, oauth, and dns settings.

tools.name: Delete vanity subdomain for project
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes an active vanity subdomain configuration for the specified supabase project, reverting it to its default supabase url.

tools.name: Delete project by ref
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a supabase project, identified by its unique `ref` id, resulting in complete data loss.

tools.name: Deploy function
tools.description: Deploys edge functions to a supabase project using multipart upload.

tools.name: Disable project readonly mode
tools.description: Temporarily disables a supabase project's read-only mode for 15 minutes to allow write operations (e.g., for maintenance or critical updates), after which it automatically reverts to read-only.

tools.name: Disable preview branching
tools.description: Disables the preview branching feature for an existing supabase project, identified by its unique reference id (`ref`).

tools.name: Exchange auth code for access and refresh token
tools.description: (beta) implements the oauth 2.0 token endpoint to exchange an authorization code or refresh token for access/refresh tokens, based on `grant type`.

tools.name: Generate TypeScript types
tools.description: Generates and retrieves typescript types from a supabase project's database; any schemas specified in `included schemas` must exist in the project.

tools.name: Get database branch config
tools.description: Retrieves the read-only configuration and status for a supabase database branch, typically for monitoring or verifying its settings.

tools.name: Get project API keys
tools.description: Retrieves all api keys for an existing supabase project, specified by its unique reference id (`ref`); this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Get project PgBouncer config
tools.description: Retrieves the active pgbouncer configuration (postgresql connection pooler) for a supabase project, used for performance tuning, auditing, or getting the connection string.

tools.name: Get Project Upgrade Eligibility
tools.description: Checks a supabase project's eligibility for an upgrade, verifying compatibility and identifying potential issues; this action does not perform the actual upgrade.

tools.name: Get project upgrade status
tools.description: Retrieves the latest status of a supabase project's database upgrade for monitoring purposes; does not initiate or modify upgrades.

tools.name: Get a specific SQL snippet
tools.description: Retrieves a specific sql snippet by its unique identifier.

tools.name: Get a SSO provider by its UUID
tools.description: Retrieves the configuration details for a specific single sign-on (sso) provider (e.g., saml, google, github, azure ad), identified by its uuid, within a supabase project.

tools.name: Get information about an organization
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specific supabase organization using its unique slug.

tools.name: Get project's auth config
tools.description: Retrieves the project's complete read-only authentication configuration, detailing all settings (e.g., providers, mfa, email/sms, jwt, security policies) but excluding sensitive secrets.

tools.name: Get project postgres config
tools.description: Retrieves the current read-only postgresql database configuration for a specified supabase project's `ref`, noting that some advanced or security-sensitive details might be omitted from the response.

tools.name: Get project's PostgREST config
tools.description: Retrieves the postgrest configuration for a specific supabase project.

tools.name: Get project's service health status
tools.description: Retrieves the current health status for a supabase project, for specified services or all services if the 'services' list is omitted.

tools.name: Get project Supavisor configuration
tools.description: Retrieves the supavisor (connection pooler) configuration for a specified supabase project, identified by its reference id.

tools.name: Get Table Schemas
tools.description: Retrieves column details, types, and constraints for multiple database tables to help debug schema issues and write accurate sql queries.

tools.name: List all database branches
tools.description: Lists all database branches for a specified supabase project, used for isolated development and testing of schema changes; ensure the project reference id is valid.

tools.name: List all functions
tools.description: Lists metadata for all edge functions in a supabase project (specified by 'ref'), excluding function code or logs; the project must exist.

tools.name: List all organizations
tools.description: Lists all organizations (id and name only) associated with the supabase account, excluding project details within these organizations.

tools.name: List all projects
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all supabase projects, including their id, name, region, and status, for the authenticated user.

tools.name: List all secrets
tools.description: Retrieves all secrets for a supabase project using its reference id; secret values in the response may be masked.

tools.name: List members of an organization
tools.description: Retrieves all members of a supabase organization, identified by its unique slug, including their user id, username, email, role, and mfa status.

tools.name: List project database backups
tools.description: Lists all database backups for a supabase project, providing details on existing backups but not creating new ones or performing restores; availability may depend on plan and configuration.

tools.name: List all buckets
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all storage buckets for a supabase project, without returning bucket contents or access policies.

tools.name: List all SSO providers
tools.description: Lists all configured single sign-on (sso) providers for a supabase project, requiring the project reference id (`ref`) of an existing project.

tools.name: List SQL snippets for the logged in user
tools.description: Retrieves a list of sql snippets for the logged-in user, optionally filtered by a specific supabase project if `project ref` is provided.

tools.name: Remove an SSO provider
tools.description: Deletes a specific sso provider by its id (`provider id`) from a supabase project (`ref`), which disables it and returns its details; ensure this action will not inadvertently lock out users.

tools.name: Reset a database branch
tools.description: Resets an existing supabase database branch, identified by `branch id`, to its initial clean state, irreversibly deleting all its current data and schema changes.

tools.name: Restore database PITR backup
tools.description: Restores a supabase project's database to a specific unix timestamp using point-in-time recovery (pitr), overwriting the current state; requires a paid plan with pitr and physical backups enabled.

tools.name: Retrieve a function
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information, metadata, configuration, and status for a specific edge function using its project reference id and function slug.

tools.name: Retrieve a function body
tools.description: Retrieves the source code (body) for a specified serverless edge function using its project reference and function slug; this is a read-only operation that does not execute the function or return runtime logs.

tools.name: Get project's read-only mode status
tools.description: Retrieves the read-only mode status for a specified supabase project to check its operational state; this action does not change the read-only state.

tools.name: Update a function
tools.description: Updates an existing supabase edge function's properties (like name, slug, source code, jwt settings, import map) identified by project `ref` and `function slug`, supporting plain text code or eszip for the body.

tools.name: Update database branch config
tools.description: Updates the configuration of a supabase database branch, allowing modification of its name, associated git branch, reset-on-push behavior, persistence, and status.

tools.name: Update project's custom hostname configuration
tools.description: Updates the custom hostname for a supabase project, requiring subsequent dns changes to a user-controlled domain for ssl certificate issuance and domain ownership.

tools.name: Update an SSO provider by its UUID
tools.description: Updates an existing sso provider's saml metadata, associated email domains, or attribute mappings for a supabase project, identified by `ref` and `provider id`.

tools.name: Update project's postgres config
tools.description: Updates specified postgresql configuration parameters for an existing supabase project (`ref`) to optimize database performance; note that unspecified parameters remain unchanged, and caution is advised as incorrect settings can impact stability or require a restart.

tools.name: Update project's PostgREST config
tools.description: Updates postgrest configuration settings (e.g., `max rows`, `db pool`, `db schema`, `db extra search path`) for a supabase project to fine-tune api performance, data exposure, and database resource usage.

tools.name: Update database pooler config
tools.description: Updates the supavisor (database pooler) configuration, such as `default pool size`, for an existing supabase project identified by `ref`; the `pool mode` parameter in the request is deprecated and ignored.

tools.name: Update SSL enforcement config
tools.description: Updates the ssl enforcement configuration (enable/disable) for a specified supabase project's database.

name: Outlook
description: Outlook is Microsoft's email and calendaring platform integrating contacts and scheduling, enabling users to manage communications and events in a unified workspace

tools.name: Add mail attachment
tools.description: Tool to add an attachment to an email message. use when you have a message id and need to attach a small (<3 mb) file or reference.

tools.name: Create calendar
tools.description: Tool to create a new calendar in the signed-in user's mailbox. use when organizing events into a separate calendar.

tools.name: Create contact folder
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact folder in the user's mailbox. use when needing to organize contacts into custom folders.

tools.name: Create Email Rule
tools.description: Create email rule filter with conditions and actions

tools.name: Create mail folder
tools.description: Tool to create a new mail folder. use when you need to organize email into a new folder.

tools.name: Create master category
tools.description: Tool to create a new category in the user's master category list. use after selecting a unique display name.

tools.name: Delete mail folder
tools.description: Delete a mail folder from the user's mailbox. use when you need to remove an existing mail folder.

tools.name: Download Outlook attachment
tools.description: Downloads a specific file attachment from an email message in a microsoft outlook mailbox; the attachment must contain 'contentbytes' (binary data) and not be a link or embedded item.

tools.name: Get mailbox settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve mailbox settings. use when you need to view settings such as automatic replies, time zone, and working hours for the signed-in or specified user.

tools.name: Get mail delta
tools.description: Tool to retrieve incremental changes (delta) of messages in a mailbox. use when syncing mailbox updates since last checkpoint.

tools.name: Get mail tips
tools.description: Tool to retrieve mail tips such as automatic replies and mailbox full status. use when you need to check recipient status before sending mail.

tools.name: Get master categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the user's master category list. use when you need to get all categories defined for the user.

tools.name: Get supported languages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve supported languages in the user's mailbox. use when you need to display or select from available mailbox languages.

tools.name: Get supported time zones
tools.description: Tool to retrieve supported time zones in the user's mailbox. use when you need a list of time zones to display or choose from for event scheduling.

tools.name: List Outlook calendars
tools.description: Tool to list calendars in the signed-in user's mailbox. use when you need to retrieve calendars with optional odata queries.

tools.name: List event attachments
tools.description: Tool to list attachments for a specific outlook calendar event. use when you have an event id and need to view its attachments.

tools.name: List Outlook attachments
tools.description: Lists metadata (like name, size, and type, but not `contentbytes`) for all attachments of a specified outlook email message.

tools.name: List event reminders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve reminders for events occurring within a specified time range. use when you need to see upcoming reminders between two datetimes.

tools.name: Add event attachment
tools.description: Adds an attachment to a specific outlook calendar event. use when you need to attach a file or nested item to an existing event.

tools.name: Create Calendar Event
tools.description: Creates a new outlook calendar event, ensuring `start datetime` is chronologically before `end datetime`.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Creates a new contact in a microsoft outlook user's contacts folder.

tools.name: Create email draft
tools.description: Creates an outlook email draft with subject, body, recipients, and an optional attachment. supports creating drafts as part of existing conversation threads by specifying a conversationid; attachments require a name, mimetype, and content.

tools.name: Create a draft reply
tools.description: Creates a draft reply in the specified user's outlook mailbox to an existing message (identified by a valid `message id`), optionally including a `comment` and cc/bcc recipients.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing contact, using its `contact id` (obtainable via 'list user contacts' or 'get contact'), from the outlook contacts of the user specified by `user id`.

tools.name: Delete Calendar Event
tools.description: Deletes an existing calendar event, identified by its unique `event id`, from a specified user's microsoft outlook calendar, with an option to send cancellation notifications to attendees.

tools.name: Get contact
tools.description: Retrieves a specific outlook contact by its `contact id` from the contacts of a specified `user id` (defaults to 'me' for the authenticated user).

tools.name: Get contact folders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of contact folders in the signed-in user's mailbox. use after authentication when you need to browse or select among contact folders.

tools.name: Get calendar event
tools.description: Retrieves the full details of a specific calendar event by its id from a user's outlook calendar, provided the event exists.

tools.name: Get email message
tools.description: Retrieves a specific email message by its id from the specified user's outlook mailbox. use the 'select' parameter to include specific fields like 'internetmessageheaders' for filtering automated emails.

tools.name: Get Outlook profile
tools.description: Retrieves the microsoft outlook profile for a specified user.

tools.name: Get schedule
tools.description: Retrieves free/busy schedule information for specified email addresses within a defined time window.

tools.name: List Outlook contacts
tools.description: Retrieves a user's microsoft outlook contacts, from the default or a specified contact folder.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Retrieves events from a user's outlook calendar via microsoft graph api, supporting pagination, filtering, property selection, sorting, and timezone specification.

tools.name: List mail folders
tools.description: Tool to list a user's top-level mail folders. use when you need folders like inbox, drafts, sent items; set include hidden folders=true to include hidden folders.

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: Retrieves a list of email messages from a specified mail folder in an outlook mailbox, with options for filtering (including by conversationid to get all messages in a thread), pagination, and sorting; ensure 'user id' and 'folder' are valid, and all date/time strings are in iso 8601 format.

tools.name: Move message to folder
tools.description: Move a message to another folder within the specified user's mailbox. this creates a new copy of the message in the destination folder and removes the original message.

tools.name: Reply to Email
tools.description: Sends a plain text reply to an outlook email message, identified by `message id`, allowing optional cc and bcc recipients.

tools.name: Search Outlook messages
tools.description: Searches messages in a microsoft 365 or enterprise outlook account mailbox, supporting filters for sender, subject, attachments, pagination, and sorting by relevance or date.

tools.name: Send email
tools.description: Sends an email with subject, body, recipients, and an optional attachment via microsoft graph api; attachments require a non-empty file with valid name and mimetype.

tools.name: Update calendar event
tools.description: Updates specified fields of an existing outlook calendar event.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Updates an existing outlook contact, identified by `contact id` for the specified `user id`, requiring at least one other field to be modified.

tools.name: Update email message
tools.description: Updates specified properties of an existing email message; `message id` must identify a valid message within the specified `user id`'s mailbox.

tools.name: Update mailbox settings
tools.description: Tool to update mailbox settings for the signed-in user. use when you need to configure automatic replies, default time zone, language, or working hours. example: schedule automatic replies for vacation.

triggers.name: New Contact Added
triggers.description: Triggered when a new contact is added in the Outlook contacts.

triggers.name: Calendar Event Changes
triggers.description: Triggered when a new calendar event occurs (created, updated, or deleted) in the Outlook calendar.

triggers.name: New Calendar Event
triggers.description: Triggered when a new calendar event is created in the Outlook calendar.

triggers.name: New Outlook Message
triggers.description: Triggered when a new message is received in the Outlook mailbox.

triggers.name: New Sent Message
triggers.description: Triggered when a new message is sent from the Outlook mailbox.
