name: Perplexity AI
description: Perplexity AI provides conversational AI models for generating human-like text responses

tools.name: PerplexityAISearch
tools.description: Perplexity ai search interfaces with perplexity ai to perform search queries and return responses from a range of models. this action manages requests to perplexity ai and processes the resulting completions, which may include text, citations, and images based on selected models and settings. key features include: autoprompting to enhance and refine queries, choice of ai models for various content and performance requirements, temperature settings to manage response randomness, top k and top p filters to fine-tune response generation. beta features include citations and images in results, and response streaming for dynamic interaction. note: the parameters 'presence penalty' and 'frequency penalty' are mutually exclusive and cannot be used simultaneously.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: API key for Perplexity AI

name: Twitter
description: Twitter, Inc. was an American social media company based in San Francisco, California, which operated and was named for named for its flagship social media network prior to its rebrand as X.

tools.name: Add a list member
tools.description: Adds a user to a specified twitter list; the list must be owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: Add post to bookmarks
tools.description: Adds a specified, existing, and accessible tweet to a user's bookmarks, with success indicated by the 'bookmarked' field in the response.

tools.name: Get bookmarks by user
tools.description: Retrieves tweets bookmarked by the authenticated user, where the provided user id must match the authenticated user's id.

tools.name: Create group DM conversation
tools.description: Creates a new group direct message (dm) conversation on twitter with specified participant ids and an initial message, which can include text and media attachments.

tools.name: Create compliance job
tools.description: Creates a new compliance job to check the status of tweet or user ids; upload ids as a plain text file (one id per line) to the `upload url` received in the response.

tools.name: Create a list
tools.description: Creates a new, empty list on x (formerly twitter), for which the provided name must be unique for the authenticated user; accounts are added separately.

tools.name: Create a post
tools.description: Creates a tweet on twitter; `text` is required unless `card uri`, `media media ids`, `poll options`, or `quote tweet id` is provided.

tools.name: Delete direct message
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific twitter direct message (dm) event using its `event id` if the authenticated user sent it; this action is irreversible and does not delete entire conversations.

tools.name: Delete list
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specified twitter list using its id, which must be owned by the authenticated user; this action is irreversible and the list must already exist.

tools.name: Fetch list members by id
tools.description: Fetches members of a specific twitter list, identified by its unique id.

tools.name: Fetch space ticket buyers list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of users who purchased tickets for a specific, valid, and ticketed twitter space.

tools.name: Follow a list
tools.description: Allows the authenticated user (`id`) to follow a specific twitter list (`list id`) they are permitted to access, subscribing them to the list's timeline; this does not automatically follow individual list members.

tools.name: Get followers by user id
tools.description: Retrieves a list of users who follow a specified public twitter user id.

tools.name: Get following by user ID
tools.description: Retrieves users followed by a specific twitter user, allowing pagination and customization of returned user and tweet data fields via expansions.

tools.name: Follow a user
tools.description: Allows an authenticated user (path `id`) to follow another user (`target user id`), which results in a pending request if the target user's tweets are protected.

tools.name: Search full archive of tweets
tools.description: Searches the full archive of public tweets from march 2006 onwards; use 'start time' and 'end time' together for a defined time window.

tools.name: Get full archive search counts
tools.description: Returns a count of tweets from the full archive that match a specified query, aggregated by day, hour, or minute; `start time` must be before `end time` if both are provided, and `since id`/`until id` cannot be used with `start time`/`end time`.

tools.name: Get a user's list memberships
tools.description: Retrieves all twitter lists a specified user is a member of, including public lists and private lists the authenticated user is authorized to view.

tools.name: Get a user's owned lists
tools.description: Call this action to retrieve lists created (owned) by a specific twitter user, not lists they follow or are subscribed to.

tools.name: Get a user's pinned lists
tools.description: Retrieves the lists a specific, existing twitter user has pinned to their profile to highlight them.

tools.name: Get users blocked by user ID
tools.description: Retrieves user objects for accounts blocked by the specified user id; this is a read-only view of a user's block list.

tools.name: Get DM events by ID
tools.description: Fetches a specific direct message (dm) event by its unique id, allowing optional expansion of related data like users or tweets; ensure the `event id` refers to an existing dm event accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get DM events for a DM conversation
tools.description: Fetches direct message (dm) events for a one-on-one conversation with a specified participant id, ordered chronologically newest to oldest; does not support group dms.

tools.name: Get list followers
tools.description: Fetches a list of users who follow a specific twitter list, identified by its id; ensure the authenticated user has access if the list is private.

tools.name: Get muted users
tools.description: Returns user objects muted by the x user identified by the `id` path parameter.

tools.name: Get post retweeters
tools.description: Retrieves users who publicly retweeted a specified public post id, excluding quote tweets and retweets from private accounts.

tools.name: Get recent direct message events
tools.description: Returns recent direct message events for the authenticated user, such as new messages or changes in conversation participants.

tools.name: Get user's followed lists
tools.description: Returns metadata (not tweets) for lists a specific twitter user follows, optionally including expanded owner details.

tools.name: Set reply visibility
tools.description: Hides or unhides an existing reply tweet.

tools.name: Lookup list by ID
tools.description: Returns metadata for a specific twitter list, identified by its id; does not return list members but can expand the owner's user object via the `expansions` parameter.

tools.name: List post likers
tools.description: Retrieves users who have liked the post (tweet) identified by the provided id.

tools.name: List posts timeline by list ID
tools.description: Fetches the most recent tweets posted by members of a specified twitter list.

tools.name: Mute user by ID
tools.description: Mutes a target user on behalf of an authenticated user, preventing the target's tweets and retweets from appearing in the authenticated user's home timeline without notifying the target.

tools.name: Pin a list
tools.description: Pins a specified list to the authenticated user's profile, provided the list exists, the user has access rights, and the pin limit (typically 5 lists) is not exceeded.

tools.name: Delete tweet
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes a specific tweet by its id; the tweet may persist in third-party caches after deletion.

tools.name: Look up post by id
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a single tweet by its unique id, provided the tweet exists and is accessible.

tools.name: Get tweets by IDs
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for one or more posts (tweets) identified by their unique ids, allowing selection of specific fields and expansions.

tools.name: Get tweets label stream
tools.description: Establishes a persistent stream of real-time events for when tweet labels are applied or removed, offering insights into content categorization.

tools.name: Fetch tweet usage data
tools.description: Fetches tweet usage statistics for a project (e.g., consumption, caps, daily breakdowns for project & client apps) to monitor api limits; data can be retrieved for 1 to 90 days.

tools.name: Search recent tweets
tools.description: Searches tweets from the last 7 days matching a query (using x's search syntax), ideal for real-time analysis, trend monitoring, or retrieving posts from specific users (e.g., `from:username`)

tools.name: Fetch recent tweet counts
tools.description: Retrieves the count of tweets matching a specified search query within the last 7 days, aggregated by 'minute', 'hour', or 'day'.

tools.name: Remove a bookmarked post
tools.description: Removes a tweet, specified by `tweet id`, from the authenticated user's bookmarks; the tweet must have been previously bookmarked by the user for the action to have an effect.

tools.name: Remove a list member
tools.description: Removes a user from a twitter list; the response `is member` field will be `false` if removal was successful or the user was not a member, and the updated list of members is not returned.

tools.name: Retrieve compliance job by id
tools.description: Retrieves status, download/upload urls, and other details for an existing twitter compliance job specified by its unique id.

tools.name: Retrieve compliance jobs
tools.description: Returns a list of recent compliance jobs, filtered by type (tweets or users) and optionally by status.

tools.name: Retrieve DM conversation events
tools.description: Retrieves direct message (dm) events for a specific conversation id on twitter, useful for analyzing messages and participant activities.

tools.name: Retrieve posts from a space
tools.description: Retrieves tweets from a specified twitter space id; the space must be accessible and results are batched (not streamed).

tools.name: Retrieve posts that quote a post
tools.description: Retrieves tweets that quote a specified tweet, requiring a valid tweet id.

tools.name: Retrieve retweets of a post
tools.description: Retrieves tweets that retweeted a specified public or authenticated-user-accessible tweet id, optionally customizing the response with fields and expansions.

tools.name: Retrieve liked tweets by user ID
tools.description: Retrieves tweets liked by a specified twitter user, provided their liked tweets are public or accessible.

tools.name: Fetch OpenAPI specification
tools.description: Fetches the openapi specification (json) for twitter's api v2, used to programmatically understand the api's structure for developing client libraries or tools.

tools.name: Retweet post
tools.description: Retweets a tweet (`tweet id`) for a given user (`id`), provided the tweet is public (or user follows if protected), not already retweeted by the user, and its author has not blocked the user.

tools.name: Search for spaces
tools.description: Searches for twitter spaces by a textual query, optionally filtering by state (live, scheduled, all) to discover audio conversations.

tools.name: Send a new message to a DM conversation
tools.description: Sends a message, with optional text and/or media attachments (using pre-uploaded `media id`s), to a specified twitter direct message conversation.

tools.name: Send a new message to a user
tools.description: Sends a new direct message with text and/or media (media id for attachments must be pre-uploaded) to a specified twitter user; this creates a new dm and does not modify existing messages.

tools.name: Look up space by ID
tools.description: Retrieves details for a twitter space by its id, allowing for customization and expansion of related data, provided the space id is valid and accessible.

tools.name: Get spaces by creator IDs
tools.description: Retrieves twitter spaces created by a list of specified user ids, with options to customize returned data fields.

tools.name: Get space information by IDs
tools.description: Fetches detailed information for one or more twitter spaces (live, scheduled, or ended) by their unique ids; at least one space id must be provided.

tools.name: Unfollow a list
tools.description: Enables a user (via `id`) to unfollow a specific twitter list (via `list id`), which removes its tweets from their timeline and stops related notifications; the action reports `following: false` on success, even if the user was not initially following the list.

tools.name: Unfollow user
tools.description: Allows the authenticated `source user id` to unfollow an existing twitter user (`target user id`), which removes the follow relationship.

tools.name: Unlike post
tools.description: Allows an authenticated user (`id`) to remove their like from a specific post (`tweet id`); the action is idempotent and completes successfully even if the post was not liked.

tools.name: Unmute a user by user ID
tools.description: Unmutes a `target user id` for the `source user id` (authenticated user), allowing the source user to see tweets and notifications from the target user again.

tools.name: Unpin a list
tools.description: Unpins a list (specified by list id) from a user's profile (specified by id), provided the list is currently pinned by that user.

tools.name: Unretweet post
tools.description: Removes a user's retweet of a specified post, if the user had previously retweeted it.

tools.name: Update list attributes
tools.description: Updates an existing twitter list's name, description, or privacy status, requiring the list id and at least one mutable property.

tools.name: Get user reverse chronological timeline
tools.description: Retrieves the home timeline/feed for a specified twitter user, showing tweets from accounts they follow - not their own posts - in reverse chronological order; useful for displaying their personalized feed without algorithmic sorting.

tools.name: Like a tweet
tools.description: Allows the authenticated user (`id`) to like a specific, accessible tweet (`tweet id`), provided neither user has blocked the other and the authenticated user is not restricted from liking.

tools.name: Look up user by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed public information for a twitter user by their id, optionally expanding related data (e.g., pinned tweets) and specifying particular user or tweet fields to return.

tools.name: Look up users by IDs
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for specified x (formerly twitter) user ids, optionally customizing returned fields and expanding related entities.

tools.name: Look up user by username
tools.description: Fetches public profile information for a valid and existing twitter user by their username, optionally expanding related data like pinned tweets; results may be limited for protected profiles not followed by the authenticated user.

tools.name: Look up users by username
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for 1 to 100 twitter users by their usernames (each 1-15 alphanumeric characters/underscores), allowing customizable user/tweet fields and expansion of related data like pinned tweets.

tools.name: Get authenticated user
tools.description: Returns profile information for the currently authenticated x user, customizable via request fields.

name: Google Drive
description: Google Drive is a cloud storage solution for uploading, sharing, and collaborating on files across devices, with robust search and offline access

tools.name: Add file sharing preference
tools.description: Modifies sharing permissions for an existing google drive file, granting a specified role to a user, group, domain, or 'anyone'.

tools.name: Copy file
tools.description: Duplicates an existing file in google drive, identified by its `file id`.

tools.name: Create Comment
tools.description: Tool to create a comment on a file. use when you need to add a new comment to a specific file in google drive.

tools.name: Create Shared Drive
tools.description: Tool to create a new shared drive. use when you need to programmatically create a new shared drive for collaboration or storage.

tools.name: Create File or Folder
tools.description: Creates a new file or folder with metadata. use to create empty files or folders, or files with content by providing it in the request body (though this action primarily focuses on metadata creation).

tools.name: Create a File from Text
tools.description: Creates a new file in google drive from provided text content (up to 10mb), supporting various formats including automatic conversion to google workspace types.

tools.name: Create a folder
tools.description: Creates a new folder in google drive, optionally within a parent folder specified by its id or name; if a parent name is provided but not found, the action will fail.

tools.name: Create Reply
tools.description: Tool to create a reply to a comment in google drive. use when you need to respond to an existing comment on a file.

tools.name: Create Shortcut to File/Folder
tools.description: Tool to create a shortcut to a file or folder in google drive. use when you need to link to an existing drive item from another location without duplicating it.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Deletes a comment from a file. use when you need to remove a specific comment from a google drive file.

tools.name: Delete Shared Drive
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a shared drive. use when you need to remove a shared drive and its contents (if specified).

tools.name: Delete Permission
tools.description: Deletes a permission from a file by permission id. use when you need to revoke access for a specific user or group from a file.

tools.name: Delete Reply
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific reply by reply id. use when you need to remove a reply from a comment on a file.

tools.name: Download a file from Google Drive
tools.description: Downloads a file from google drive by its id. for google workspace documents (docs, sheets, slides), optionally exports to a specified `mime type`. for other file types, downloads in their native format regardless of mime type.

tools.name: Edit File
tools.description: Updates an existing google drive file by overwriting its entire content with new text (max 10mb).

tools.name: Empty Trash
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete all of the user's trashed files. use when you want to empty the trash in google drive.

tools.name: Modify File Labels
tools.description: Modifies the set of labels applied to a file. returns a list of the labels that were added or modified. use when you need to programmatically change labels on a google drive file, such as adding, updating, or removing them.

tools.name: Find file
tools.description: Tool to list or search for files and folders in google drive. use when you need to find specific files based on query criteria or list contents of a drive/folder.

tools.name: Find folder
tools.description: Tool to find a folder in google drive by its name and optionally a parent folder. use when you need to locate a specific folder to perform further actions like creating files in it or listing its contents.

tools.name: Generate File IDs
tools.description: Generates a set of file ids which can be provided in create or copy requests. use when you need to pre-allocate ids for new files or copies.

tools.name: Get about
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the user, the user's drive, and system capabilities. use when you need to check storage quotas, user details, or supported import/export formats.

tools.name: Get Changes Start Page Token
tools.description: Tool to get the starting pagetoken for listing future changes in google drive. use this when you need to track changes to files and folders.

tools.name: Get Comment
tools.description: Tool to get a comment by id. use when you need to retrieve a specific comment from a google drive file and have both the file id and comment id.

tools.name: Get Shared Drive
tools.description: Tool to get a shared drive by id. use when you need to retrieve information about a specific shared drive.

tools.name: Get File Metadata
tools.description: Tool to get a file's metadata by id. use when you need to retrieve the metadata for a specific file in google drive.

tools.name: Get Permission
tools.description: Gets a permission by id. use this tool to retrieve a specific permission for a file or shared drive.

tools.name: Get Reply
tools.description: Tool to get a specific reply to a comment on a file. use when you need to retrieve the details of a particular reply.

tools.name: Get Revision
tools.description: Tool to get a specific revision's metadata by revision id. use when you need to retrieve information about a particular version of a file.

tools.name: Delete folder or file
tools.description: Tool to delete a file or folder in google drive. use when you need to permanently remove a specific file or folder using its id. note: this action is irreversible.

tools.name: Hide Shared Drive
tools.description: Tool to hide a shared drive from the default view. use when you want to remove a shared drive from the user's main google drive interface without deleting it.

tools.name: List Changes
tools.description: Tool to list the changes for a user or shared drive. use when you need to track modifications to files and folders, such as creations, deletions, or permission changes. this action requires a `pagetoken` which can be initially obtained using the `get changes start page token` action or from a previous `list changes` response.

tools.name: List Comments
tools.description: Tool to list all comments for a file in google drive. use when you need to retrieve comments associated with a specific file.

tools.name: List File Labels
tools.description: Tool to list the labels on a file. use when you need to retrieve all labels associated with a specific file in google drive.

tools.name: List Files and Folders
tools.description: Tool to list a user's files and folders in google drive. use this to search or browse for files and folders based on various criteria.

tools.name: List Permissions
tools.description: Tool to list a file's permissions. use when you need to retrieve all permissions associated with a specific file or shared drive.

tools.name: List Replies to Comment
tools.description: Tool to list replies to a comment in google drive. use this when you need to retrieve all replies associated with a specific comment on a file.

tools.name: List File Revisions
tools.description: Tool to list a file's revisions. use when you need to retrieve the revision history of a specific file in google drive.

tools.name: List Shared Drives
tools.description: Tool to list the user's shared drives. use when you need to get a list of all shared drives accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Move File
tools.description: Tool to move a file from one folder to another in google drive. use when you need to reorganize files by changing their parent folder(s).

tools.name: Export or download a file
tools.description: Deprecated: exports google workspace files (max 10mb) to a specified format using `mime type`, or downloads other file types; use `googledrive download file` instead.

tools.name: Stop Watch Channel
tools.description: Tool to stop watching resources through a specified channel. use this when you want to stop receiving notifications for a previously established watch.

tools.name: Unhide Shared Drive
tools.description: Tool to unhide a shared drive. use when you need to restore a shared drive to the default view.

tools.name: Untrash File
tools.description: Tool to restore a file from the trash. use when you need to recover a deleted file. this action updates the file's metadata to set the 'trashed' property to false.

tools.name: Update Comment
tools.description: Tool to update an existing comment on a google drive file. use when you need to change the content or status (e.g., resolve) of a comment.

tools.name: Update Shared Drive
tools.description: Tool to update the metadata for a shared drive. use when you need to modify properties like the name, theme, background image, or restrictions of a shared drive.

tools.name: Update File (Metadata)
tools.description: Updates file metadata. uses patch semantics (partial update) as per google drive api v3. use this tool to modify attributes of an existing file like its name, description, or parent folders. note: this action currently supports metadata updates only. file content updates require multipart/related upload and are not yet implemented.

tools.name: Update File Revision Metadata
tools.description: Updates metadata of a file revision (e.g., keepforever, publish). use this tool to modify the metadata of a specific revision of a file in google drive.

tools.name: Update Permission
tools.description: Tool to update a permission with patch semantics. use when you need to modify an existing permission for a file or shared drive.

tools.name: Update Reply
tools.description: Tool to update a reply to a comment on a google drive file. use when you need to modify the content of an existing reply.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Uploads a file (max 5mb) to google drive, moving it to a specified folder if a valid folder id is provided, otherwise uploads to root.

tools.name: Watch Drive Changes
tools.description: Tool to subscribe to changes for a user or shared drive in google drive. use when you need to monitor a google drive for modifications and receive notifications at a specified webhook url.

triggers.name: Comment Added (Docs/Sheets/Slides)
triggers.description: Triggers when a new comment is added to Google Docs, Sheets, or Slides.

triggers.name: File Created
triggers.description:
Triggers when a new file is created/added in Google Drive.
    This trigger monitors files and fires when new files are detected.

triggers.name: File Deleted or Trashed
triggers.description: Triggers when a file is moved to trash or permanently deleted in Google Drive.

triggers.name: File Shared (Permissions Added)
triggers.description:
Triggers when new sharing permissions are granted to a file or folder in Google Drive.

    This trigger monitors the Drive Changes API to detect files that changed and, for those files,
    compares their current permissions against previously seen permissions to identify newly
    added sharing entries.

triggers.name: File Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a file's metadata or content changes in Google Drive.
    Emits file ID, modification timestamp, and editor info.

triggers.name: Google Drive Changes
triggers.description: Triggers when changes are detected in a Google Drive.

triggers.name: New File Matching Query
triggers.description: Triggers when a new Google Drive file matches a provided query.

name: Google Docs
description: Google Docs is a cloud-based word processor with real-time collaboration, version history, and integration with other Google Workspace apps

tools.name: Copy Google Document
tools.description: Tool to create a copy of an existing google document. use this to duplicate a document, for example, when using an existing document as a template. the copied document will have a default title (e.g., 'copy of [original title]') if no new title is provided, and will be placed in the user's root google drive folder.

tools.name: Create a document
tools.description: Creates a new google docs document using the provided title as filename and inserts the initial text at the beginning if non-empty, returning the document's id and metadata (excluding body content).

tools.name: Create Document Markdown
tools.description: Creates a new google docs document, optionally initializing it with a title and content provided as markdown text.

tools.name: Create Footer
tools.description: Tool to create a new footer in a google document. use when you need to add a footer, optionally specifying its type and the section it applies to.

tools.name: Create Footnote
tools.description: Tool to create a new footnote in a google document. use this when you need to add a footnote at a specific location or at the end of the document body.

tools.name: Create Header
tools.description: Tool to create a new header in a google document. use this tool when you need to add a header to a document, optionally specifying the section it applies to.

tools.name: Create Named Range
tools.description: Tool to create a new named range in a google document. use this to assign a name to a specific part of the document for easier reference or programmatic manipulation.

tools.name: Create Paragraph Bullets
tools.description: Tool to add bullets to paragraphs within a specified range in a google document. use when you need to format a list or a set of paragraphs as bullet points.

tools.name: Delete Content Range in Document
tools.description: Tool to delete a range of content from a google document. use when you need to remove a specific portion of text or other structural elements within a document.

tools.name: Delete Footer
tools.description: Tool to delete a footer from a google document. use when you need to remove a footer from a specific section or the default footer.

tools.name: Delete Header
tools.description: Deletes the header from the specified section or the default header if no section is specified. use this tool to remove a header from a google document.

tools.name: Delete Named Range
tools.description: Tool to delete a named range from a google document. use when you need to remove a previously defined named range by its id or name.

tools.name: Delete Paragraph Bullets
tools.description: Tool to remove bullets from paragraphs within a specified range in a google document. use when you need to clear bullet formatting from a section of a document.

tools.name: Delete Table
tools.description: Tool to delete an entire table from a google document. use when you have the document id and the specific start and end index of the table element to be removed. the table's range can be found by inspecting the document's content structure.

tools.name: Delete Table Column
tools.description: Tool to delete a column from a table in a google document. use this tool when you need to remove a specific column from an existing table within a document.

tools.name: Delete Table Row
tools.description: Tool to delete a row from a table in a google document. use when you need to remove a specific row from an existing table.

tools.name: Get Charts from Spreadsheet
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all charts from a specified google sheets spreadsheet. use when you need to get chart ids and their specifications for embedding or referencing elsewhere, such as in google docs.

tools.name: Get document by id
tools.description: Retrieves an existing google document by its id; will error if the document is not found.

tools.name: Insert Inline Image
tools.description: Tool to insert an image from a given uri at a specified location in a google document as an inline image. use when you need to add an image to a document programmatically.

tools.name: Insert Page Break
tools.description: Tool to insert a page break into a google document. use when you need to start new content on a fresh page, such as at the end of a chapter or section.

tools.name: Insert Table in Google Doc
tools.description: Tool to insert a table into a google document. use when you need to add a new table at a specific location or at the end of a segment (like document body, header, or footer) in a document.

tools.name: Insert Table Column
tools.description: Tool to insert a new column into a table in a google document. use this tool when you need to add a column to an existing table at a specific location.

tools.name: Insert Text into Document
tools.description: Tool to insert a string of text at a specified location within a google document. use when you need to add new text content to an existing document.

tools.name: List Charts from Spreadsheet
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of charts with their ids and metadata from a google sheets spreadsheet. use to identify charts available for embedding into google docs.

tools.name: Replace All Text in Document
tools.description: Tool to replace all occurrences of a specified text string with another text string throughout a google document. use when you need to perform a global find and replace operation within a document.

tools.name: Replace Image in Document
tools.description: Tool to replace a specific image in a document with a new image from a uri. use when you need to update an existing image within a google doc.

tools.name: Search Documents
tools.description: Search for google documents using various filters including name, content, date ranges, and more.

tools.name: Unmerge Table Cells
tools.description: Tool to unmerge previously merged cells in a table. use this when you need to revert merged cells in a google document table back to their individual cell states.

tools.name: Update Document Markdown
tools.description: Replaces the entire content of an existing google docs document with new markdown text; requires edit permissions for the document.

tools.name: Update Document Style
tools.description: Tool to update the overall document style, such as page size, margins, and default text direction. use when you need to modify the global style settings of a google document.

tools.name: Update existing document
tools.description: Applies programmatic edits, such as text insertion, deletion, or formatting, to a specified google doc using the `batchupdate` api method.

tools.name: Update Table Row Style
tools.description: Tool to update the style of a table row in a google document. use when you need to modify the appearance of specific rows within a table, such as setting minimum row height or marking rows as headers.

triggers.name: Document Deleted
triggers.description:
Triggers when an existing Google Doc is deleted (moved to trash).
    This trigger monitors Google Docs and fires when documents are trashed.

triggers.name: Document Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when an existing Google Doc is updated or modified.
    This trigger monitors Google Docs and fires when documents are updated.

triggers.name: New Folder Created in Root
triggers.description:
Triggers when a new folder is created in the root folder of Google Drive.
    This trigger monitors Google Drive and fires when new folders are detected in the root directory.

triggers.name: New Document Added
triggers.description:
Triggers when a new Google Doc is added/created.
    This trigger monitors Google Docs and fires when new documents are detected.

name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is an inbound marketing, sales, and customer service platform integrating CRM, email automation, and analytics to facilitate lead nurturing and seamless customer experiences

tools.name: Add asset association
tools.description: Associates an existing asset ('form', 'object list', or 'external web url') with a specified hubspot marketing campaign.

tools.name: Add token to event template
tools.description: Adds a new custom data token to an existing event template for a specified hubspot application, optionally populating a crm object property if objectpropertyname is provided.

tools.name: Archive email
tools.description: Archives the hubspot email specified by `emailid` by moving it to the recycling bin, making it inaccessible unless restored.

tools.name: Archive a batch of emails by ID
tools.description: Archives multiple hubspot crm emails by id; ids must exist as archiving is irreversible.

tools.name: Archive a batch of quotes by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing, non-archived quotes by their ids; this action is irreversible and useful for managing outdated or irrelevant quotes.

tools.name: Archive batch of companies by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of companies by their unique ids; targeted companies must exist, not be previously archived, and this api operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Archive batch of contacts by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing contacts by their hubspot crm ids, rendering them inactive; this action is irreversible via the api and requires manual restoration or a separate unarchive endpoint.

tools.name: Archive batch of deals by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing deals by their unique hubspot ids, removing them from active views and reports (soft delete); archived deals may be restorable.

tools.name: Archive batch of feedback submissions by id
tools.description: Asynchronously archives a batch of hubspot feedback submissions using their unique ids, which must correspond to valid and existing submissions; the operation is queued, and submissions are moved from active views without being deleted.

tools.name: Archive batch of line items by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing line items by their unique ids in hubspot crm; this operation is irreversible via the api.

tools.name: Archive batch of objects by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing, non-archived crm objects of a specified `objecttype` by their ids, effectively hiding them from active use.

tools.name: Archive batch of properties
tools.description: Archives a batch of properties by their internal names for a specified hubspot crm object type; this operation is idempotent and safe to retry.

tools.name: Archive batch of tickets by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing, unarchived hubspot crm tickets by their unique ids.

tools.name: Archive batch products by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing, unarchived hubspot products by their ids; this action is irreversible via the api.

tools.name: Archive company
tools.description: Archives an existing company in hubspot crm by its `companyid`, moving it to a recycling bin from which it can be restored, rather than permanently deleting it.

tools.name: Archive contact by id
tools.description: Archives a contact in hubspot crm by its id, moving it to the recycling bin; this is generally irreversible via api and removes the contact from active use.

tools.name: Archive a CRM object by ID
tools.description: Archives a specific hubspot crm object by its type and id, moving it to the recycling bin; this action is irreversible via the api but objects can often be restored via the hubspot ui.

tools.name: Archive emails
tools.description: Archives multiple hubspot emails by their ids.

tools.name: Archive feedback submission
tools.description: Archives an existing, non-archived feedback submission in hubspot crm by its id, moving it to the recycling bin (not permanently deleting it).

tools.name: Archive line item by id
tools.description: Archives a specific hubspot line item by its id, moving it to a recoverable state.

tools.name: Archive product
tools.description: Archives a hubspot product by its id.

tools.name: Archive product by product ID
tools.description: Archives an existing product in hubspot crm by its `productid`, moving it to an archived state (irreversible via api) to remove it from active use while retaining its data.

tools.name: Archive products
tools.description: Archives multiple hubspot products by their ids.

tools.name: Archive property by object type and name
tools.description: Archives a specified crm property by its object type and name, moving it to the recycling bin; note that some default hubspot properties cannot be archived.

tools.name: Archive property group
tools.description: Archives a hubspot property group, making it inactive and hidden (not permanently deleted, allowing potential restoration) with immediate effect on its crm visibility and usability.

tools.name: Archive quote object by id
tools.description: Archives a hubspot quote object by id to the recycling bin; this is api-irreversible and may need manual restoration.

tools.name: Archive ticket
tools.description: Archives a hubspot ticket by its id.

tools.name: Archive ticket by id
tools.description: Archives an existing hubspot ticket by its id, moving it to the recycling bin; this is a permanent operation not undoable via the api.

tools.name: Archive tickets
tools.description: Archives multiple hubspot tickets by their ids.

tools.name: Audit pipeline changes by id
tools.description: Retrieves a reverse chronological audit log of all changes for a specific, existing hubspot crm pipeline, which is identified by its `pipelineid` and a valid `objecttype` that supports pipelines (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets').

tools.name: Batch read companies by properties
tools.description: Batch-retrieves hubspot company records by their ids, allowing custom id properties, specific properties to fetch, and historical data.

tools.name: Read Batch Emails
tools.description: Retrieves a batch of hubspot email objects by their internal ids or values of a specified unique property, allowing targeted property selection, including historical data.

tools.name: Batch update quotes
tools.description: Updates multiple existing hubspot quotes in a batch; each quote is identified by its object id or a custom unique property (via `idproperty`), and only writable properties are modified.

tools.name: Campaign search
tools.description: Searches for and retrieves a paginated list of hubspot marketing campaigns.

tools.name: Cancel active import
tools.description: Cancels an active hubspot data import job using its `importid`; this action is irreversible, and any data already processed will remain.

tools.name: Clone marketing email
tools.description: Duplicates an existing hubspot marketing email, identified by its `id`, into a new draft; an optional `clonename` can be assigned to this new email copy.

tools.name: Configure calling extension settings
tools.description: Configures or updates settings for a hubspot app's calling extension, including its name, ui url, iframe dimensions, `isready` status, and `supportscustomobjects` flag, for the specified `appid`.

tools.name: Create email
tools.description: Creates a new email engagement record in hubspot, requiring portal-specific `properties` (e.g., `hs timestamp` as a utc millisecond timestamp), and that association `to id`s and `associationtypeid`s are valid and existing.

tools.name: Create a batch of campaigns
tools.description: Creates up to 50 marketing campaigns in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create a batch of companies
tools.description: Creates multiple company records in hubspot crm in a single batch operation, processing up to 100 companies per request.

tools.name: Create batch of contacts
tools.description: Deprecated: use the `create batch of contacts` action instead. creates multiple hubspot contact records.

tools.name: Create a batch of emails
tools.description: Creates multiple email objects for record-keeping (does not send emails) within hubspot crm in a single batch, allowing properties and associations to other crm objects to be set for each email.

tools.name: Create A/B test variation
tools.description: Creates a new a/b test variation for an existing hubspot email, using its `contentid`; this action only creates the variation, it does not start the a/b test or send emails.

tools.name: Create a campaign
tools.description: Creates a new marketing campaign in hubspot with the specified properties, returning the created campaign data including its `campaignguid`.

tools.name: Create a new property group
tools.description: Creates a new, empty property group for a specified crm object type in hubspot, requiring a unique group name for that object type; properties must be added separately.

tools.name: Create a new marketing email
tools.description: Creates a new marketing email in hubspot, allowing comprehensive configuration of content, recipients, sender details, a/b testing, scheduling, web version, and other settings; the internal `name` for the email is required.

tools.name: Create association for object type
tools.description: Creates the *definition* (schema) of a new association in hubspot, specifying how two crm object types relate (not an actual link between records); any provided `name` must be unique for the `fromobjecttypeid` and `toobjecttypeid` pair.

tools.name: Create batch of contacts
tools.description: Creates up to 100 new contact records in hubspot crm, optionally associating them with existing crm objects; ensure associated object ids are valid.

tools.name: Create batch of deals
tools.description: Creates multiple deals in hubspot crm; ensure any associated object ids, deal stages, and pipeline ids specified are valid and exist within the hubspot account.

tools.name: Create batch of feedback submissions
tools.description: Creates a batch of feedback submissions in hubspot, ideal for bulk imports; all property names, `associationtypeid`s, and association `to id`s must reference existing entities in hubspot.

tools.name: Create batch of line items
tools.description: Creates multiple hubspot line items in a batch, each with specified properties and associations to other existing crm objects.

tools.name: Create batch of objects
tools.description: Creates multiple crm objects of a specified `objecttype` (e.g., contacts, companies, deals) in a single batch operation, where each object can have its own set of properties and associations.

tools.name: Create batch of properties
tools.description: Efficiently creates multiple crm properties in a single batch for a specified hubspot object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', custom object id), ideal for schema setup or updates.

tools.name: Create batch of quotes
tools.description: Creates multiple hubspot crm quotes in a batch, ideal for bulk operations; provide meaningful quote details in `inputs` as property requirements can vary, and inspect response for individual quote statuses as partial success is possible.

tools.name: Create batch of tickets
tools.description: Creates multiple hubspot tickets in a batch, each with its own properties and associations; `inputs` list must not be empty, each item needs `properties`, and associations/custom properties must be validly defined using internal names for custom fields and iso 8601 for dates.

tools.name: Create campaign
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot campaign.

tools.name: Create campaigns
tools.description: Creates multiple hubspot campaigns in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create company
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot company.

tools.name: Create company object
tools.description: Creates a new company object in hubspot crm with specified properties and associations, returning the new company object.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot contact.

tools.name: Create contact object with properties
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot contact with specified properties and optional associations; requires at least one identifiable property (e.g., email) and valid `to  id` for any associations.

tools.name: Create CRM object with properties
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot crm object (e.g., contact, company, custom object) with specified `properties` (using valid internal names) and `associations` (to existing objects via valid type ids).

tools.name: Create deal
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot deal.

tools.name: Create email
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot email.

tools.name: Create emails
tools.description: Creates multiple hubspot emails in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create event template for app
tools.description: Creates a new event template for a hubspot app, defining structure, custom properties (tokens), and appearance (markdown with handlebars) of custom timeline events for crm objects; this template must exist before logging corresponding events.

tools.name: Create feedback submission
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot feedback submission to record customer feedback (e.g., survey responses, support interactions), optionally associating it with crm objects.

tools.name: Create line item
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot line item.

tools.name: Create line item object
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot line item, where `properties` must contain all keys required by the specific hubspot instance, `associations` items must link to existing crm objects via `to id`, and an empty `associations` list is permissible if the api supports unassociated line items.

tools.name: Create line items
tools.description: Creates multiple hubspot line items in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create multiple timeline events batch
tools.description: Creates multiple immutable timeline events in a batch, ideal for bulk data imports or real-time synchronizations, using a valid event template; may update crm properties if the template is so configured.

tools.name: Create new deal object
tools.description: Creates a new deal in hubspot crm with specified properties and associations; ensure `pipeline`, `dealstage`, and any `associations.to id` are valid existing ids, and providing `dealname` is highly recommended.

tools.name: Create new object schema with custom properties
tools.description: Creates a new custom object schema in hubspot crm with unique naming for schema and properties, defined display/required/searchable properties within the 'properties' list, provided immutable labels, and correctly configured 'enumeration' type properties (options/referencedobjecttype).

tools.name: Create or update draft version
tools.description: Creates or updates the draft version of a marketing email identified by `emailid`; if no draft exists, a new one is created from the current live version to prepare changes or a/b tests before publishing.

tools.name: Create pipeline for object type
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot pipeline for a specified crm `objecttype` (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets'), requiring the pipeline `label` be unique for that `objecttype` and each stage `label` be unique within the pipeline.

tools.name: Create pipeline stage
tools.description: Creates a new stage in a specified hubspot crm pipeline for a given object type, such as 'deals' or 'tickets'.

tools.name: Create product
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot product.

tools.name: Create product batch
tools.description: Creates multiple products in hubspot crm in a batch, allowing unique properties and associations per product; ensure `associationcategory` and `associationtypeid` are valid, and `to  id` refers to an existing crm object id when specifying associations.

tools.name: Create product object
tools.description: Creates a new product in hubspot with specified properties and optional associations; ensure `hs sku` is unique if provided, custom properties are pre-defined in hubspot, and any association `to id` and `associationtypeid` are valid.

tools.name: Create products
tools.description: Creates multiple hubspot products in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Create property for specified object type
tools.description: Creates a new custom property for a specified hubspot crm object type; ensure `groupname` refers to an existing property group for the `objecttype`.

tools.name: Create quote object
tools.description: Creates a new quote object in hubspot crm with specified properties and associations.

tools.name: Create ticket
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot ticket.

tools.name: Create ticket object
tools.description: Creates a new ticket in hubspot with specified properties and associations; ensure custom property names, associated object ids (`to`), pipeline ids (`hs pipeline`), and stage ids (`hs pipeline stage`) are valid in your hubspot instance.

tools.name: Create tickets
tools.description: Creates multiple hubspot tickets in a batch, each with its own properties and associations; `inputs` list must not be empty, each item needs `properties`, and associations/custom properties must be validly defined using internal names for custom fields and iso 8601 for dates.

tools.name: Create timeline event based on template
tools.description: Creates an immutable custom timeline event on a crm object's record using a specified, existing event template (identified by `eventtemplateid`), optionally updating crm object properties if defined in the template; requires `email`, `utk`, or `objectid` for association.

tools.name: Create workflow
tools.description: Creates a new hubspot workflow to automate processes; ensure `enrollmentcriteria` and `actions` use properties relevant to the specified `objecttypeid`.

tools.description: Deletes an existing marketing email, either permanently (default) or by archiving if `archived` is `true`.

tools.name: Delete calling extension settings
tools.description: Permanently deletes the settings for a calling extension app, specified by its `appid`, rendering it unusable for all connected hubspot accounts; this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete campaign
tools.description: Permanently deletes a marketing campaign from hubspot using its `campaignguid`; returns a 204 no content status even if the campaign does not exist.

tools.name: Delete contact for gdpr compliance
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes a hubspot contact for gdpr compliance (identified via `objectid` and `idproperty`); an email `objectid` for a non-existent contact may be blocklisted.

tools.name: Delete pipeline by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a hubspot pipeline and all its stages by `pipelineid` and `objecttype`; this is irreversible, so use validation flags to avoid errors if the pipeline is not empty.

tools.name: Delete pipeline stage by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific pipeline stage for an `objecttype` (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets') that supports pipelines; this operation is irreversible, so ensure no active crm records are associated with the stage to prevent data issues.

tools.name: Delete schema by object type
tools.description: Permanently deletes a hubspot custom object schema, specified by its `objecttype`, after all associated crm records have been deleted.

tools.name: Delete timeline event template
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specific timeline event template, identified by its `eventtemplateid`, from the application `appid`.

tools.name: Delete video conferencing app settings
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes all settings for a video conferencing application identified by its `appid` in hubspot, removing its configuration and preventing it from functioning until reconfigured; existing meetings and historical data are unaffected.

tools.name: Delete workflow
tools.description: Permanently deletes a hubspot workflow by its id; deleted workflows cannot be restored via the api and the id must exist.

tools.name: Read crm contact by id
tools.description: Deprecated: use `read crm contact by id` instead. retrieves a hubspot crm contact by its unique internal hubspot id, allowing selection of properties, historical values, associated objects, and filtering for archived contacts.

tools.name: Fetch contact ids
tools.description: Fetches hubspot contact ids for a specified `campaignguid` (must be a valid uuid of an existing campaign) and `contacttype`, supporting date filtering and pagination.

tools.name: Fetch import error details
tools.description: Fetches a paginated list of read-only error details for a specific hubspot crm import, requiring a valid `importid` for a processed import.

tools.name: Retrieve line item by id

tools.name: Fetch recording settings by app ID
tools.description: Fetches call recording settings for a specified, existing hubspot calling extension app.

tools.description: Fetches a revenue attribution report for a specified, existing marketing campaign, optionally using a specific attribution model and date range; if both start and end dates are given, `enddate` must not be earlier than `startdate`.

tools.name: GDPR delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes a contact and associated content for gdpr compliance; an email used for identification via `idproperty`='email' that is not found will be irreversibly blocklisted.

tools.name: Get active imports list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of currently active import jobs in hubspot for monitoring ongoing data operations.

tools.name: Get aggregated statistic intervals
tools.description: Retrieves aggregated statistics for marketing emails (e.g., send counts), grouped by specified time intervals within a defined time range.

tools.description: Retrieves aggregated statistics for marketing emails, optionally within an iso8601 formatted time range, by email ids, or specific email properties.

tools.description: Fetches a list of marketing emails from a hubspot account, with options for filtering, sorting, pagination, and including performance statistics.

tools.name: Retrieve page of crm owners
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of crm owners from hubspot, optionally filtering by email or archived status. <<deprecated: use 'retrieve page of crm owners' instead.>>

tools.name: Get a revision of a marketing email
tools.description: Retrieves a specific, previously saved revision of a marketing email using its unique email id and revision id.

tools.name: Get campaign metrics
tools.description: Retrieves key attribution metrics for an existing marketing campaign, identified by its `campaignguid`, within an optional date range.

tools.name: Get Marketing Emails
tools.description: Fetches a list of marketing emails from hubspot, supporting filtering by creation/update timestamps, pagination, and sorting.

tools.name: Get revisions of a marketing email
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all historical versions (including full state like content, settings, metadata) for a specified, existing marketing email; revision id -1 identifies the current version.

tools.name: Get specific event template for app
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific event template for a given application in hubspot's crm timeline.

tools.name: Get the details of a specified marketing email
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific marketing email in hubspot using its unique email id, optionally including performance statistics and specific properties.

tools.name: Get the variation of an A/B marketing email

tools.name: List association types
