tools.name: Merge two companies of same type
tools.description: Merges two existing company records of the same type in hubspot crm, where `objectidtomerge` is absorbed into `primaryobjectid`; this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Merge two contacts of same type
tools.description: Merges a hubspot contact (`objectidtomerge`) into another contact (`primaryobjectid`), deleting the former and making `primaryobjectid` absorb its data; this irreversible action is used for deduplicating contacts of the same type.

tools.name: Merge two deals of same type
tools.description: Permanently merges two hubspot crm deals of the same type, typically to eliminate duplicates or consolidate related sales opportunities.

tools.name: Merge two emails with same type
tools.description: Merges two existing, same-type hubspot crm emails: `objectidtomerge` is absorbed into `primaryobjectid` and then deleted; use for de-duplication, this action is irreversible.

tools.name: Merge two feedback submissions
tools.description: Merges two existing feedback submissions by id, primarily for consolidating duplicates or related feedback; this operation is irreversible, and `primaryobjectid` values take precedence in conflicts.

tools.name: Merge two line items of same type
tools.description: Merges two line items, `objectidtomerge` into `primaryobjectid`, which must be of the same type; `objectidtomerge` is absorbed and the operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Merge two objects of same type
tools.description: Merges two distinct hubspot crm objects of the same `objecttype`, consolidating data into `primaryobjectid` (which is preserved) and deleting `objectidtomerge`; this operation is permanent and irreversible.

tools.name: Merge two products of the same type
tools.description: To de-duplicate or combine product variants, merges two existing, same-type hubspot product records by consolidating `objectidtomerge` into `primaryobjectid`; `objectidtomerge` is archived/deleted, and the operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Merge two quotes of same type
tools.description: Merges two distinct quotes of the same type by consolidating `objectidtomerge` into `primaryobjectid` (e.g., for combining information or updating terms); this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Merge two tickets of same type
tools.description: Merges two existing hubspot tickets of the same type, where `objectidtomerge` (which is then deactivated) is absorbed into `primaryobjectid`.

tools.name: Modify calling extension settings
tools.description: Updates settings (e.g., display name, ui url/dimensions, feature flags) for an existing calling extension app, identified by `appid`.

tools.name: Partially update contact
tools.description: Partially updates specified properties for an existing hubspot contact, identified by its valid `contactid`.

tools.name: Partially update CRM object by ID
tools.description: Partially updates specified properties of a crm object (e.g., contact, company, deal) identified by its type and id, or optionally by a unique property value if `idproperty` is specified.

tools.name: Partially update deal by id
tools.description: Partially updates specified properties of an existing hubspot crm deal, identified by its `dealid` or an optional custom unique `idproperty`.

tools.name: Partially update pipeline by id
tools.description: Partially updates a crm pipeline's label, display order, or restores an archived pipeline by setting `archived` to `false`.

tools.name: Partially update property group
tools.description: Partially updates a property group's `displayorder` or `label` for a specified crm `objecttype` in hubspot.

tools.name: Partially update ticket by id
tools.description: Modifies specified properties of an existing hubspot ticket, identified by `ticketid` or a custom `idproperty`; to clear a property, provide an empty string as its value.

tools.name: Partially update company object by id
tools.description: Partially updates specified `properties` of an existing hubspot company, identified by its `companyid` (optionally using `idproperty` as the unique key), ensuring property names are valid hubspot internal names.

tools.name: Partial update quote by quote id
tools.description: Performs a partial update on an existing hubspot quote's specified properties, identifying the quote by `quoteid` (either its internal id or a custom unique property value if `idproperty` is provided).

tools.name: Permanently delete company for GDPR compliance
tools.description: Permanently deletes a company (identified by objectid) and its associated data from hubspot for gdpr compliance; this action is irreversible and requires the company to exist.

tools.name: Permanently delete contact for GDPR
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes a hubspot contact for gdpr; if deleting by a non-existent email (using idproperty 'email'), the email is blocklisted instead.

tools.name: Permanently delete contact for GDPR compliance
tools.description: Irreversibly erases a hubspot contact and associated data per a gdpr request; if an email is given for a non-existent contact, it's blocklisted.

tools.name: Permanently delete quote for GDPR compliance
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a hubspot **quote** (not a contact, despite the action's internal naming) to comply with gdpr's 'right to be forgotten'.

tools.name: Permanently delete contact via GDPR
tools.description: Permanently deletes a hubspot contact and all its associated data for gdpr compliance, identifying the contact by its id or another unique property.

tools.name: Permanently delete deal for GDPR compliance
tools.description: Permanently deletes a hubspot deal for gdpr compliance, identified by its unique id or a specified property value; this action is irreversible and may blocklist the identifier if the deal isn't found when using `idproperty`.

tools.name: Permanently delete GDPR contact and content
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes an existing hubspot contact and associated content for gdpr compliance, optionally blocklisting the contact's email.

tools.name: Permanently delete line items for gdpr
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specified line item and its associated content for gdpr compliance; this action is irreversible and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Publish or send a marketing email
tools.description: Publishes or sends a specified hubspot marketing email that is valid and ready for sending; requires marketing hub enterprise or the transactional email add-on.

tools.name: Purge schema by object type
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes the schema for an existing `objecttype` in hubspot crm; this deprecated endpoint should be used with extreme caution.

tools.name: Read Email
tools.description: Call this to retrieve an existing hubspot email by its `emailid` or an alternative unique `idproperty`.

tools.name: Read a batch of campaigns
tools.description: Retrieves details for a batch of up to 50 marketing campaigns by their ids, optionally including specified properties and asset metrics for a given date range; response order is not guaranteed and duplicate ids are ignored.

tools.name: Read a batch of CRM object properties
tools.description: Reads definitions (metadata, not values) for a batch of crm object properties for a specified `objecttype`, supporting partial success.

tools.name: Read a campaign
tools.description: Retrieves details for a marketing campaign by `campaignguid`, optionally including specified `properties` and asset metrics if both `startdate` and `enddate` are provided.

tools.name: Read a CRM property by name
tools.description: Reads a specific crm property definition for a given hubspot object type by its internal name.

tools.name: Read all properties for object type
tools.description: Deprecated: use `read all properties for object type` instead. retrieves property definitions for a specified hubspot crm object type.

tools.name: Read all properties for object type
tools.description: Retrieves definitions and metadata (not actual values) for properties of a specified hubspot crm object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom objects).

tools.name: Read property groups for object type
tools.description: Retrieves all property groups for a specified hubspot crm object type. <<DEPRECATED use read_property_groups_for_object_type>>

tools.name: Read an owner by given ID or user ID
tools.description: **deprecated:** please use the `retrieve owner by id or user id` action instead. retrieves a specific hubspot crm owner by their id, with options to specify id type (owner or user) and to include archived records.

tools.name: Read a page of deals
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of hubspot crm deals; use the 'after' token from a previous response's 'paging.next.after' for subsequent pages.

tools.name: Read a page of objects by type
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of objects for a specified and valid hubspot crm object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom id).

tools.name: Read a CRM property by name
tools.description: Deprecated: use `read a crm property by name` to read a specific crm property definition for a given hubspot object type by its internal name.

tools.name: Read a property group
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific property group of a given crm object type, detailing its structure and attributes, but not the actual property values of crm objects.

tools.name: Read batch feedback submissions by id or property
tools.description: Retrieves up to 100 feedback submissions in a batch using their ids or a specified unique `idproperty`, optionally including specified properties and their history.

tools.name: Read batch of contacts by id or properties
tools.description: Reads a batch of hubspot contacts by their ids or a specified unique `idproperty`, optionally including property history and filtering by archived status; ensure `inputs` refer to existing contacts and `idproperty` (if used) is a unique identifier.

tools.name: Read batch of crm objects by id or property values
tools.description: Reads a batch of crm objects of a specified `objecttype` using their hubspot ids or unique property values from the `inputs` list, allowing retrieval of specific `properties`, their historical values (`propertieswithhistory`), and filtering by `archived` status.

tools.name: Read batch of line items by id or property values
tools.description: Retrieves a batch of hubspot crm line items by their ids, or optionally by values of a custom unique property defined in `idproperty`.

tools.name: Read batch of products by id or property
tools.description: Retrieves a batch of hubspot crm products by their ids or a specified unique `idproperty`, optionally filtering by archived status and including historical changes for specified properties.

tools.name: Read batch of quotes by property values
tools.description: Efficiently retrieves a batch of hubspot crm quotes by their ids (or a specified unique property), optionally including archived quotes, specific properties, and property history.

tools.name: Read a batch of tickets by id or unique values
tools.description: Retrieves a batch of hubspot crm tickets using a list of their ids, or optionally via a custom unique property specified in `idproperty`, allowing for selection of specific properties, their history, and filtering by archival status.

tools.name: Read budget
tools.description: Fetches detailed budget (total, spent, remaining) and spend information for a marketing campaign, including an 'order' field for sequencing budget/spend items (0 is oldest).

tools.name: Read crm contact by id
tools.description: Retrieves a hubspot crm contact by its unique internal hubspot id, allowing selection of properties, historical values, associated objects, and filtering for archived contacts.

tools.name: Read crm object by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific crm object (e.g., contact, company, deal, ticket) by its id or a unique property, optionally including specific properties, history, and associations.

tools.name: Read feedback submission by id
tools.description: Reads a hubspot feedback submission by its id, optionally using a custom unique 'idproperty', and allows specifying properties to return including history and associations.

tools.name: Read product by id
tools.description: Retrieves a hubspot product by its id, allowing customization of returned properties, history, and associations; `idproperty` can specify an alternative unique identifier property which must be configured as unique in hubspot.

tools.name: Read property groups for object type
tools.description: Retrieves all property groups in a single call for a specified hubspot crm object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies'), returning only the groups themselves, not the individual properties within them.

tools.name: Archive contact by id
tools.description: Deprecated: use the `archive contact by id` action to archive a hubspot crm contact by its id.

tools.name: Remove asset association
tools.description: Disassociates an asset (form, object list, or external web url) from a hubspot campaign.

tools.name: Remove association from schema
tools.description: Permanently removes a specified association definition (type) from a hubspot object's schema, preventing future creations of this association type without affecting existing instances.

tools.name: Remove deal object by id
tools.description: Archives a hubspot deal by its `dealid`, moving it to the recycling bin when it's no longer relevant, created in error, or needs removal from active view; archived deals won't appear in active lists or reports.

tools.name: Remove token from event template
tools.description: Removes a token from a hubspot event template, preventing its inclusion in new events created from that template.

tools.name: Render event detail template
tools.description: Renders detailed information for a specific hubspot crm timeline event using a predefined event template, ignoring `extradata` references in the template not present in event data.

tools.name: Render event header or detail as html
tools.description: Renders an event's header or detail template as html for a specified event on the hubspot crm timeline, using a given event template id and event id.

tools.name: Replace all properties of pipeline
tools.description: Overwrites an entire crm pipeline (specified by `objecttype` and `pipelineid`) and all its stages with a new definition, returning the updated pipeline.

tools.name: Replace pipeline stage properties
tools.description: Replaces all properties of a specified pipeline stage; the new `label` must be unique within the pipeline, and if `objecttype` is 'deals', the `metadata` must include a 'probability' key.

tools.name: Reset draft
tools.description: Resets a marketing email's draft to its currently published (live) version, discarding all unpublished changes; the email must have a live version to revert to.

tools.name: Restore a revision of a marketing email
tools.description: Restores a specific, existing, non-active revision of a marketing email to become the new live version for that email.

tools.name: Restore a revision of a marketing email to draft state
tools.description: Restores a specific revision of a marketing email to a draft state, overwriting any existing draft.

tools.name: Retrieve all object schemas
tools.description: Retrieves all object schema definitions (not data records) for a hubspot account, supporting retrieval of either active or archived schemas.

tools.name: Retrieve all pipelines for specified object type
tools.description: Deprecated: use `retrieve all pipelines for specified object type` instead. retrieves all pipelines in hubspot for a specified crm object type like deals or tickets.

tools.name: Retrieve all pipelines for specified object type
tools.description: Retrieves all pipelines in hubspot for a specified crm object type, such as deals or tickets.

tools.name: Retrieve a batch of deals by IDs or property values
tools.description: Retrieves a batch of hubspot crm deals by their hubspot ids or values of a specified unique `idproperty`; `inputs` must contain at least one entry and `idproperty`, if used, must name a property that uniquely identifies deals.

tools.name: Retrieve calling settings for app
tools.description: Retrieves the read-only calling extension settings for a specific hubspot app; the app must exist and have calling extensions configured.

tools.name: Retrieve company object by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific hubspot company by its id (or an alternative unique property value if `idproperty` is specified), optionally including specific properties, property history, associated object ids, or archived records.

tools.name: Retrieve deal by id
tools.description: Fetches a hubspot crm deal by its id, optionally including specific properties, their history, and associations; use `idproperty` for retrieval with a custom unique property.

tools.name: Retrieve existing object schema
tools.description: Fetches the detailed schema definition for a specified, existing standard or custom hubspot crm object type; this action is read-only and does not create or modify schemas.

tools.name: Retrieve line item by id
tools.description: Retrieves a hubspot crm line item by its id or a specified unique property (`idproperty`).

tools.name: Retrieve line items list
tools.description: Fetches a paginated list of hubspot crm line items, allowing selection of specific properties (including history), associated object ids, and filtering by archive status; ensure property and association names are valid hubspot internal names.

tools.name: Retrieve owner by ID or user ID
tools.description: Retrieves a specific hubspot crm owner by their id, with options to specify id type (owner or user) and to include archived records.

tools.name: Retrieve owners
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all owners in the hubspot crm, including their id, first name, last name, email, and user id.

tools.name: Retrieve page of companies
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of companies from hubspot, using an 'after' cursor from a previous response for subsequent pages.

tools.name: Retrieve page of crm owners
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of crm owners from hubspot, optionally filtering by email or archived status.

tools.name: Retrieve pipeline stage by id
tools.description: Fetches detailed properties and metadata (e.g., label, display order, custom properties) for a specific stage within a hubspot crm pipeline, identified by its `objecttype`, `pipelineid`, and `stageid`.

tools.name: Retrieve pipeline stages
tools.description: Fetches all stages for a specified hubspot crm object type and pipeline id.

tools.name: Retrieve ticket by id
tools.description: Retrieves a hubspot ticket by its `ticketid` or by a unique `idproperty` (if `idproperty` is used, its values must be unique across all tickets), allowing customization of returned properties, property history, associations, and archived status.

tools.name: Retrieve timeline event by ids
tools.description: Retrieves a specific hubspot crm timeline event by its `eventtemplateid` (for an existing template) and `eventid` (for an existing event), returning event details which may not include full associated crm object data.

tools.name: Retrieve video conference settings by id
tools.description: Retrieves video conference application settings, such as webhook urls and user/account management configurations, for a specified `appid`.

tools.name: Return pipeline by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific pipeline by its id and crm object type, detailing its stages and properties.

tools.name: Search campaigns
tools.description: Searches for hubspot campaigns.

tools.name: Search company objects
tools.description: Searches hubspot company objects using a text query, complex filter groups (anded within, ored between), sorting, and specific property selection, including custom properties.

tools.name: Search contacts by criteria
tools.description: Searches for hubspot contacts using a text query, specific filter criteria (filters in a group are anded, groups are ored), sorting, and pagination to retrieve selected properties.

tools.name: Search crm email objects
tools.description: Searches crm email objects using full-text queries, complex filtering (filters within a group are or'd, groups are and'd), sorting, pagination, and property selection; ensure `propertyname` in filters is valid and filterable for emails.

tools.name: Search crm objects by criteria
tools.description: Searches hubspot crm objects (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies') by `objecttype` using complex criteria including filters, sorting, and pagination; property names used in filters, sorts, and returned properties must be valid for the specified `objecttype`.

tools.name: Search deals by criteria
tools.description: Searches hubspot deals using complex criteria (text queries, property filters, sorting, pagination) for targeted retrieval beyond simple id lookups; ensure filter operator/value combinations are valid for the target hubspot property.

tools.name: Search emails
tools.description: Searches for hubspot emails using flexible criteria and filters.

tools.name: Search feedback submissions
tools.description: Searches for feedback submissions in hubspot crm using text query, filter groups, sorting, and pagination, returning specified properties.

tools.name: Search line items by criteria
tools.description: Searches hubspot line items using criteria including filters, sorting, and pagination; `after` must be a valid cursor from a previous response, and `sorts`/`properties` must refer to valid line item property names.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Searches for hubspot products using flexible criteria and filters.

tools.name: Search products by criteria
tools.description: Searches hubspot products using text queries, filters, and sorting by sortable properties, with options for pagination and specifying returned properties.

tools.name: Search quotes by criteria
tools.description: Searches hubspot crm quotes using a text query, complex filter criteria, sorting, and pagination.

tools.name: Search tickets
tools.description: Searches for hubspot tickets using flexible criteria and filters.

tools.name: Search tickets by criteria
tools.description: Retrieves hubspot tickets by applying filters on properties, a full-text query, sort preferences, and pagination, allowing selection of specific fields to be returned.

tools.name: Search products by criteria
tools.description: Deprecated: searches hubspot products by criteria; use `search products by criteria` instead.

tools.name: Set call recording settings
tools.description: Configures the url (`urltoretrieveauthedrecording`) that hubspot uses to retrieve call recordings for a specified third-party calling app (`appid`), which must be an existing calling extension app integrated with the hubspot account.

tools.name: Update Email
tools.description: Partially updates properties of an existing hubspot email object, identified by `emailid` (as internal id or custom unique property value if `idproperty` is given); the object must exist.

tools.name: Update a batch of campaigns
tools.description: Updates properties for up to 50 existing hubspot marketing campaigns in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Update a batch of contacts
tools.description: Updates specified properties for a batch of up to 100 hubspot contacts, identified by their vids; ensure property values use hubspot internal names and formats (e.g., for enums like 'lifecyclestage').

tools.name: Update a batch of emails
tools.description: Updates multiple hubspot email engagement records in a batch, identifying each by its hubspot object `id` (or an alternative unique property via `idproperty`) and setting new string values for specified properties (which must be valid internal email property names).

tools.name: Update a batch of line items
tools.description: Updates a batch of existing hubspot crm line items in a single operation, identifying each by its primary id or a unique `idproperty` (which must be a unique identifier property in hubspot), and modifies their specified properties.

tools.name: Update a marketing email
tools.description: Updates properties of an existing marketing email identified by its `emailid`; unspecified fields retain their current values.

tools.name: Update batch feedback submissions
tools.description: Updates a batch of hubspot feedback submissions; property keys must be existing internal hubspot names and values must be correctly formatted strings.

tools.name: Update batch of companies
tools.description: Updates specified properties for multiple existing hubspot companies in a batch, identifying each company by its hubspot id or by a unique property name in `idproperty` with its value in `id`.

tools.name: Update batch of CRM tickets
tools.description: Batch updates properties for multiple hubspot crm tickets using a list of inputs, where each input specifies the ticket `id` and the `properties` to modify.

tools.name: Update a batch of deals
tools.description: Updates properties for multiple existing hubspot crm deals in a batch; ensure property names are the internal hubspot names.

tools.name: Update a batch of objects by id or property values
tools.description: Performs a batch update on a valid `objecttype` where properties are writeable and any `idproperty` used is designated unique; updates can be partial.

tools.name: Update batch of products
tools.description: Updates multiple hubspot product records in a single batch; all properties to be updated must already exist in hubspot.

tools.name: Update calling app recording settings
tools.description: Updates the recording settings, such as the url for retrieving authenticated recordings, for a specific calling extension app identified by its `appid`.

tools.name: Update campaign
tools.description: Partially updates specific, writable properties of an existing hubspot marketing campaign identified by `campaignguid`; an empty string value in `properties` clears a property.

tools.name: Update emails
tools.description: Updates multiple hubspot emails in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Update existing event template
tools.description: Updates an existing hubspot event template's name, display templates, and tokens; providing `tokens` replaces the entire existing list, and the `id` in the request body must match `eventtemplateid` in the path.

tools.name: Update existing object schema
tools.description: Updates an existing custom object schema's metadata in hubspot, such as its description, labels, display properties, required properties, searchable properties, and restorability, for a specified `objecttype` that must already exist.

tools.name: Update feedback submission by id
tools.description: Partially updates writable properties of an existing hubspot feedback submission, identified by its `feedbacksubmissionid` (which can be an internal object id, or a unique property value if `idproperty` is specified).

tools.name: Update line item object partially
tools.description: Partially updates specified properties of an existing hubspot line item, identified by `lineitemid` (as hubspot object id or value of `idproperty` if used); new values overwrite existing ones, and an empty string clears a property.

tools.name: Update pipeline stage by ids
tools.description: Partially updates a hubspot crm pipeline stage identified by `objecttype`, `pipelineid`, and `stageid`, requiring `metadata` in the request; unspecified fields are unchanged.

tools.name: Update product
tools.description: Updates properties for an existing hubspot product.

tools.name: Update products
tools.description: Updates multiple hubspot products in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Update specific CRM property
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing hubspot crm property, identified by its `objecttype` and `propertyname`; only provided fields are modified, and changing a property's `type` can cause data loss if incompatible with existing data.

tools.name: Update ticket
tools.description: Updates properties for an existing hubspot ticket.

tools.name: Update tickets
tools.description: Updates multiple hubspot tickets in a single batch operation.

tools.name: Update token on event template
tools.description: Updates the label or options of an existing token within a specified hubspot crm event template; token name and data type remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update video conference app settings
tools.description: Updates interaction urls (for creating/updating/deleting meetings, fetching accounts, verifying users) for a video conference application specified by `appid`; the application must exist and all urls must be valid and publicly accessible.

tools.description: Fetches information for a specified, existing slack bot user; will not work for regular user accounts or other integration types.

tools.name: Fetch conversation history
tools.description: Fetches a chronological list of messages and events from a specified slack conversation, accessible by the authenticated user/bot, with options for pagination and time range filtering.

tools.name: Fetch team information
tools.description: Deprecated: fetches comprehensive metadata about the current slack team. use `fetch team info` instead.

tools.name: Get Do Not Disturb status for users
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves a user's current do not disturb status. use `get team dnd status` instead.

tools.name: Fetch item reactions
tools.description: Fetches reactions for a slack message, file, or file comment, requiring one of: channel and timestamp; file id; or file comment id.

tools.name: Retrieve conversation replies
tools.description: Retrieves replies to a specific parent message in a slack conversation, using the channel id and the parent message's timestamp (`ts`).

tools.name: Fetch team info
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive metadata about the current slack team, or a specified team if the provided id is accessible.

tools.name: Fetch workspace settings information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed settings for a specific slack workspace, primarily for administrators in an enterprise grid organization to view or audit workspace configurations.

tools.name: Find channels
tools.description: Find channels in a slack workspace by any criteria - name, topic, purpose, or description.

tools.name: Lookup users by email
tools.description: Retrieves the slack user object for an active user by their registered email address; fails with 'users not found' if the email is unregistered or the user is inactive.

tools.name: Find users
tools.description: Find users in a slack workspace by any criteria - email, name, display name, or other text. includes optimized email lookup for exact email matches.

tools.name: Get channel conversation preferences
tools.description: Retrieves conversation preferences (e.g., who can post, who can thread) for a specified channel, primarily for use within slack enterprise grid environments.

tools.name: Get reminder information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing slack reminder specified by its id; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Get remote file
tools.description: Retrieve information about a remote file added to slack.

tools.name: Get team DND status
tools.description: Retrieves a user's current do not disturb status.

tools.name: Retrieve user presence
tools.description: Retrieves a slack user's current real-time presence (e.g., 'active', 'away') to determine their availability, noting this action does not provide historical data or status reasons.

tools.name: Create conversation
tools.description: Deprecated: initiates a public or private channel-based conversation. use `create channel` instead.

tools.name: Invite users to a Slack channel
tools.description: Invites users to an existing slack channel using their valid slack user ids.

tools.name: Invite users to channel
tools.description: Invites users to a specified slack channel; this action is restricted to enterprise grid workspaces and requires the authenticated user to be a member of the target channel.

tools.name: Invite user to workspace
tools.description: Invites a user to a slack workspace and specified channels by email; use `resend=true` to re-process an existing invitation for a user not yet signed up.

tools.name: Invite user to workspace and channels
tools.description: Deprecated: invites a user to a slack workspace and specified channels by email. use `invite user to workspace` instead.

tools.name: Join conversation by channel id
tools.description: Joins an existing slack conversation (public channel, private channel, or multi-person direct message) by its id, if the authenticated user has permission.

tools.name: Leave conversation channel
tools.description: Leaves a slack conversation given its channel id; fails if leaving as the last member of a private channel or if used on a slack connect channel.

tools.name: List accessible conversations for a user
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves conversations accessible to a specified user. use `list conversations` instead.

tools.name: List all channels
tools.description: Lists conversations available to the user with various filters and search options.

tools.name: List conversations
tools.description: Deprecated: lists conversations available to the user with various filters and search options. use `list channels` instead.

tools.name: List all Slack team users with pagination
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves a paginated list of all users in a slack workspace. use `list all users` instead.

tools.name: List all users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all users, including comprehensive details, profile information, status, and team memberships, in a slack workspace; data may not be real-time.

tools.name: List all users in a user group
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all user ids within a specified slack user group, with an option to include users from disabled groups.

tools.name: List conversations
tools.description: Retrieves conversations accessible to a specified user (or the authenticated user if no user id is provided), respecting shared membership for non-public channels.

tools.name: List Slack files
tools.description: Lists files and their metadata within a slack workspace, filterable by user, channel, timestamp, or type; this action returns metadata only, not file content.

tools.name: List reminders
tools.description: Lists all reminders with their details for the authenticated slack user; returns an empty list if no reminders exist.

tools.name: List remote files
tools.description: Retrieve information about a team's remote files.

tools.name: List scheduled messages
tools.description: Retrieves a list of pending (not yet delivered) messages scheduled in a specific slack channel, or across all accessible channels if no channel id is provided, optionally filtered by time and paginated.

tools.name: List scheduled messages in a channel
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves a list of pending (not yet delivered) messages scheduled in a specific slack channel. use `list scheduled messages` instead.

tools.name: List pinned items in a channel
tools.description: Retrieves all messages and files pinned to a specified channel; the caller must have access to this channel.

tools.name: List team remote files
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieve information about a team's remote files. use `list remote files` instead.

tools.name: List starred items
tools.description: Lists items starred by a user.

tools.name: List starred items
tools.description: Deprecated: lists items starred by a user. use `list starred items` instead.

tools.name: List team custom emojis
tools.description: Retrieves all custom emojis for the slack workspace (image urls or aliases), not standard unicode emojis; does not include usage statistics or creation dates.

tools.name: List user groups
tools.description: Lists user groups in a slack workspace, including user-created and default groups; results for large workspaces may be paginated.

tools.name: List user reactions
tools.description: Lists all reactions added by a specific user to messages, files, or file comments in slack, useful for engagement analysis when the item content itself is not required.

tools.name: List user reminders with details
tools.description: Deprecated: lists all reminders with their details for the authenticated slack user. use `list reminders` instead.

tools.name: List admin users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of admin users for a specified slack workspace.

tools.name: Set user presence
tools.description: Manually sets a user's slack presence, overriding automatic detection; this setting persists across connections but can be overridden by user actions or slack's auto-away (e.g., after 10 mins of inactivity).

tools.name: Mark reminder as complete
tools.description: Marks a specific slack reminder as complete using its `reminder` id; **deprecated**: this slack api endpoint ('reminders.complete') was deprecated in march 2023 and is not recommended for new applications.

tools.name: Open DM
tools.description: Opens or resumes a slack direct message (dm) or multi-person direct message (mpim) by providing either user ids or an existing channel id.

tools.name: Open or resume direct or multi-person messages
tools.description: Deprecated: opens or resumes a slack direct message (dm) or multi-person direct message (mpim). use `open dm` instead.

tools.name: Pin an item to a channel
tools.description: Pins a message to a specified slack channel; the message must not already be pinned.

tools.name: Remove participants from call
tools.description: Deprecated: registers participants removed from a slack call. use `remove call participants` instead.

tools.name: Register a new call with participants
tools.description: Deprecated: registers a new call in slack using `calls.add` for third-party call integration. use `start call` instead.

tools.name: Register new call participants
tools.description: Deprecated: registers new participants added to a slack call. use `add call participants` instead.

tools.name: Remove remote file
tools.description: Removes the slack reference to an external file (which must have been previously added via the remote files api), specified by either its `external id` or `file` id (one of which is required), without deleting the actual external file.

tools.name: Remove a star from an item
tools.description: Removes a star from a previously starred slack item (message, file, file comment, channel, group, or dm), requiring identification via `file`, `file comment`, `channel` (for channel/group/dm), or both `channel` and `timestamp` (for a message).

tools.name: Remove user from conversation
tools.description: Removes a specified user from a slack conversation (channel); the caller must have permissions to remove users and cannot remove themselves using this action.

tools.name: Remove call participants
tools.description: Registers participants removed from a slack call.

tools.name: Remove reaction from item
tools.description: Removes an emoji reaction from a message, file, or file comment in slack.

tools.name: Rename a Slack channel
tools.description: Renames a public or private slack channel; for enterprise grid workspaces, the user must be a workspace admin or channel manager.

tools.name: Rename a conversation
tools.description: Renames a slack channel, automatically adjusting the new name to meet naming conventions (e.g., converting to lowercase), which may affect integrations using the old name.

tools.name: Rename an emoji
tools.description: Renames an existing custom emoji in a slack workspace, updating all its instances.

tools.name: Retrieve a user's identity details
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's and their team's identity, with details varying based on oauth scopes (e.g., `identity.basic`, `identity.email`, `identity.avatar`).

tools.name: Retrieve call information
tools.description: Retrieves a point-in-time snapshot of a specific slack call's information.

tools.name: Retrieve conversation information
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a slack conversation by id (e.g., name, purpose, creation date, with options for member count/locale), excluding message content; requires a valid channel id.

tools.name: Get conversation members
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of active member ids for a specified slack public channel, private channel, direct message (dm), or multi-person direct message (mpim).

tools.name: Retrieve user DND status
tools.description: Retrieves a slack user's current do not disturb (dnd) status to determine their availability before interaction; any specified user id must be a valid slack user id.

tools.name: Retrieve detailed file information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed metadata and paginated comments for a specific slack file id; does not download file content.

tools.name: Retrieve detailed user information
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive information for a valid slack user id, excluding message history and channel memberships.

tools.name: Retrieve message permalink
tools.description: Retrieves a permalink url for a specific message in a slack channel or conversation; the permalink respects slack's privacy settings.

tools.name: Retrieve remote file info
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieve information about a remote file added to slack. use `get remote file` instead.

tools.name: Retrieve team profile details
tools.description: Retrieves all profile field definitions for a slack team, optionally filtered by visibility, to understand the team's profile structure.

tools.name: Retrieve user profile information
tools.description: Retrieves profile information for a specified slack user (defaults to the authenticated user if `user` id is omitted); a provided `user` id must be valid.

tools.name: Unarchive conversation
tools.description: Deprecated: reverses conversation archival. use `unarchive channel` instead.

tools.name: Revoke a file's public url
tools.description: Revokes a slack file's public url, making it private; this is a no-op if not already public and is irreversible.

tools.name: Schedule message
tools.description: Schedules a message to a slack channel, dm, or private group for a future time (`post at`), requiring `text`, `blocks`, or `attachments` for content; scheduling is limited to 120 days in advance.

tools.name: Schedule message in chat
tools.description: Deprecated: schedules a message to a slack channel, dm, or private group for a future time. use `schedule message` instead.

tools.name: Search Messages
tools.description: Deprecated: searches messages in a slack workspace using a query with optional modifiers. use `search messages` instead.

tools.name: Search messages
tools.description: Workspace‑wide slack message search with date ranges and filters. use `query` modifiers (e.g., in:#channel, from:@user, before/after:yyyy-mm-dd), sorting (score/timestamp), and pagination.

tools.name: Send ephemeral message
tools.description: Sends an ephemeral message to a user in a channel.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Posts a message to a slack channel, direct message, or private group; requires content via `text`, `blocks`, or `attachments`.

tools.name: Send a message to a Slack channel
tools.description: Deprecated: posts a message to a slack channel, direct message, or private group. use `send message` instead.

tools.name: Send an ephemeral message
tools.description: Deprecated: sends an ephemeral message to a user in a channel. use `send ephemeral message` instead.

tools.name: Set a conversation's purpose
tools.description: Sets the purpose (a short description of its topic/goal, displayed in the header) for a slack conversation; the calling user must be a member.

tools.name: Set DND duration
tools.description: Turns on do not disturb mode for the current user, or changes its duration.

tools.name: Set profile photo
tools.description: This method allows the user to set their profile image.

tools.name: Set conversation read cursor
tools.description: Marks a message, specified by its timestamp (`ts`), as the most recently read for the authenticated user in the given `channel`, provided the user is a member of the channel and the message exists within it.

tools.name: Set conversation topic
tools.description: Sets or updates the topic for a specified slack conversation.

tools.name: Set Slack user profile information
tools.description: Updates a slack user's profile, setting either individual fields or multiple fields via a json object.

tools.name: Set the user's profile image
tools.description: Deprecated: this method allows the user to set their profile image. use `set profile photo` instead.

tools.name: Share a me message in a channel
tools.description: Sends a 'me message' (e.g., '/me is typing') to a slack channel, where it's displayed as a third-person user action; messages are plain text and the channel must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: Share a remote file in channels
tools.description: Shares a remote file, which must already be registered with slack, into specified slack channels or direct message conversations.

tools.name: Start call
tools.description: Registers a new call in slack using `calls.add` for third-party call integration; `created by` is required if not using a user-specific token.

tools.name: Start real time messaging session
tools.description: Initiates a slack rtm session providing a single-use websocket url (valid 30s) for event streaming; does not set initial presence status.

tools.name: Unarchive a public or private channel
tools.description: Unarchives a specified public or private slack channel that is currently archived, using its channel id.

tools.name: Unarchive channel
tools.description: Reverses conversation archival.

tools.name: Unpin message from channel
tools.description: Unpins a message, identified by its timestamp, from a specified channel if the message is currently pinned there; this operation is destructive.

tools.name: Update Slack user group
tools.description: Updates an existing slack user group, which must be specified by an existing `usergroup` id, with new optional details such as its name, description, handle, or default channels.

tools.name: Update call information
tools.description: Updates the title, join url, or desktop app join url for an existing slack call identified by its id.

tools.name: Update a Slack message
tools.description: Updates a slack message, identified by `channel` id and `ts` timestamp, by modifying its `text`, `attachments`, or `blocks`; provide at least one content field, noting `attachments`/`blocks` are replaced if included (`[]` clears them).

tools.name: Update an existing remote file
tools.description: Updates metadata or content details for an existing remote file in slack; this action cannot upload new files or change the fundamental file type.

tools.name: Update user group members
tools.description: Replaces all members of an existing slack user group with a new list of valid user ids.

tools.name: Upload or create a file in Slack
tools.description: Uploads a file to slack, requiring either `content` (for text) or `file` (for binary data), optionally sharing it in specified `channels` or as a reply via `thread ts`.

triggers.name: New Channel Created Trigger

name: Canvas
description: Canvas is a learning management system supporting online courses, assignments, grading, and collaboration, widely used by schools and universities for virtual classrooms

tools.name: Create account notification
tools.description: Creates a global notification within a canvas account, ensuring `end at` is after `start at` and any specified `notification roles` are valid.

tools.name: Create appointment group
tools.description: Creates a new appointment group in canvas for schedulable time slots within specified course or group contexts.

tools.name: Create an assignment
tools.description: Creates a new assignment within a specified course in canvas lms.

tools.name: Create assignment override
tools.description: Creates an assignment override to adjust due/unlock/lock dates for an assignment in a course, targeting specific students (requires `title`), a group, or a course section; at least one target (`student ids`, `group id`, or `course section id`) is required.

tools.name: Create Calendar Event
tools.description: Creates a calendar event with options for recurrence (finite `rrule` series only), section-specific timings, and blackout dates within a specified context.

tools.name: Create communication channel
tools.description: Creates a new communication channel (e.g., email, sms, push) for an existing canvas user to receive notifications.

tools.name: Create content share
tools.description: Shares a canvas content item to specified users, if the sender has necessary permissions and receiver ids are valid.

tools.name: Create conversation
tools.description: Use to send messages in canvas by creating a new conversation or adding to an existing one; an existing conversation with the same recipients (and matching scope/filter, if specified) may be reused unless `force new` is true.

tools.name: Create a course
tools.description: Creates a new course in canvas within a specified account, with comprehensive configuration options.

tools.name: Create discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to create a new entry in a canvas discussion topic. use when posting a message with optional attachments to a discussion topic.

tools.name: Create discussion topic
tools.description: Creates a new discussion topic in a specified canvas course, allowing comprehensive configuration of its content, type, publication settings, engagement features, and associations.

tools.name: Create enrollment
tools.description: Enrolls a user in a canvas course with a specified role and status; `associated user id` is required if `enrollment type` is 'observerenrollment'.

tools.name: Create Folder
tools.description: Creates a new folder in canvas within a specified context (e.g., course, user) and optional parent folder; ensure the context and any parent folder (specified by id or path, not both) already exist.

tools.name: Create Module
tools.description: Creates a new organizational module within a specified canvas lms course, with options for availability, sequencing, and prerequisites.

tools.name: Create a page for a course
tools.description: Creates a new wiki page in a specified canvas course, with options for title, html body, editing permissions, publication, and designation as front page (which also requires publication).

tools.name: Create Quiz
tools.description: Creates a new quiz with various settings in a specified existing canvas course; `assignment group id` applies only to graded quiz types.

tools.name: Create a quiz question
tools.description: Creates a new question for an existing quiz within a course; if `answers` are provided, their structure must align with `question type`, and any `quiz group id` must be valid for an existing group in the quiz.

tools.name: Delete appointment group
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing appointment group by its id; associated appointments may also be canceled or affected.

tools.name: Delete an assignment
tools.description: Soft-deletes a specific assignment within a course, returning the assignment object with its `workflow state` updated to 'deleted'.

tools.name: Delete a folder
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing folder specified by its unique id.

tools.name: Delete quiz
tools.description: Permanently deletes the quiz identified by `quiz id` from the course identified by `course id`; this action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Get current grades
tools.description: Fetches current, aggregated grade data from canvas analytics for a specified account id.

tools.name: Get term grade data
tools.description: Retrieves department-level aggregated grade data for a specific academic term within a canvas account.

tools.name: Edit assignment
tools.description: Updates an existing assignment in a canvas course (identified by `course id` and `assignment id`); only attributes explicitly provided in the request are modified.

tools.name: Edit a quiz
tools.description: Modifies an existing canvas quiz; only attributes with provided values in the request are updated.

tools.name: Export content
tools.description: Use to initiate an asynchronous export of content (e.g., common cartridge, qti, zip) from an existing canvas course, returning an export id and progress url.

tools.name: Fetch Data
tools.description: Fetches a specific category of canvas data (e.g., accounts, courses, users) by setting exactly one `get *` boolean flag to true and providing any associated ids. supports pagination with per page (default 100, max 100) and page (default 1) parameters to fetch large datasets.

tools.name: Get Canvas accounts
tools.description: Retrieves all canvas accounts accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get all assignments
tools.description: Retrieves assignments for a specified canvas course.

tools.name: Get all users
tools.description: Retrieves a list of users for a specified canvas `account id` (use 'self' for the current user's root account), supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

tools.name: Get assignment
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific assignment within a given course in canvas.

tools.name: Get Assignment Rubric
tools.description: Fetches the detailed rubric for a specified assignment within a canvas course; fails if the assignment has no associated rubric.

tools.name: Get Course Activity
tools.description: Retrieves daily activity analytics, such as page views and participation events, for a specified canvas course.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about the currently authenticated user from the canvas lms.

tools.name: Get department-level completed statistics
tools.description: Retrieves numeric statistics for all completed courses for a specified canvas account id; the account must exist.

tools.name: Get department level current statistics
tools.description: Fetches a snapshot of current numerical statistics for a canvas account, requiring its valid id.

tools.name: Get department level completed grades
tools.description: Retrieves the distribution of final grades (0-100, binned to whole numbers) for all completed courses in a canvas account, where each data point represents one student's final grade in one course.

tools.name: Get department level term statistics
tools.description: Retrieves department-level academic term statistics (e.g., enrollment, activity, grades) for a specified account and term in canvas, provided analytics data is available.

tools.name: Get enrollment by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a specific enrollment by its id within a given account.

tools.name: Get gradebook history days
tools.description: Retrieves a chronological list of dates with grading activity and the active graders for a specified course.

tools.name: Get Page for a Course
tools.description: Retrieves a specific content page (wiki or content page) by its url or numeric id from a specified canvas course.

tools.name: Get quiz submissions
tools.description: Retrieves all submissions for a specific quiz within a course; ensure `course id` and `quiz id` are valid and the quiz belongs to the course.

tools.name: Get report status
tools.description: Retrieves the status of a previously initiated report in a canvas account, specified by its type and id.

tools.name: Get a single course
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific canvas course using its `course id`, which must be valid, and allows for including additional data fields in the response via the `include` parameter.

tools.name: Get single submission
tools.description: Retrieves a specific submission for an assignment made by a particular user within a designated course.

tools.name: Get submission files
tools.description: Retrieves files from a student's canvas assignment submission, processing text, binary, and zip files, and providing s3 download urls if s3 integration is active and uploads are successful.

tools.name: Get user assignment analytics
tools.description: Fetches detailed assignment-level analytics for a specific student in a designated course, including submission details and class performance statistics.

tools.name: Get user course progress
tools.description: Retrieves the academic progress of a specific user within a given course.

tools.name: Get user participation analytics
tools.description: Retrieves page view activity and participation details for a specific student enrolled in a designated course.

tools.name: Get User Profile
tools.description: Retrieves profile information for an existing canvas user.

tools.name: Grade or comment on a submission
tools.description: Updates a student's assignment submission with a grade, comment, sticker, or status change; requires `course id`, `assignment id`, `user id`, and at least one update field.

tools.name: List Accounts for Course Admins
tools.description: Retrieves canvas accounts visible to the current user due to their course-level administrative roles; no request parameters are needed.

tools.name: List all folders
tools.description: Retrieves the first page of folders for a specified canvas course id; this action is scoped to courses only.

tools.name: List appointment groups
tools.description: Retrieves a list of canvas appointment groups based on specified filters; any provided `context codes` must be valid and accessible by the user.

tools.name: List assignment submissions
tools.description: Retrieves submissions for a specific assignment within a course, optionally including related resources or grouping by student group for group assignments. supports pagination to retrieve more than the default 10 submissions.

tools.name: List Available Reports
tools.description: Lists available reports (including those that can be or have been generated) for a valid canvas account id.

tools.name: List calendar events for a user
tools.description: Retrieves calendar events and assignments for a specific user from canvas lms, supporting extensive filtering options detailed in the request schema.

tools.name: List communication messages
tools.description: Retrieves communication messages from canvas.

tools.name: List communication channels
tools.description: Retrieves a list of communication channels associated with a specific user in canvas.

tools.name: List content exports
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of content exports from canvas for a specified, existing course.

tools.name: List courses
tools.description: Retrieves a list of the current user's courses from canvas, optionally filtered by enrollment type and state.

tools.name: List Courses for a User
tools.description: Retrieves a list of courses in canvas for a specified `user id`, requiring observer or admin permissions to view courses for others.

tools.name: List Course Users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users for a given canvas `course id` (which must be an existing course), supporting various filtering, sorting, and data inclusion options.

tools.name: List Discussion Entries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve paginated discussion entries for a specific discussion topic in a course. use when needing to list all posts and replies under a given topic, supports pagination.

tools.name: List Discussion Topics
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of discussion topics or announcements for a specified course.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Fetches metadata (id, name, size, type, urls) for all files within a specified canvas course.

tools.name: List folders
tools.description: Retrieves a list of immediate sub-folders within the specified `folder id`.

tools.name: List pages for a course
tools.description: Retrieves a list of wiki pages associated with a specific, existing course in canvas.

tools.name: List Quizzes in Course
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of quizzes for a specified, valid canvas course, optionally filtering by a search term in the quiz title.

tools.name: List sent content shares
tools.description: Retrieves content shares sent by the specified user to other users or courses within canvas.

tools.name: List submissions
tools.description: Fetches gradebook history submissions for a specific course, assignment, grader, and date from canvas.

tools.name: List submissions for multiple assignments
tools.description: Retrieves submissions from a canvas course for specified assignments and/or students; the course must be accessible.

tools.name: List uncollated submission versions
tools.description: Retrieves a feed of uncollated submission versions from the gradebook history for a course; any provided `assignment id` must be valid for the course, and any `user id` must be for a user enrolled in the course.

tools.name: List users in account
tools.description: Use this action to retrieve all users associated with a specific, existing canvas account id.

tools.name: Reply to discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to reply to a discussion entry. use when you need to send a message to a discussion entry with optional attachments.

tools.name: Retrieve enrollment term

tools.name: Create an issue

tools.name: Create an issue comment

tools.name: Create a pull request

tools.name: Create repository

tools.name: Create snippet comment

tools.name: Delete issue

tools.name: Delete repository

tools.name: Get current user

tools.name: Get file from repository

tools.name: Get Pull Request

tools.name: Get snippet

tools.name: List pull requests

tools.name: List repositories in workspace
tools.description: Lists repositories in a specified bitbucket workspace, accessible to the authenticated user, with options to filter by role or query string, and sort results.

tools.name: List workspace members
tools.description: Lists all members of a specified bitbucket workspace; the workspace must exist.

tools.name: List workspaces
tools.description: Lists bitbucket workspaces accessible to the authenticated user, optionally filtered and sorted.

tools.name: Update an issue
tools.description: Updates an existing issue in a bitbucket repository by modifying specified attributes; requires `workspace`, `repo slug`, `issue id`, and at least one attribute to update.

tools.name: Clear tasks

tools.name: Create a task list

tools.name: Delete task

tools.name: Delete task list

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Use to retrieve a specific google task if its `task id` and parent `tasklist id` are known.

tools.name: Get task list

tools.name: Insert Task

tools.name: List task lists

tools.name: Move Task

tools.name: Patch task list

name: Figma
description: A collaborative interface design tool.

tools.name: Add a comment to a file
tools.description: Posts a new comment to a figma file or branch, optionally replying to an existing root comment (replies cannot be nested); `region height` and `region width` in `client meta` must be positive if defining a comment region.

tools.name: Add a reaction to a comment
tools.description: Posts a specified emoji reaction to an existing comment in a figma file or branch, requiring valid file key and comment id.

tools.name: Create a webhook
tools.description: Creates a figma webhook for a `team id` to send post notifications for an `event type` to a publicly accessible https `endpoint`; an initial ping is sent unless `status` is `paused`.

tools.name: Create dev resources
tools.description: Creates and attaches multiple uniquely-urled development resources to specified figma nodes, up to 10 per node.

tools.name: Create, modify, or delete variables
tools.description: Manages variables, collections, modes, and their values in a figma file via batch create/update/delete operations; use temporary ids to link new related items in one request and ensure `variablemodevalues` match the target variable's `resolvedtype`.

tools.name: Delete a comment
tools.description: Deletes a specific comment from a figma file or branch, provided the authenticated user is the original author of the comment.

tools.name: Delete a reaction
tools.description: Deletes a specific emoji reaction from a comment in a figma file; the user must have originally created the reaction.

tools.name: Delete a webhook
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing webhook, identified by its unique `webhook id`; this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete dev resource
tools.description: Deletes a development resource (used to link figma design elements to external developer information like code or tasks) from a specified figma file.

tools.name: Design tokens to tailwind
tools.description: Convert design tokens to tailwind css configuration. takes the output from extractdesigntokens and generates: - tailwind.config.ts/js with theme extensions - optional globals.css with font imports note: shadow colors can be provided in either string format (e.g., "rgba(15, 110, 110, 0.32)") or dictionary format (e.g., {"r": 0.059, "g": 0.431, "b": 0.431, "a": 0.32}).

tools.name: Detect background
tools.description: Detect background layers for selected nodes. uses geometric analysis, z-index ordering, and visual properties to identify potential background layers.

tools.name: Discover Figma Resources
tools.description: 🔍 smart figma resource discovery - never guess ids again! 🎯 easiest method: just paste any figma url to get all ids: • file urls: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/design → get file key • design urls: https://www.figma.com/design/abc123/design → get file key • node urls: ...?node-id=123:456 → get file key + node id • team urls: .../team/123456/... → get team id 🔄 step-by-step discovery: 1. team id → projects list (with project ids) 2. project id → files list (with file keys + thumbnails) 3. file key → nodes list (with node ids + hierarchy) 💡 common workflows: • extract from url: discoverfigmaresources(figma url="...") • browse team: discoverfigmaresources(team id="123") • list files: discoverfigmaresources(project id="proj 456") • find nodes: discoverfigmaresources(file key="abc123") ✨ get file key for getfilejson, node ids for detectbackground, etc.

tools.name: Download Figma Images
tools.description: Download images from figma file nodes. renders specified nodes as images and downloads them using mercury's filedownloadable infrastructure. supports png, svg, jpg, and pdf formats.

tools.name: Extract design tokens
tools.description: Extract design tokens from figma files. combines styles, variables, and extracted values to create a comprehensive design token system.

tools.name: Extract Prototype Interactions
tools.description: Extract prototype interactions and animations from figma files. analyzes the prototype data to extract: - user interactions (clicks, hovers, etc.) - transition animations - component variant states - user flows and navigation

tools.name: Get activity logs
tools.description: Retrieves activity log events from figma, allowing filtering by event types, time range, and pagination.

tools.name: Get a webhook
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific webhook by its id, provided the webhook exists and is accessible to the user.

tools.name: Get comments in a file
tools.description: Retrieves all comments from an existing figma file, identified by a valid `file key`, returning details like content, author, position, and reactions, with an option for markdown formatted content.

tools.name: Get component
tools.description: Get component data with automatic simplification. returns clean, ai-friendly component structure.

tools.name: Get component set
tools.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific published figma component set using its unique `key`.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for the currently authenticated figma user.

tools.name: Get dev resources
tools.description: Retrieves development resources (e.g., jira/github links) for a figma main file, optionally filtering by specific node ids.

tools.name: Get file components
tools.description: Retrieves published components from a figma file, which must be a main file (not a branch) acting as a library.

tools.name: Get file component sets
tools.description: Retrieves all published component sets from the specified figma main file (file key must not be for a branch).

tools.name: Get file json
tools.description: Get figma file data with automatic simplification. this enhanced version automatically transforms verbose figma json into clean, ai-friendly format with: - css-like property names - deduplicated variables - removed empty values - 70%+ size reduction use simplify=false to get raw api response.

tools.name: Get files in a project
tools.description: Fetches a list of files in a figma project, optionally including branch metadata.

tools.name: Get file styles
tools.description: Retrieves a list of published styles (like colors, text attributes, effects, and layout grids) from a specified main figma file (not a branch).

tools.name: Get image fills
tools.description: Retrieves temporary (14-day expiry) download urls for all image fills in a figma file; requires `imageref` from `paint` objects to map urls.

tools.name: Get library analytics component action data
tools.description: Retrieves component insertion and detachment analytics for a specified figma library, groupable by 'component' or 'team' and filterable by a date range (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: Get library analytics component usage data
tools.description: Retrieves component usage analytics for a specified figma library file (identified by `file key`), with data groupable by 'component' or 'file'.

tools.name: Get library analytics style action data
tools.description: Retrieves style usage analytics (insertions, detachments) for a figma library, grouped by 'style' or 'team'; if providing a date range, ensure end date is not before start date.

tools.name: Get library analytics style usage data
tools.description: Retrieves style usage analytics for a figma library (specified by a valid `file key`), allowing data to be grouped by 'file' or 'style'.

tools.name: Get library analytics variable action data
tools.description: Retrieves weekly, paginated analytics data on variable insertions and detachments for a specified figma library (identified by `file key`), groupable by 'variable' or 'team', and filterable by an optional date range.

tools.name: Get library analytics variable usage data
tools.description: Retrieves paginated analytics data on variable usage from a specified figma library, grouped by 'file' or 'variable', for libraries with enabled analytics.

tools.name: Get local variables
tools.description: Retrieves all local/remote variables for a figma file/branch; crucial for obtaining mode-specific values which `/v1/files/{file key}/variables/published` omits.

tools.name: Get payments
tools.description: Retrieves a user's payment information for a figma plugin, widget, or community file; the authenticated identity must own the resource.

tools.name: Get projects in a team
tools.description: Retrieves projects within a specified figma team that are visible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get published variables
tools.description: Retrieves variables published from a specified figma file; this api is available only to full members of enterprise organizations.

tools.name: Get reactions for a comment
tools.description: Retrieves reactions for a specific comment in a figma file.

tools.name: Get style
tools.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific style in figma using its unique style key.

tools.name: Get team components
tools.description: Retrieves components published in a specific figma team's library; the team must have published components, otherwise an empty list is returned.

tools.name: Get team component sets
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of published component sets (collections of reusable ui elements) from a specified figma team's library.

tools.name: Get team styles
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of published styles, such as colors or text attributes, from a specified figma team's library.

tools.name: Get team webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves all webhooks registered for a specified figma team.

tools.name: Get versions of a file
tools.description: Retrieves the version history for a figma file or branch, as specified by its `file key`.

tools.name: Get webhook requests
tools.description: Retrieves a history of webhook requests for a specific figma webhook subscription; data is available for requests sent within the last seven days.

tools.name: Render images of file nodes
tools.description: Renders specified nodes from a figma file as images (jpg, pdf, png, svg), returning a map of node ids to image urls (or `null` for failed nodes); images expire after 30 days and are capped at 32 megapixels (larger requests are scaled down).

tools.name: Update a webhook
tools.description: Updates an existing figma webhook, identified by `webhook id`, allowing modification of its event type, endpoint, passcode, status, or description.

tools.name: Update dev resources
tools.description: Updates the name and/or url of one or more existing figma dev resources, each identified by its unique `id`.

name: Composio Search
description: Composio Search provides comprehensive web search across travel (flights, hotels, events), e-commerce (Amazon, Walmart, shopping), financial markets, news, academic research, images, and location services.

tools.name: Composio DuckDuckGo Search
tools.description: The duckduckgosearch class utilizes the composio duckduckgo search api to perform searches, focusing on web information and details. it leverages the duckduckgo search engine via the composio duckduckgo search api to retrieve relevant web data based on the provided query.

tools.name: Composio Google Events Search
tools.description: The eventsearch class enables scraping of google events search queries. it conducts an event search using the composio events search api, retrieving information on events such as concerts, festivals, and other activities based on the provided query.

tools.name: Exa Answer
tools.description: Get answers with citations using the exa api.

tools.name: Composio Similarlinks
tools.description: Perform a search to find similar links and retrieve a list of relevant results. the search can optionally return contents.

tools.name: Composio Finance Search
tools.description: The financesearch class utilizes the composio finance search api to conduct financial searches, focusing on financial data and stock information. it leverages the google finance search engine via the composio finance search api to retrieve pertinent financial details based on the provided query.

tools.name: Composio Google Maps Search
tools.description: The googlemapssearch class performs a location-specific search using the composio goolge maps search api. this class extends the functionality of the base action class to specifically target locations related to the given query. by utilizing the google maps search engine through the composio goolge maps search api, it fetches the most relevant location data based on the input query. the `googlemapssearch` class is particularly useful for applications that need to retrieve and display location information about a specific area. it leverages the powerful search capabilities of google's maps search engine, ensuring that the returned results are accurate and relevant.

tools.name: Composio Image Search
tools.description: The imagesearch class performs an image search using the composio image search api, to target image data and information. it uses the google images search engine through the composio image search api to fetch relevant image information based on the input query.

tools.name: Composio News Search
tools.description: The newssearch class performs a news-specific search using the composio news search api. this class extends the functionality of the base action class to specifically target news articles related to the given query. by utilizing the google news search engine through the composio news search api, it fetches the most relevant news articles based on the input query. the `newssearch` class is particularly useful for applications that need to retrieve and display the latest news articles about a specific topic. it leverages the powerful search capabilities of google's news search engine, ensuring that the returned results are current and relevant.

tools.name: Composio Scholar Search
tools.description: Scholar api allows you to scrape results from a google scholar search query. the scholarsearch class performs an academic search using the composio scholar search api, academic papers and scholarly articles. it uses the google scholar search engine through the serp api to fetch relevant academic information based on the input query.

tools.name: Composio Google Search
tools.description: Perform a google search using the composio google search api.

tools.name: Composio Shopping Search
tools.description: The shoppingsearch class performs a product search using the composio shopping search api.it specifically target shopping results related to the given query. by utilizing the google shopping search engine through the composio shopping search api, it fetches the most relevant product listings based on the input query. the `shoppingsearch` class is particularly useful for applications that need to retrieve and display the latest product listings and shopping results for a specific item. it leverages the powerful search capabilities of google's shopping search engine, ensuring that the returned results are current and relevant.

tools.name: Composio LLM Search
tools.description: The composio llm search class serves as a gateway to the composio llm search api, allowing users to perform searches across a broad range of content with multiple filtering options. it accommodates complex queries, including both keyword and phrase searches, with additional parameters to fine-tune the search results. this class enables a tailored search experience by allowing users to specify the search depth, include images and direct answers, apply domain-specific filters, and control the number of results returned. it is designed to meet various search requirements, from quick lookups to in-depth research.

tools.name: Composio Trends Search
tools.description: The trendssearch class performs a trend search using the google trends search api, to target trend data and information. it uses the google trends search engine through the google trends search api to fetch relevant trend information based on the input query.

tools.name: Add organization attribute option
