tools.name: Delete oauth client webhook
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific webhook subscription of an oauth client in the cal application, stopping its notifications.

tools.name: Cancel booking via uid
tools.description: Cancels an existing and active cal.com booking using its unique identifier (uid).

tools.name: Check calendar availability
tools.description: Retrieves free/busy availability for a specified calendar to aid scheduling without revealing event details; requires an existing, accessible calendar, noting that data granularity can vary.

tools.name: Check gcal synchronization status
tools.description: Call this read-only action to verify the connection and synchronization status of a user's google calendar integration with cal.

tools.name: Check ics feed calendar endpoint
tools.description: Checks an ics feed url (expected as a query parameter) to verify its validity, accessibility, and icalendar data integrity.

tools.name: Check Stripe status
tools.description: Verifies if stripe is correctly connected to the cal scheduling system and functional for processing payments, reporting only on the integration's status.

tools.name: Check team stripe integration status
tools.description: Retrieves the stripe integration status and related information for a team, primarily to verify account connection, subscription details, or payment setup; this is a read-only operation that does not modify stripe settings.

tools.name: Confirm booking by uid
tools.description: Confirms an existing booking by `bookinguid` if the booking exists and is in a state allowing confirmation (e.g., not already cancelled or confirmed); this finalizes the booking, does not modify its details, and should typically be performed once.

tools.name: Connect to calendar

tools.name: Create membership for organization

tools.name: Create OAuth client webhook configuration
tools.description: Creates a webhook for an existing oauth client to send real-time cal.com event notifications (e.g., `booking created`, `meeting ended`) to the `subscriberurl`, enabling integration with external systems or workflow automation.

tools.name: Create organization attributes
tools.description: Creates a new custom attribute for an existing organization, used to enhance data collection for event bookings or user profiles.

tools.name: Create organization webhook by org ID
tools.description: Creates a webhook for a specified, existing organization, sending notifications for selected trigger events to a designated, publicly accessible subscriber url that accepts post requests.

tools.name: Create or update team profile
tools.description: Creates a new team profile, or updates one if a 'slug' matches, customizing branding, scheduling, privacy, and operational details.

tools.name: Create phone call event
tools.description: Schedules a phone call event in cal.com using existing eventtype, organization, and team ids; this action only registers the event details and does not initiate the actual phone call.

tools.name: Create phone call for event type
tools.description: Creates a phone call template associated with an existing event type and team, for defining reusable call configurations like numbers and scripts; note this does not initiate an actual call.

tools.name: Create team event type
tools.description: Creates a new event type for a specified team in cal.com; ensure `teamid`, any provided `scheduleid`, `hosts.userid`, and `destinationcalendar` details are valid and accessible.

tools.name: Create team event types with custom options
tools.description: Creates a highly customizable cal.com team event type with extensive scheduling, booking, and host assignment options; `lengthinminutes` (as string) must be included in `lengthinminutesoptions`, destination calendar details (from `/api/v2/calendars`) must be valid, and host user ids must be valid team members.

tools.name: Create team in organization
tools.description: Creates a new team with customizable attributes within an existing and accessible cal.com organization specified by orgid.

tools.name: Create team membership with role
tools.description: Adds a user to a team with a specified role, acceptance status, and impersonation settings; ensure `teamid` and `userid` refer to existing, valid entities.

tools.name: Create user availability schedule
tools.description: Creates a cal.com user availability schedule, defining its name, timezone, weekly recurring availability, and specific date overrides; if `isdefault` is true, this schedule replaces any existing default and applies to event types not linked to a specific schedule.

tools.name: Create user schedule in organization
tools.description: Creates a new schedule defining a user's availability with weekly slots and date-specific overrides in an organization; setting 'isdefault' to true may replace an existing default schedule for the user.

tools.name: Create webhook for event type
tools.description: Creates a webhook for an existing `eventtypeid` in cal.com, sending notifications for specified `triggers` to a `subscriberurl` that handles post requests.

tools.name: Decline booking with reason
tools.description: Declines a pending booking using its bookinguid, optionally with a reason; this action is irreversible and applies only to bookings awaiting confirmation.

tools.name: Delete conference app connection
tools.description: Disconnects the specified conferencing application (e.g., 'zoom', 'google meet') for the cal.com account, immediately terminating any ongoing call or meeting; use with caution.

tools.name: Delete event type by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing event type by its id, which invalidates its scheduling links; the operation is irreversible, and while existing bookings are unaffected, no new bookings can be made for this event type.

tools.name: Delete event type in team
tools.description: Permanently removes an event type's configuration from a team's scheduling options (e.g., for cleanup); this action is irreversible and requires the event type to be associated with the team.

tools.name: Delete membership in team
tools.description: Use to permanently remove a user's membership from a specific team within an organization, which revokes their team-associated access but does not remove them from the organization.

tools.name: Delete oauth client user
tools.description: Irreversibly revokes a specific user's association with a given oauth client, without deleting the user's cal account.

tools.name: Delete organization attribute
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing attribute (specified by `attributeid`) from an existing organization (specified by `orgid`); this action is irreversible and may affect features dependent on the attribute.

tools.name: Delete organization attribute option
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specified option from an organization's attribute, typically to remove an unnecessary configuration choice.

tools.name: Delete organization membership
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes a user's membership from an organization, removing all associated access and permissions; the response confirms deletion without returning details of the deleted membership.

tools.name: Delete org webhook
tools.description: Permanently deletes an organization's webhook, which stops all its notifications; this action is irreversible and the webhook cannot be recovered.

tools.name: Delete schedule by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific schedule using its unique identifier, which must correspond to an existing schedule.

tools.name: Delete selected calendars
tools.description: Removes a specified, currently selected calendar from the user's active list within the application, without deleting it from the external provider.

tools.name: Delete selected slot
tools.description: Deletes a previously selected time slot from the cal schedule using its `uid`; the slot must exist and this action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete team by id
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes an existing team and all its associated data from the cal system, using the team's unique `teamid`.

tools.name: Delete team from organization
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specific team (and all its associated data, members, and linked projects/events) from an organization, when the team is no longer needed or during organizational restructuring.

tools.name: Delete team memberships by id
tools.description: Irreversibly removes a user's team membership in the cal application, revoking access to that specific team; the user's overall cal account remains active.

tools.name: Delete user attribute option
tools.description: Removes a custom attribute option (e.g., skill, role) currently assigned to a user within an organization; this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete user from organization
tools.description: Permanently removes a user from a specific organization (user's system-wide account is unaffected), revoking their access rights therein; this action is irreversible via api and expects the user to be a current member.

tools.name: Delete user schedule
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific user's schedule, provided the organization, user, and schedule (identified by `orgid`, `userid`, and `scheduleid`) exist.

tools.name: Delete webhook by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing webhook by its `webhookid`, stopping future notifications; this action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete webhook for event type
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific webhook for an event type, halting its real-time notifications; this operation is irreversible and leaves the event type and other webhooks untouched.

tools.name: Delete webhooks for event type
tools.description: Call this to irreversibly delete all webhooks for a specific `eventtypeid` if the event type exists; details of deleted webhooks are not returned.

tools.name: Disconnect calendar using credential id
tools.description: Disconnects a calendar integration by its provider name and credential id, irreversibly revoking cal's access; external calendar data remains unaffected.

tools.name: Fetch all bookings
tools.description: Fetches a list of bookings, optionally filtered by status, attendee, date range, or by event/team ids (which must belong to/include the authenticated user respectively), with support for pagination and sorting.

tools.name: Fetch event type details
tools.description: Fetches all configuration settings and characteristics for a single event type (identified by orgid, teamid, and eventtypeid), which must exist and be accessible; this read-only action cannot list, create, or modify event types.

tools.name: Fetch organization attribute by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific attribute of an organization, useful for fetching a single data point instead of the entire organization record.

tools.name: Fetch provider access token
tools.description: Fetches an oauth access token for the specified `clientid` to authenticate api calls; this action only retrieves the token, not managing scheduling or calendar events.

tools.name: Fetch schedule by id
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specific, existing schedule using its `scheduleid`.

tools.name: Fetch user schedule by org id
tools.description: Fetches a specific user's schedule, potentially including events and availability, using `orgid`, `userid`, and `scheduleid`.

tools.name: Fetch webhook by event type id
tools.description: Retrieves details for a single, specific webhook using its `webhookid` and associated `eventtypeid`.

tools.name: Force refresh user oauth client
tools.description: Forces an immediate refresh of oauth tokens for a specified user and client, bypassing the normal expiration cycle, typically when existing tokens are suspected to be invalid or fresh credentials are required; ensure the user exists, the client is registered, and prior authorization is valid.

tools.name: Get all timezones
tools.description: Retrieves all supported time zone identifiers (e.g., 'america/new york', 'europe/london') and their associated metadata, excluding specific dst changes or precise utc offset details.

tools.name: Get available slots info
tools.description: Retrieves available time slots for scheduling by considering existing bookings and availability, based on criteria like a specified time range and event type.

tools.name: Get conference OAuth authorization url
tools.description: Generates an oauth 2.0 authorization url for a supported conferencing `app` to initiate or refresh its integration with cal.com.

tools.name: Get default schedule details
tools.description: Retrieves the cal system's global default schedule configuration, not custom or user-specific ones.

tools.name: Get event type by team id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific event type by its id, requiring that the event type is associated with the given team id.

tools.name: Get google calendar oauth authentication url
tools.description: Generates the initial google calendar oauth 2.0 authorization url for user redirection to begin the authentication and authorization process.

tools.name: Get oauth clients user
tools.description: Retrieves users associated with a specific oauth client (identified by a valid `clientid`) for auditing access or managing permissions.

tools.name: Get organization ID
tools.description: Retrieves all organization ids associated with the currently authenticated user.

tools.name: Get organization schedules
tools.description: Retrieves a list of schedules (e.g., events, appointments) for an organization, providing basic schedule information, not detailed individual event data.

tools.name: Get organization teams event types
tools.description: Retrieves event types, including names, durations, and custom settings for team scheduling, for all teams within an existing organization specified by `orgid`.

tools.name: Get organization user schedules
tools.description: Fetches all schedule information for a specific user within an organization; handle potential pagination for extensive schedules.

tools.name: Get schedule for user in team
tools.description: Fetches all scheduled events or appointments for a specified user within their team and organization.

tools.name: Get stripe connect info
tools.description: Retrieves stripe connect account details (id, charges/payouts status, verification, settings) for the user's linked cal.com account; response may be empty or indicate no integration if no account is linked.

tools.name: Get team details by organization ID and team ID
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details (e.g., members, roles, metadata) for a specific team using its `teamid` within an organization specified by `orgid`.

tools.name: Get team information by team ID
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for an existing team using its unique id; returned fields may vary by team configuration and user permissions.

tools.name: Get teams list
tools.description: Retrieves all teams the user belongs to, including their names and members.

tools.name: Get webhook by id
tools.description: Retrieves details for an existing and accessible webhook by its id; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Handle conferencing oauth callback for app
tools.description: Processes an oauth 2.0 callback for a conferencing `app`, exchanging the `code` and `state` for access credentials; ensure an oauth flow was previously initiated.

tools.name: List event types
tools.description: Retrieves cal event types, filterable by `username` (required if `eventslug` is provided), multiple `usernames`, or organization details (`orgslug` or `orgid`).

tools.name: List organization memberships
tools.description: Retrieves all memberships for a given organization, including user details, roles, status, and membership dates.

tools.name: List team event types by org and team id
tools.description: Retrieves all event types for a specific team within an organization, optionally filtering by a specific event slug.

tools.name: Mark booking absent for UID
tools.description: Marks the host and/or specified attendees as absent for an existing booking, typically used after a scheduled event to record no-shows.

tools.name: Modify organization membership by id
tools.description: Updates an organization membership's status (accepted), role, or impersonation settings, identified by `orgid` and `membershipid` in the path; requires at least one of these fields in the request to apply changes.

tools.name: Modify org attribute by id
tools.description: Partially updates an organization attribute using `orgid` and `attributeid`, allowing modification of its name, slug, type, or enabled status; changing the 'type' may affect existing data.

tools.name: Patch organization attribute option
tools.description: Partially updates a specific option for an organization's attribute, modifying its 'value' and/or 'slug'; at least one of 'value' or 'slug' must be provided.

tools.name: Patch organization user details
tools.description: Partially updates details for a user that exists within the specified organization.

tools.name: Patch team details by ID
tools.description: Updates specified details for an existing team identified by `teamid`; unspecified fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Patch webhook event type
tools.description: Updates configuration (e.g., payload template, active status, url, triggers, secret) for an existing webhook tied to a specific event type.

tools.name: Post calendar credentials
tools.description: Use to submit/update authentication credentials (passed in the request body) for an existing calendar, enabling cal to connect with external calendar services for synchronization.

tools.name: Connect conferencing app
tools.description: Connects or reconnects cal.com with a specified conferencing application to enable future virtual meeting scheduling, but does not itself create or schedule meetings.

tools.name: Post a new booking request
tools.description: Creates a new booking for an active event type, scheduling it for a specified start time (preferably in the future) with primary attendee details and optional customizations.

tools.name: Assign or create attribute option for user
tools.description: Assigns an existing attribute option (using `attributeoptionid`) or creates a new one (using `value`) for a user, linking it to a specified `attributeid` which must already exist within the organization.

tools.name: Add selected calendar
tools.description: Links a new external calendar or updates an existing link to one, enabling synchronization with the cal application by specifying the `integration` provider, the calendar's `externalid`, and the `credentialid`.

tools.name: Post user to organization
tools.description: Adds a new user to an existing organization (identified by `orgid` in path), requiring user's `email` and allowing extensive optional profile customization.

tools.name: Post webhook event
tools.description: Creates a new cal.com webhook subscription to send real-time notifications for specified calendar events to a publicly accessible subscriber url.

tools.name: Reassign booking to another user
tools.description: Reassigns an existing, active booking to a specified, authorized user; does not notify participants of this change.

tools.name: Reassign booking with uid
tools.description: Reassigns the specified booking to a new team member, who is determined by the system rather than being specified in the request.

tools.name: Refresh oauth token for client id
tools.description: Refreshes an oauth access token for a specified `clientid` and managed user using their `refreshtoken`, enabling continued api access when the current token is near or past expiry.

tools.name: Reschedule booking by uid
tools.description: Reschedules an existing booking (identified by `bookinguid`) to a new time, provided the new slot's availability is confirmed beforehand; all other rescheduling parameters (e.g., new date, time) must be sent in the post request body, not via this action's direct parameters.

tools.name: Reserve slot for event
tools.description: Temporarily reserves an available time slot for an existing and bookable event type, useful for high-demand slots to prevent double-bookings while the user completes the booking.

tools.name: Retrieve attribute options for org
tools.description: Retrieves all available options for a specific attribute within a designated organization, requiring valid and associated `orgid` and `attributeid`.

tools.name: Retrieve booking details by uid
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for an existing booking, identified by its `bookinguid`.

tools.name: Retrieve calendar busy times
tools.description: To find busy calendar slots for scheduling/conflict detection, call this with a valid `credentialid`, an `externalid` accessible by it, and a recognized iana `loggedinuserstz`; returns only busy intervals, not event details or free slots.

tools.name: Retrieve calendar list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all calendar summaries (no event details) associated with the authenticated user's account.

tools.name: Retrieve current team for organization
tools.description: Retrieves details of the team(s) for the currently authenticated user within the specified organization `orgid`.

tools.name: Retrieve default conferencing settings
tools.description: Retrieves an account's or organization's read-only default conferencing settings in cal.com (e.g., video platform, meeting duration) to inform event creation or ensure consistency.

tools.name: Retrieve event type by id
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific, existing cal.com event type using its unique id; this is a read-only action and does not return associated events or bookings.

tools.name: Retrieve membership from organization
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific membership within a particular organization.

tools.name: Retrieve my information
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's core profile information (e.g., name, email, timezone); does not retrieve related data like calendar events or schedules.

tools.name: Retrieve OAuth client user by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing user specifically associated with an existing oauth client.

tools.name: Retrieve oauth client webhook by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific webhook using its `webhookid` and the `clientid` of its associated oauth client.

tools.name: Retrieve organization attributes
tools.description: Retrieves detailed attributes (e.g., configurations, settings, metadata) for an organization, identified by its `orgid`, which must correspond to an existing organization.

tools.name: Retrieve organization attributes options
tools.description: Fetches all available attribute options for a specific user within a given organization, provided the organization and user exist and the user is part of the organization.

tools.name: Retrieve organization webhook by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information, including configuration and status, for a specific webhook by its id (`webhookid`) within a given organization (`orgid`).

tools.name: Retrieve organization webhooks by org ID
tools.description: Retrieves a list of webhooks for an organization specified by `orgid`, supporting pagination; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Retrieve provider details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing provider in the cal scheduling system using their unique client id.

tools.name: Retrieve schedules list
tools.description: Retrieves a comprehensive list of all schedules associated with the authenticated user's cal.com account or organization.

tools.name: Retrieve team details in organization
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of teams and their details for a specific organization id; individual team member details or schedules are not included.

tools.name: Retrieve team event types
tools.description: Retrieves event types for a team within the cal scheduling system; this action does not provide details on scheduled instances or member availability.

tools.name: Retrieve team membership by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information, including role and status, for a specific team membership using its id, for a given organization and team.

tools.name: Retrieve team membership details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed attributes for a specific team membership by its id and the team id, such as member information, role, and status; does not list all team members.

tools.name: Retrieve team memberships
tools.description: Retrieves a list of memberships, detailing member roles and statuses, for an existing team specified by `teamid`, with support for pagination.

tools.name: Retrieve team memberships for organization
tools.description: Retrieves all user memberships, including their roles and states, for a specific team within an organization.

tools.name: Retrieve users in organization
tools.description: Retrieves users associated with a specific organization id, excluding individual scheduling or calendar data; the `orgid` must be a valid identifier for an existing organization.

tools.name: Retrieve v2 conferencing info
tools.description: Retrieves an authenticated cal user's or organization's video conferencing configurations, capabilities, and installed apps, useful for understanding options before scheduling or verifying setups; provider availability may vary by subscription or settings.

tools.name: Retrieve webhook details for oauth client
tools.description: Retrieves a list of webhooks for a specific oauth client, supporting pagination.

tools.name: Retrieve webhooks for event type
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of webhooks (including urls, subscribed events, and status) for a specified, existing event type id, useful for auditing configurations or troubleshooting.

tools.name: Retrieve webhooks list
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of webhooks from the user's cal scheduling system account, which are used for real-time notifications on events like new bookings, cancellations, or updates.

tools.name: Save calendar entry
tools.description: Saves or updates a calendar's settings using a get request, typically for data already on the server or simple updates via query parameters.

tools.name: Save calendar ics feeds
tools.description: Imports and saves one or more publicly accessible external icalendar (ics) feed urls into the cal.com calendar system.

tools.name: Save OAuth credentials via GCal API
tools.description: Completes the google calendar oauth 2.0 flow by exchanging the `code` and `state` (received from google's redirect after user consent) for access and refresh tokens.

tools.name: Save stripe details
tools.description: Completes the stripe oauth flow by saving stripe details; call this when a user is redirected back from stripe with an authorization `code` and `state`.

tools.name: Set default conferencing app
tools.description: Sets the specified, valid, and configured conferencing application as the default for new meetings for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Update destination calendar integration
tools.description: Updates the destination calendar for syncing events, using `integration` and `externalid` (typically from `/calendars` endpoint).

tools.name: Update OAuth client user settings
tools.description: Updates specified profile and scheduling preference fields for a user associated with an oauth client; `defaultscheduleid`, if provided, must be an existing, valid schedule for the user.

tools.name: Update oauth client webhook
tools.description: Updates specified properties of an existing webhook for an oauth client; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update schedule by ID
tools.description: Updates an existing schedule by its id, allowing partial modification of properties; providing `availability` or `overrides` replaces them entirely.

tools.name: Update team information by id
tools.description: Updates an existing team's information by its id within a specified organization; the `slug`, if provided, must be unique within the organization.

tools.name: Update team membership by id
tools.description: Updates specified properties (e.g., acceptance status, role, impersonation settings) of an existing team membership, identified by `teamid` and `membershipid`, supporting partial updates where only provided fields are modified.

tools.name: Update team membership properties
tools.description: Updates attributes like acceptance status, role, or impersonation settings for an existing team membership; only provided fields are changed, and this action cannot create or delete memberships.

tools.name: Update user profile details
tools.description: Updates the profile information and preferences for the authenticated user, affecting only the fields provided in the request.

tools.name: Update user schedule in organization
tools.description: Modifies an existing schedule for a specified user within an organization by updating only the provided fields; the organization, user, and schedule must already exist.

tools.name: Update webhook by id
tools.description: Updates an existing cal.com webhook by its `webhookid`, allowing partial modification of its attributes; only explicitly provided fields will be changed.

tools.name: Update webhook for organization
tools.description: Use this action to modify settings of an already created webhook for an organization, such as its target url, active status, or the events that trigger it.

required.description: Client id of the app

required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: full

name: Wrike
description: Wrike is a project management and collaboration tool offering customizable workflows, Gantt charts, reporting, and resource management to boost team productivity

tools.name: Bulk modify group members
tools.description: Adds or removes members for multiple wrike groups in a single request; all specified user ids must correspond to existing wrike users.

tools.name: Create a folder
tools.description: Creates a new wrike subfolder within the specified `folderid`, optionally as a project if `customitemtypeid` is given; the folder is auto-shared with its creator.

tools.name: Create a group
tools.description: Creates a new user group in wrike with a specified title, optionally setting members, parent group, avatar, and custom metadata.

tools.name: Create invitation
tools.description: Invites a user to a wrike workspace by email, optionally with name, specifying either `usertypeid` or a combination of `role`/`external`; custom email subject/message available for paid accounts.

tools.name: Create task in folder
tools.description: Creates a new task in a specified wrike folder; if setting priority with `prioritybefore` or `priorityafter`, the referenced task must be in the same folder or project.

tools.name: Delete custom field by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a custom field by its id; this action is irreversible and requires a valid, existing custom field id.

tools.name: Delete folder
tools.description: Permanently deletes the folder specified by `folderid` and all its contents (e.g., tasks, documents, subfolders) from the wrike workspace; this irreversible action is for when the folder is no longer needed and has no active tasks or dependencies that would block deletion.

tools.name: Delete group by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a group by its `groupid`; this action is irreversible and does not affect user accounts that were members of the group.

tools.name: Delete invitation
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing invitation, specified by its unique `invitationid`; this action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a wrike task and all its associated data by its id; this action is irreversible and the task must exist.

tools.name: Fetch all tasks
tools.description: Fetches tasks from a wrike account, allowing filtering by status, due date, and subfolder inclusion, with customizable response fields and pagination.

tools.name: Get account information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed wrike account information, where the response content is influenced by selected fields, account subscription, and user permissions.

tools.name: Get all custom fields
tools.description: Retrieves all custom field definitions (including id, name, type, and settings) from the wrike account; this returns the definitions themselves, not their specific values on wrike items, and is useful for obtaining custom field ids.

tools.name: Get contacts
tools.description: Retrieves a list of wrike contacts (e.g., team members, clients, collaborators); response includes contact details but not their detailed task or project involvement.

tools.name: Get folders
tools.description: Retrieves folders and/or projects from wrike, with filters; when using `nextpagetoken`, all other filter parameters must match the initial request.

tools.name: Get specific contact information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific wrike contact using their unique `contactid`, optionally including `metadata` and `customfields` if specified in the `fields` parameter.

tools.name: Get specific user
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific user in wrike using their unique user id.

tools.name: Get task by id
tools.description: Retrieves read-only detailed information for a specific wrike task by its unique id, optionally allowing specification of fields to include in the response.

tools.name: Launch folder blueprint async
tools.description: Asynchronously launches a new project or folder structure in wrike from a specified folder blueprint, typically returning a task id to track progress.

tools.name: Launch Task Blueprint Async
tools.description: Asynchronously launches a wrike task blueprint to create tasks/projects, requiring either `super task id` (parent task) or `parent id` (parent folder/project) for placement.

tools.name: List Folder Blueprints
tools.description: Retrieves all account-level folder blueprints, which are templates for standardizing folder/project creation with predefined structures, custom fields, and workflows.

tools.name: List space folder blueprints
tools.description: Lists all folder blueprints (templates for new folders/projects) within a specified wrike space, requiring a valid and accessible space id.

tools.name: List space task blueprints
tools.description: Lists task blueprints (templates for creating tasks with consistent structures) available in a specific, accessible wrike space.

tools.name: List subfolders by folder id
tools.description: Lists subfolders (metadata only, not their contents) for an existing wrike folder specified by `folderid`, supporting recursive descent, filtering, and pagination.

tools.name: List Task Blueprints
tools.description: Retrieves a list of defined task blueprints (predefined task templates) from the wrike account, supporting pagination.

tools.name: Update account metadata
tools.description: Updates or adds custom key-value metadata to the wrike account, useful for integrations, storing app-specific data, or mapping external system identifiers.

tools.name: Modify folder attributes
tools.description: Modifies an existing wrike folder: updates title, description, parents (not root/recycle bin), sharing, metadata, custom fields/columns; restores, converts to project, or manages access roles.

tools.name: Modify group
tools.description: Updates an existing wrike user group's attributes like title, members, parent, avatar, or metadata, using its `groupid` and specifying only the fields to change.

tools.name: Modify task
tools.description: Modifies an existing wrike task by its id, allowing updates to attributes such as title, status, dates, assignees, and custom fields; `prioritybefore` and `priorityafter` are mutually exclusive, and parent folder ids for `addparents`/`removeparents` cannot be the recycle bin.

tools.name: Retrieve custom field by id
tools.description: Retrieves a wrike custom field's detailed information (e.g., type, possible values for dropdowns), properties, and metadata; the `customfieldid` must correspond to an existing custom field.

tools.name: Query invitations
tools.description: Retrieves all active invitations in wrike, useful for viewing and auditing pending invitations or managing user onboarding.

tools.name: Get group by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific wrike group using its `groupid`, optionally including 'metadata'.

tools.name: Query workflows
tools.description: Fetches a list of all workflows with their detailed information from the wrike account; this is a read-only action and does not support pagination or filtering through its parameters.

tools.name: Retrieve list of groups
tools.description: Retrieves a list of user groups from the wrike account, supporting metadata filtering, pagination, and inclusion of specific fields; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Update custom field by id
tools.description: Updates properties of an existing wrike custom field by its id, such as its title, type, scope, or sharing settings.

tools.name: Update invitation
tools.description: Updates a pending wrike invitation (`invitationid`) to resend it or change user's role/type (use `usertypeid` over deprecated `role`/`external`).

tools.name: Update metadata on a specific contact
tools.description: Updates metadata, job role, or custom fields for an existing wrike contact specified by `contactid`; if `jobroleid` is provided, it must be a valid id.

tools.name: Update a specific user
tools.description: Updates specified profile attributes (e.g., account id, role, external status) for an existing wrike user; unspecified fields remain unchanged.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

required.name: full
required.description: The base URL of your Wrike instance (e.g., https://www.wrike.com).

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: Exa
description: Exa focuses on data extraction and search, helping teams gather, analyze, and visualize information from websites, APIs, or internal databases

tools.name: Generate an answer
tools.description: Generates a direct, citation-backed answer to a clear natural language question or topic using exa's search, adept at both specific answers and detailed summaries for open-ended queries.

tools.name: Create Import
tools.description: Tool to create a new import to upload data into a webset. use when you need to initialize an import before uploading the data file.

tools.name: Create a Monitor
tools.description: Tool to create a new monitor. use when you need to schedule automated updates for a webset without manual runs.

tools.name: Create Webset
tools.description: Tool to create a new webset with search, import, and enrichment setup. use when you need to configure and seed a webset in one call.

tools.name: Delete import
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing import. use when you need to permanently remove an import by its id.

tools.name: Delete webset
tools.description: Tool to delete a webset. use after confirming the webset id to permanently remove the webset and all its items.

tools.name: Find similar
tools.description: Finds web pages semantically similar to a given url using embeddings-based search, optionally retrieving full text, highlights, or summaries for results.

tools.name: Get contents from URLs or document IDs
tools.description: Retrieves configurable text and highlights from a list of exa document ids or publicly accessible urls.

tools.name: Get Event
tools.description: Tool to get details of a specific event by its id. use when you have an event id and need its full details.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Tool to list all events that have occurred in the system. use when you need to paginate through the event history.

tools.name: List imports
tools.description: Tool to list all imports for the webset. use when you need to paginate through and monitor import jobs.

tools.name: List webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all webhooks for websets. use when you need to view existing webhooks and paginate through results.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Performs a web search using the exa engine, useful for queries requiring advanced filtering, specific content categories, or ai-optimized prompting.

tools.name: Update import
tools.description: Tool to update an import configuration by id. use when you need to modify an import's title or metadata.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Exa API key.

name: Sentry
description: Integrate Sentry to manage your error tracking and monitoring.

tools.name: Access project information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a sentry project, given its existing organization and project id or slug.

tools.name: Add organization member via email
tools.description: Invites a new member (or re-invites an existing non-accepted member) to a sentry organization via email, allowing specification of organization and team roles.

tools.name: Add or remove user email by id
tools.description: Adds or removes a secondary email for an existing sentry user, determined by whether the email already exists for that user.

tools.name: Add team member in organization
tools.description: Adds an existing member of an organization to one of its teams; the member must already belong to the organization, and the team must also belong to that organization.

tools.name: Add team to project
tools.description: Grants a sentry team access to a sentry project within the specified sentry organization.

tools.name: Create dashboard with widgets
tools.description: Creates a sentry dashboard with widgets for an organization; `organization id or slug` and specified `project` ids must be valid, and `start`/`end` datetimes (if absolute range) must form a logical iso 8601 range.

tools.name: Create external user for organization
tools.description: Links a sentry user to an external identity provider's user within a sentry organization; the sentry user must be an organization member, an active integration for the provider must be configured, and `external id` is typically required for the external user.

tools.name: Create organization alert rule
tools.description: Creates a sentry metric alert rule for an organization, mandating a 'critical' trigger, typically for a single project, where actions may require sentry integrations.

tools.name: Create organization monitor
tools.description: Creates a new monitor (type 'cron job') within a sentry organization to track scheduled tasks, allowing configuration of its name, slug (which must be unique if provided), status, owner, and muting preferences for incidents.

tools.name: Create organization team
tools.description: Creates a new team in a sentry organization, requiring either a 'slug' (preferred, as 'name' is deprecated) or 'name' to define the team.

tools.name: Create project key with optional rate limiting
tools.description: Creates a new client key (dsn) for an existing sentry project, with optional custom rate limit configuration.

tools.name: Create project rule for alerts
tools.description: Creates a sentry project alert rule by defining conditions, actions, and optional filters using specific json structures (detailed in parameter descriptions) to automate responses to event patterns for an existing organization and project.

tools.name: Create project webhook subscription
tools.description: Registers a new webhook subscription for a sentry project to send http post notifications to a specified url for given events, provided the project has the 'servicehooks' feature enabled.

tools.name: Create release deploy for org
tools.description: Creates a new deploy record in sentry to track the introduction of a release version into a specific environment.

tools.name: Create release for organization
tools.description: Creates a new sentry release for an existing organization, associating it with specified projects that must belong to that organization.

tools.name: Create scim group for organization
tools.description: Creates a new sentry team (scim group) within an organization where scim is enabled; a url-friendly slug is auto-generated from the `displayname` (e.g., 'my team' becomes 'my-team' by lowercasing and replacing spaces with dashes), and the team starts with no members.

tools.name: Create sentry external issue link
tools.description: Links an existing sentry issue to an issue in an external service, or updates an existing link, requiring a configured sentry app installation `uuid`.

tools.name: Create team project for organization
tools.description: Creates a new sentry project for an existing organization and team, allowing configuration of its name, slug, platform, and default alert rules.

tools.name: Create user for SAML integration
tools.description: Creates a new sentry organization member via a scim request for saml integration; this action does not support setting secondary emails.

tools.name: Delete dsyms for project
tools.description: Permanently removes a specific debug information file (dif), used for symbolicating crash reports, from the specified sentry project and organization.

tools.name: Delete external issue by uuid
tools.description: Unlinks an external issue (e.g., from jira/github), identified by `external issue id`, from the sentry app installation specified by `uuid`.

tools.name: Delete an external team by id
tools.description: Unlinks a previously established external team from a sentry team; this action does not delete either the sentry team or the external team.

tools.name: Delete external user from organization
tools.description: Deletes the link between an external user (e.g., from an sso provider) and a sentry user within the specified sentry organization.

tools.name: Delete member from team
tools.description: Removes an organization member from a sentry team, revoking their team-specific permissions, provided the member is currently part of that team.

tools.name: Delete organization alert rule
tools.description: Deletes a specific metric alert rule within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Delete organization dashboard
tools.description: Deletes a custom dashboard or tombstones (marks as deleted) a pre-built dashboard within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Delete organization discover query
tools.description: Permanently removes a specific saved discover query (a configuration for exploring event data) from a sentry organization.

tools.name: Delete organization integration
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific integration previously installed for the sentry organization.

tools.name: Delete organization issue
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific sentry issue, identified by its id, from an organization; this operation is irreversible and idempotent.

tools.name: Delete organization member
tools.description: Permanently removes a member from a sentry organization, revoking their access to that organization and all its associated projects.

tools.name: Delete organization monitor
tools.description: Deletes a sentry cron monitor or, if `environment` is specified, only specific environments within that monitor.

tools.name: Delete organization release
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly removes a sentry release, including all its associated files, identified by its version from the specified organization.

tools.name: Delete org notification action
tools.description: Deletes a specific spike protection notification action for a sentry organization, where `action id` must be a valid action associated with the `organization id or slug`.

tools.name: Delete project by id
tools.description: Schedules a sentry project for asynchronous deletion within a specified organization, hiding it from most public views once the process begins.

tools.name: Delete project hook
tools.description: Deletes a specific service hook from a sentry project using its organization, project, and hook identifiers.

tools.name: Delete project issues
tools.description: Permanently removes specified issues from a sentry project; if no issue ids are provided, it removes the oldest 1000 issues.

tools.name: Delete project key
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific client key (dsn) for a project, preventing it from being used to send events to sentry.

tools.name: Delete project monitor
tools.description: Deletes a sentry monitor, or optionally only its specified environments, for a given project.

tools.name: Delete project replay
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific sentry session replay (a video-like reproduction of user interactions, including console logs and network activity) from the specified project and organization.

tools.name: Delete project rule
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific issue alert rule from an existing project within an existing sentry organization.

tools.name: Delete a project symbol source
tools.description: Deletes a specific custom symbol source from a project.

tools.name: Delete project team association
tools.description: Revokes a team's access to a sentry project; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Delete release file
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific file from an existing release, project, and organization; this action is idempotent.

tools.name: Delete release file by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific build artifact (e.g., source map, application bundle) associated with a release.

tools.name: Delete team by organization and team slug
tools.description: Schedules a sentry team for asynchronous deletion, which releases the team's slug for reuse upon successful scheduling.

tools.name: Delete a team from an organization (SCIM v2)
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specific team from a sentry organization via a scim v2 request, provided scim integration is enabled for the organization.

tools.name: Delete user emails by id
tools.description: Permanently removes a sentry user's email address; if multiple emails exist, sentry's api logic (e.g., primary or previously marked) determines which is deleted.

tools.name: Delete user from org
tools.description: Removes a scim-managed member from a sentry organization that has scim enabled, permanently revoking their access.

tools.name: Fetch issue event by id
tools.description: Retrieves the 'latest', 'oldest', or 'recommended' event for a sentry issue, optionally filtered by environment(s).

tools.name: Fetch organization alert rules
tools.description: Retrieves a list of active metric alert rules for an existing sentry organization, identified by its id or slug.

tools.name: Fetch organization release threshold statuses
tools.description: Retrieves derived health statuses for release thresholds in a sentry organization for a given time range, optionally filtered by environment, project, or release; `start` and `end` times must be provided together. **`[warning]`**: this api is experimental (alpha) and subject to change!

tools.name: Fetch organization replay count
tools.description: Retrieves the total count of session replays for a specified sentry organization, filterable by time range, environment, project, and query.

tools.name: Fetch organization replay details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific replay session by id within a sentry organization, optionally filtering time-series data using `statsperiod` or `start`/`end`, and further refining by projects, environments, or specific fields.

tools.name: Fetch organization replay selectors
tools.description: Fetches replay selectors (css selectors for session replays) for a sentry organization, filterable by various criteria; use either `statsperiod` or `start`/`end` for time range, not both.

tools.name: Fetch project environment details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific environment within a sentry project.

tools.name: Fetch project ownership details
tools.description: Retrieves the ownership configuration, like codeowners rules or issue owner settings, for a specified sentry project.

tools.name: Fetch project release files
tools.description: Retrieves artifact files (e.g., source maps, debug information files) for a specific release version in a sentry project; requires existing organization, project, and release version with associated files.

tools.name: Fetch project replay clicks
tools.description: Fetches a list of user click interactions for a specific sentry session replay, including the clicked dom element id and timestamp.

tools.name: Fetch replay recording segment
tools.description: Retrieves a specific recording segment for a sentry replay, requiring valid organization, project, replay, and segment identifiers.

tools.name: Get activation of alert rule for organization
tools.description: Retrieves all activations (triggered instances) for a specific metric alert rule within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Get integration details by org
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific integration, identified by `integration id`, installed within an existing sentry organization, identified by `organization id or slug`.

tools.name: Get organization by id or slug
tools.description: Retrieves a sentry organization by its id or slug; use the `detailed` parameter to optionally exclude project and team details for a more concise response.

tools.name: Get organization details
tools.description: Retrieves sentry organizations accessible via the current authentication, with scope varying between user (all in region) and api key (linked org only) credentials.

tools.name: Get organization environments
tools.description: Retrieves a list of deployment environments (e.g., 'production', 'staging') for a sentry organization, optionally filtering by visibility.

tools.name: Get organization issue details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific issue within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Get organization monitor by id or slug
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific monitor (e.g., a cron job or scheduled task) within an organization.

tools.name: Get organization release version
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information, including optional health data and statistics, for a specific release version within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Get organization sessions
tools.description: Retrieves time series data for an organization's sentry project release health sessions; note session duration data (e.g., using `avg(session.duration)`) may be incomplete after jan 12, 2023, results are capped at 10,000 data points, `statsperiod` overrides `start`/`end` timestamps, and the `interval` parameter (default/min '1h', max '1d', format like `statsperiod`) dictates time series resolution and must cleanly divide one day.

tools.name: Get organization stats summary
tools.description: Retrieves summarized event statistics for a sentry organization, aggregated by project, allowing queries for event counts or unique occurrences over a specified time period and resolution, with filtering by project, category, and outcome.

tools.name: Get project events
tools.description: Retrieves a list of error events for a specified project within a sentry organization, with options for pagination and detail level.

tools.name: Get project event stats
tools.description: Retrieves event statistics for a specified sentry project, returning data as [timestamp, count] pairs; ensure `since` precedes `until` if both are provided.

tools.name: Get project hook
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing service hook, identified by `hook id`, within a specific sentry project and organization.

tools.name: Get project list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of sentry projects (representing monitored applications or services), useful for discovery or selecting a project for subsequent operations.

tools.name: Get project monitor by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific sentry cron monitor, provided the organization, project, and monitor exist.

tools.name: Get project rule details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific issue alert rule within a sentry project.

tools.name: Get scim group by team id
tools.description: Retrieves scim group information for a sentry team, if scim is enabled for the organization; the 'members' list in the response is limited to 10,000 entries.

tools.name: Get sentry app installations for organization
tools.description: Retrieves a list of sentry app installations for a given organization, which must exist.

tools.name: Get team members by id or slug
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all active members for a sentry team, excluding users with pending invitations.

tools.name: Get who viewed replay by project
tools.description: Retrieves users who viewed a specific, existing session replay within a sentry project and organization.

tools.name: List organization dashboards
tools.description: Retrieves a list of custom dashboards for a sentry organization, with pagination support.

tools.name: List organization members
tools.description: Lists all members, including those with pending invitations, for a sentry organization.

tools.name: List organization releases
tools.description: Retrieves a list of releases for an existing sentry organization, optionally filtering by a query string that matches the start of the release version.

tools.name: List organization repositories
tools.description: Retrieves a list of version control repositories for a specific sentry organization, which must exist and is identified by its id or slug.

tools.name: List organization user teams
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all teams that the authenticated user has access to within the specified sentry organization.

tools.name: List project users
tools.description: Retrieves users who have interacted with or are recognized within a specific sentry project, optionally filtered by a query.

tools.name: List SCIM v2 organization users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of scim (system for cross-domain identity management) users for a sentry organization, allowing for filtering, pagination, and attribute exclusion.

tools.name: List teams in organization
tools.description: Lists teams for an existing sentry organization, optionally including project details and supporting pagination via a cursor.

tools.name: Create an external team
tools.description: Links an external team or channel (e.g., slack, github) to an existing sentry team, using a pre-configured integration for the specified provider and its valid sentry integration id.

tools.name: Modify organization monitor data
tools.description: Updates an existing sentry monitor's properties, requiring `name` and `type` (must be 'cron job'), and optionally `slug`, `status`, `owner`, or `is muted` state for a monitor within the specified organization.

tools.name: Modify organization notification action
tools.description: Modifies an organization's notification action, specifically for `spike-protection` triggers.

tools.name: Modify organization settings
tools.description: Updates settings for a sentry organization, such as name, slug, member roles, privacy, and integrations; if `avatartype` is 'upload', `avatar` (base64 image) is required.

tools.name: Modify release file attributes
tools.description: Updates attributes (e.g., name, distribution) of a specific file within an existing release, identified by organization, version, and file id.

tools.name: Patch SCIM group operations
tools.description: Performs scim patch operations (rfc 7644) to update attributes of a scim-enabled sentry team, provided scim integration is active for the organization.

tools.name: Deactivate an organization member
tools.description: Deactivates and permanently deletes a sentry organization member by using a scim patch operation to set their 'active' attribute to 'false'.

tools.name: Add a symbol source to a project
tools.description: Adds a new custom symbol source (http, gcs, or s3) to a project for fetching debug symbols; if an `id` is provided, it must be unique for the project and not start with 'sentry:'.

tools.name: Enable spike protection for an organization
tools.description: Enables or updates spike protection for specified projects (or all projects using `['$all']`) within an existing sentry organization, to which the projects must belong.

tools.name: Retrieve alert rule details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific metric alert rule within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve commit files for release
tools.description: Retrieves files changed in commits for a specified sentry release; the release must exist and have linked commits.

tools.name: Retrieve an organization's repository commits
tools.description: Retrieves a list of commits for a given repository within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve dsym files for project
tools.description: Retrieve a list of debug information files (dsym files) for a specified sentry project, used for symbolication to display human-readable stack traces.

tools.name: Retrieve event id for organization
tools.description: Resolves a sentry event id to its project and issue details within an accessible sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve files for release
tools.description: Retrieves artifact files for a specific release version in a sentry organization; the organization and release must exist, and the response `data` field will contain the file information as a dictionary.

tools.name: Retrieve issue events by id
tools.description: Retrieves events for a specified sentry `issue id`, which must be an existing issue.

tools.name: Retrieve issue hashes for organization
tools.description: Retrieves a list of grouping checksums (hashes) generated by sentry for a specific issue within an organization, used for understanding event aggregation.

tools.name: Retrieve issue tag details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information (e.g., top values, counts) for a specific tag key on an existing sentry issue; results are paginated (max 1000 values per page).

tools.name: Retrieve monitor checkins
tools.description: Retrieves the history of check-ins for a sentry monitor, providing insights into the health and performance of associated scheduled tasks.

tools.name: Retrieve monitor checkins by org
tools.description: Retrieves check-ins (pings/heartbeats of a monitored cron job or task) for a specific monitor within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve notification action by org id
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific spike protection notification action, which defines alerts for triggered spike protection rules, within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve organization dashboard
tools.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific custom dashboard within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve organization events
tools.description: Retrieves discover event data for a sentry organization; the `sort` field must be in the `field` list (not an equation), and `field` has a 20-item limit.

tools.name: Retrieve organization integrations list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of available integrations for an existing sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve organization member
tools.description: Retrieves details for a sentry organization member or pending invitee, including role, teams, and status, using their member id and the organization's id or slug.

tools.name: Retrieve organization monitors
tools.description: Retrieves cron monitors for a sentry organization, including details of nested monitor environments.

tools.name: Retrieve organization projects
tools.description: Retrieves a list of sentry projects for a specified organization (which must be accessible), supporting pagination via cursor.

tools.name: Retrieve organization relay usage
tools.description: Retrieves relay usage information, primarily a list of trusted relays, for a specified sentry organization, which must have relay usage enabled.

tools.name: Retrieve organization release commits
tools.description: Retrieves a list of commits for a given release version in an existing sentry organization, if the release exists.

tools.name: Retrieve organization replays
tools.description: Fetches session replays for a sentry organization; use `statsperiod` for relative time, or `start` and `end` (used together) for absolute time ranges.

tools.name: Retrieve organization SCIM groups
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of scim groups (teams) for a sentry organization; the `members` field in the response for each group will contain at most 10,000 members.

tools.name: Retrieve organization stats v2
tools.description: Retrieves sentry organization event statistics; specify time range with `statsperiod` or both `start`/`end`; note that grouping by `project` returns a sum not a time-series, and `interval` (if used) must be 1h-1d and cleanly divide 24 hours.

tools.name: Retrieve org integration config
tools.description: Retrieves configuration for all integrations, or a specific integration if `providerkey` is given, for an existing sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve project environments
tools.description: Retrieves a list of environments for an existing project within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve project event by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific sentry event using its id, organization identifier, and project identifier.

tools.name: Retrieve project filter data
tools.description: Retrieves a sentry project's current data filtering settings, used to ignore events from sources like localhost, web crawlers, or legacy browsers.

tools.name: Retrieve project hooks
tools.description: Return a list of service hooks (webhooks) bound to a sentry project, used to send notifications to external services upon event occurrences.

tools.name: Retrieve project issues list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of issues for a sentry project, defaulting to unresolved issues unless an empty `query` string is provided or specific `hashes` are used.

tools.name: Retrieve project key details
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific client key (dsn) for a sentry project, which is used by sentry sdks to send event data.

tools.name: List a project's client keys
tools.description: Retrieves a list of client keys (dsns), used by sentry sdks to send events, for a specified project within an organization.

tools.name: Retrieve project members list
tools.description: Retrieves active organization members belonging to any team assigned to the specified sentry project.

tools.name: Retrieve project release file details
tools.description: Retrieves metadata (default) or raw content (if `download` is true) for a specific file within a sentry project's release version.

tools.name: Retrieve project rules by org and project id
tools.description: Retrieves a list of active issue alert rules associated with a specific project within an organization.

tools.name: Retrieve project symbol sources
tools.description: Retrieves custom symbol sources for a sentry project, either listing all or fetching a specific one if its id is provided.

tools.name: Retrieve project tag values
tools.description: Retrieves up to 1000 unique values for a specified tag key that has been recorded for events within a sentry project.

tools.name: Retrieve project teams
tools.description: Retrieves a list of teams with explicit access to a specific project within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve release commits
tools.description: Retrieves a list of commits associated with a specific release version within a sentry project.

tools.name: Retrieve release deployments
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all deployment records for a specific release version in an organization, detailing each deployment's environment and timestamps.

tools.name: Retrieve release file by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific file's content or its metadata from a sentry release, using the `download` parameter to choose between raw content or json metadata.

tools.name: Retrieve replay recording segments
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of recording segments for a specific sentry replay, used for reconstructing or analyzing the replay.

tools.name: Retrieve saved discover queries
tools.description: Retrieves a list of saved discover queries for a sentry organization, optionally filtered and sorted.

tools.name: Retrieve saved discover query for organization
tools.description: Retrieves a specific saved discover query (a predefined set of filters and conditions for exploring event data) for a sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve short id for organization
tools.description: Resolves an existing sentry short id to its issue details within a valid sentry organization.

tools.name: Retrieve source map debug event
tools.description: Retrieves detailed debug information for diagnosing source map processing issues for a specific sentry event, stack trace frame, and exception index.

tools.name: Retrieve team info
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing sentry team within its organization, optionally expanding related data (e.g., projects) or collapsing sections (e.g., organization details).

tools.name: Retrieve team projects
tools.description: Retrieves a list of sentry projects for a specific team within an organization, supporting pagination via a cursor.

tools.name: Retrieve user email information
tools.description: Retrieves a list of email addresses for an existing sentry user, identified by their `user id`.

tools.name: Retrieve user feedback for project
tools.description: Retrieves user feedback for a project from sentry's older 'user reports' system, excluding feedback from the modern 'user feedback widget'.

tools.name: Retrieve user via SCIM API
tools.description: Retrieves an individual sentry organization member's details accessible via scim v2 using their member id, noting that `firstname` and `lastname` in the response will be 'n/a'.

tools.name: Save organization discover query
tools.description: Saves a new discover query with a unique name for a sentry organization, allowing reuse of search criteria for analyzing event data (errors, transactions) across specified projects and environments.

tools.name: Fetch Tag Values for Issue
tools.description: Retrieves a list of distinct values for a specified tag key associated with an existing sentry issue, useful for understanding tag manifestations like browser versions or affected users.

tools.name: Submit notification action API data
tools.description: Creates a sentry notification action for 'spike-protection' triggers, requiring `integration id` if `service type` is 'slack', 'pagerduty', or 'opsgenie', and `target identifier`/`target display` if `service type` is 'slack' or 'opsgenie'.

tools.name: Submit project user feedback
tools.description: Deprecated: submits user feedback for a sentry project event (use if newer sentry feedback tools are unavailable); submit within 30 mins of event, overwritable within 5 mins.

tools.name: Switch team role for member
tools.description: Changes a member's role within a sentry team, ensuring the member is already part of the team and that any organization-level role restrictions are respected.

tools.name: Toggle project filter status
tools.description: Updates the status or configuration of a specific inbound data filter for a sentry project; use `active` for most filters, or `subfilters` if `filter id` is `legacy-browser`.

tools.name: Update environment visibility
tools.description: Updates the visibility of a specific environment within a sentry project.

tools.name: Update external team integration
tools.description: Updates an existing external team integration's display name, provider, sentry integration id, or external id; the `integration id` must match a valid, configured sentry integration for the organization and the specified `provider`.

tools.name: Update external user for organization
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing external user linkage (identified by `external user id`) within a sentry organization (specified by `organization id or slug`).

tools.name: Update issue attributes in organization
tools.description: Updates specified attributes of an existing sentry issue within a sentry organization, leaving other attributes unchanged.

tools.name: Update organization alert rules
tools.description: Replaces an existing sentry metric alert rule's configuration; fields not provided in the request are removed or reset.

tools.name: Update organization dashboard
tools.description: Updates an existing custom dashboard, allowing modifications to its title, widgets, and data filters; providing `widgets`, `projects`, `environment`, `period`, `start`, `end`, or `filters` will overwrite existing settings for those fields.

tools.name: Update organization member role
tools.description: Updates a sentry organization member's organization-level role (`orgrole`) and/or their team roles (`teamroles`), ensuring the initiator has permissions equivalent to both the member's current and intended new `orgrole` if `orgrole` is being modified.

tools.name: Update project details
tools.description: Updates a sentry project's settings (e.g., name, slug, platform, bookmark status); `isbookmarked` can be updated with `project:read` permission, other fields typically require `project:write` or `project:admin` permissions.

tools.name: Update project issue status and details
tools.description: Bulk update attributes of issues in a sentry project, targeting issues by a list of ids or by a query status (which implies updating all matching issues if ids are omitted).

tools.name: Update project key configuration
tools.description: Updates configuration settings (e.g., name, status, rate limits, sdk options) for an existing sentry client key (dsn), identified by `key id`, within a specified `project id or slug` and `organization id or slug`.

tools.name: Update project monitor
tools.description: Updates an existing sentry monitor (used for tracking recurring tasks/cron jobs) within a specific organization and project, allowing modification of its properties such as name, slug, type, status, owner, and muting status.

tools.name: Update project ownership settings
tools.description: Updates the ownership configuration settings (raw rules, fallthrough, auto-assignment, codeowners sync) for a sentry project; omitted attributes retain their current values.

tools.name: Update project release file details
tools.description: Updates the name (path) or distribution identifier of a specific file within an existing project release in sentry.

tools.name: Update Project Rule By Id
tools.description: Updates an existing sentry project issue alert rule by `rule id`, completely overwriting it; all rule fields must be provided in the request, as omitted fields may be cleared or reset to defaults.

tools.name: Update release details for organization
tools.description: Updates an existing sentry release's details for an organization, including its reference, url, release date, associated commits, or repository references.

tools.name: Update a saved query for an organization
tools.description: Updates an existing discover saved query for a sentry organization.

tools.name: Update symbol source settings
tools.description: Updates an existing custom symbol source's settings in a sentry project, such as its type, name, layout preferences, and connection parameters.

tools.name: Update team information by organization id
tools.description: Updates the slug for an existing team within a sentry organization.

tools.name: Update user email
tools.description: Updates the primary email for a sentry user; the new email must be valid and not already in use as a primary email by another sentry account.

tools.name: Update webhook configuration
tools.description: Updates an existing sentry service hook's target url and subscribed event types for a given project and organization.

tools.name: Upload dsyms file to project
tools.description: Uploads a dsym (debug symbols) zip archive, containing an apple .dsym folder, to the specified sentry project for symbolicating crash reports from apple platforms.

tools.name: Upload file to project release
tools.description: Uploads a file to a sentry project release, for an existing organization, project, and version; uses `multipart/form-data` and the region-specific sentry domain.

tools.name: Upload release file to organization
tools.description: Uploads a new file, such as a source map or debug information, to an existing release version in a sentry organization.

tools.name: View organization notification actions
tools.description: Retrieves spike protection notification actions for a sentry organization, filterable by project ids or slugs (slugs take precedence); if `triggertype` is used, it must be 'spike-protection'.

name: Snowflake
