tools.description: Updates the position of an existing checklist on a trello card.

tools.name: Update label attributes
tools.description: Updates an existing trello label's attributes (color, name, or associated board) by its id; the label must exist.

tools.name: Update label color
tools.description: Updates the color of an existing trello label, or removes its color if 'null' is specified for the value.

tools.name: Update label name
tools.description: Updates the name of an existing trello label, identified by `idlabel`; an empty string for `value` clears the label's name but does not delete the label.

tools.name: Update list attributes
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing trello list, such as name, position, archive status, board, or copies cards from another list, provided the list `idlist` exists.

tools.name: Update lists closed status
tools.description: Updates whether an existing trello list is closed (archived); a closed list is hidden from the board view but not deleted and can be re-opened.

tools.name: Move list to board
tools.description: Moves an existing trello list (identified by `idlist`) to an existing destination board (board id in `value`), optionally setting its new position (`pos`).

tools.name: Update list name
tools.description: Updates the name of an existing trello list, identified by its id; this only changes the list's name, not its cards or position.

tools.name: Update list position
tools.description: Changes a trello list's order on a board to 'top', 'bottom', or a specified numeric position, affecting only its position.

tools.name: Update list subscription
tools.description: Updates the subscription status for a trello list, allowing the user to subscribe or unsubscribe to control notifications.

tools.name: Update Member Board Background
tools.description: Updates an existing board background's properties (brightness, image file, or tiling) for a specified trello member, using their id and the board background id.

tools.name: Update member avatar source
tools.description: Updates the avatar source for a specified trello member.

tools.name: Update member saved search
tools.description: Updates an existing trello member's saved search (name, position, or query) identified by `idmember` and `idsavedsearch`.

tools.name: Update member saved search name
tools.description: Updates a trello member's saved search display name (not its criteria), identified by `idmember` and `idsavedsearch`; the search must exist and belong to the member.

tools.name: Update member saved search position
tools.description: Updates the position of a specified saved search for a trello member; other attributes of the saved search or member remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update member saved search query
tools.description: Updates the query string of an existing saved search for a trello member.

tools.name: Update member bio
tools.description: Updates the bio of a specified trello member.

tools.name: Update member by ID
tools.description: Updates an existing trello member's profile information, preferences, or username.

tools.name: Update member's custom board background
tools.description: Updates a specific existing custom board background for a trello member.

tools.name: Update member full name by id
tools.description: Updates the full name for a trello member, identified by their valid id or username; this operation only affects the full name, leaving other profile information unchanged.

tools.name: Update member initials
tools.description: Updates the initials for a specified trello member, identified by their id or username.

tools.name: Update member color blind preference
tools.description: Updates a trello member's color blind preference, which only changes their specific display without affecting others.

tools.name: Update member locale preference
tools.description: Updates a trello member's locale preference; affects date/time display (not existing content translation) and an empty `value` may reset to default.

tools.name: Update Member Summary Interval
tools.description: Updates a trello member's preference for the frequency of email summary notifications; this setting affects only summary notifications.

tools.name: Update member username
tools.description: Updates the username for an existing trello member, identified by their id or current username.

tools.name: Update notification status by id
tools.description: Updates only the 'unread' status of a specific trello notification.

tools.name: Update notification unread status
tools.description: Marks an existing and accessible trello notification as read or unread.

tools.name: Update organization attributes
tools.description: Updates various attributes of an existing trello organization, identified by `idorg`.

tools.name: Update organization description
tools.description: Updates or clears the description for an existing trello organization, identified by its id or name, to a new string up to 16384 characters.

tools.name: Update organization display name
tools.description: Updates the display name of a trello organization, identifiable by its current id or name (`idorg`), to the new `value`; other attributes remain unaffected.

tools.name: Update an organization member
tools.description: Adds/updates a member in a specified trello organization (`idorg`); `email` and `type` are api-required, `fullname` is needed if `email` is new to trello.

tools.name: Update organization member
tools.description: Updates a member's details (email, full name, or type) in a trello organization, applying changes only to the fields provided.

tools.name: Update organization name by id
tools.description: Updates the unique programmatic identifier (used in urls and api interactions) for an existing trello organization; this is an irreversible operation, effective immediately, and only affects this identifier.

tools.name: Update organization Google Apps version
tools.description: Updates the google apps integration version preference for a specified trello organization, to manage compatibility or features related to google workspace services.

tools.name: Update organization invite restriction
tools.description: Modifies a trello organization's invitation policy using an email, domain, or keyword rule, affecting only future invites, not existing members.

tools.name: Update organization permission level
tools.description: Updates a trello organization's `permissionlevel` preference, determining if it's members-only or link-accessible, and affecting new board default visibility.

tools.name: Update organization website
tools.description: Updates the website url for a specified trello organization.

tools.name: Update an organization's associated domain preferences
tools.description: Updates or removes the google workspace domain associated with a trello organization, often to configure features like sso or automatic user provisioning.

tools.name: Update organization board visibility preference
tools.description: Updates the preference controlling who can set board visibility to 'organization-visible' within an existing trello organization.

tools.name: Update an organization's external members access
tools.description: Updates the 'externalmembersdisabled' preference for a trello organization to control whether non-members can be added to its boards.

tools.name: Update org member deactivation status
tools.description: Updates a member's deactivation status in an organization; 'true' deactivates (suspends access temporarily), 'false' reactivates.

tools.name: Update org membership
tools.description: Updates a trello organization member's type to 'admin', 'normal', or 'observer', using the organization and membership ids.

tools.name: Update organization private board visibility restriction
tools.description: Updates the organization's preference controlling who is permitted to change the visibility of its private boards; requires admin privileges for the organization.

tools.name: Update organization public board visibility
tools.description: Updates the restriction on who can set board visibility to public for a specified trello organization.

tools.name: Update session by id
tools.description: Updates a trello user session's viewed board id or status; call when user activity or board focus changes.

tools.name: Update session status by ID
tools.description: Updates the status of an existing trello session.

tools.name: Update a token's webhook
tools.description: Updates an existing webhook's description, callback url, or monitored trello model id, using the api token in the path to identify the webhook; any new `idmodel` must be accessible by the token.

tools.name: Update webhooks
tools.description: Updates an existing trello webhook's description, active status, callback url, or monitored model id; requires the webhook id (not in request body) to be specified, typically via url path.

tools.name: Update webhook active status
tools.description: Updates the active status ('true' or 'false') of an existing trello webhook specified by `idwebhook`, without affecting other properties.

tools.name: Update webhook configuration
tools.description: Updates an existing trello webhook's configuration, avoiding the need to delete and recreate it for modifications.

tools.name: Update webhook callback url
tools.description: Updates the callback url for a specific trello webhook; other webhook attributes remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update webhook description
tools.description: Updates the description of an existing trello webhook; an empty string for the new description removes the current one.

tools.name: Update webhook idModel
tools.description: Updates the `idmodel` (the monitored trello entity like a board, list, or card) for an active webhook `idwebhook` to the new model id `value`; other webhook properties are unaffected.

triggers.name: Card Archived Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a card is archived in the specified board

triggers.name: New Activity Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when there is activity in Trello.

triggers.name: New Board Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a board is created in the specified workspace

triggers.name: New Card Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a card is created in the specified board

triggers.name: Card Updated Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a specific card is updated

required.name: consumer_key
required.description: Consumer key of the app

required.name: consumer_secret
required.description: Consumer secret of the app

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

optional.name: bearer_token
optional.description: Access token injected automatically after OAuth2 authentication flow.

name: Apollo
description: Apollo provides CRM and lead generation capabilities, helping businesses discover contacts, manage outreach, and track sales pipelines for consistent customer relationship development

tools.name: Add Contacts to Sequence
tools.description: Adds contacts to a specified apollo email sequence by initiating an asynchronous background job and returning its details.

tools.name: Bulk organization enrichment
tools.description: Enriches data for up to 10 organizations simultaneously by providing a list of their base company domains (e.g., 'apollo.io', not 'www.apollo.io').

tools.name: Bulk people enrichment
tools.description: Use to enrich multiple person profiles simultaneously with comprehensive data from apollo's database.

tools.name: Bulk update account stage
tools.description: Bulk updates the stage for specified existing apollo.io accounts, moving them to a valid new account stage.

tools.name: Create an Apollo account
tools.description: Creates a new account in apollo.io; a new record is created even if a similar account exists, and provided `owner id` or `account stage id` must be valid existing ids.

tools.name: Create Apollo contact
tools.description: Creates a new contact in apollo.io; use `account id` to link to an organization and `contact stage id` for sales stage, noting that apollo does not perform automatic deduplication.

tools.name: Create Apollo deal
tools.description: Creates a new sales opportunity (deal) in apollo.io; all provided ids (`owner id`, `account id`, `opportunity stage id`) must be valid existing apollo identifiers.

tools.name: Create Apollo Task
tools.description: Creates a distinct apollo.io task for each contact id in contact ids, assigning them to user id; this action is not for free plan users and repeated calls create duplicate tasks.

tools.name: Get Labels
tools.description: Retrieves all labels from apollo.io, used for organizing contacts and accounts.

tools.name: Get opportunity stages
tools.description: Retrieves all configured opportunity (deal) stages from the apollo.io account.

tools.name: Get Organization Job Postings
tools.description: Retrieves paginated job postings for a specified organization by its id, optionally filtering by domain; ensure `organization id` is a valid identifier.

tools.name: Get typed custom fields
tools.description: Retrieves all typed custom field definitions available in the apollo.io instance, detailing their types and configurations.

tools.name: List Apollo account stages
tools.description: Retrieves all available apollo.io account stages, each including its unique id and name.

tools.name: List apollo contact stages
tools.description: Retrieves all available contact stages from an apollo account, including their unique ids and names.

tools.name: List Apollo deals
tools.description: Retrieves a list of deals from apollo, using apollo's default sort order if 'sort by field' is omitted.

tools.name: List email accounts
tools.description: Retrieves all email accounts and their details for the authenticated user; takes no parameters.

tools.name: List Apollo Users
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all users (teammates) associated with the apollo account, supporting pagination via `page` and `per page` parameters.

tools.name: Enrich organization data
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive organization enrichment data from apollo.io for a given company domain; results are most meaningful if the company exists in apollo's database.

tools.name: Search organizations in Apollo
tools.description: Searches apollo's database for organizations using various filters; consumes credits (unavailable on free plans), retrieves a maximum of 50,000 records, and uses `page` (1-500) and `per page` (1-100) for pagination.

tools.name: Enrich person with Apollo
tools.description: Enriches and retrieves information for a person from apollo.io, requiring one of: `email`, `hashed email`, `id`, `linkedin url`, or (`first name` and `last name` with `organization name` or `domain`) for matching; `webhook url` must be provided if `reveal phone number` is true.

tools.name: Apollo people search
tools.description: Searches apollo's contact database for people using various filters; results are limited to 50,000 records and this action does not enrich contact data.

tools.name: Search Apollo Accounts
tools.description: Searches for accounts within your existing apollo.io database using various criteria; requires a paid plan and is limited to 50,000 records.

tools.name: Search Apollo contacts
tools.description: Searches apollo contacts using keywords, stage ids (from 'list contact stages' action), or sorting (max 50,000 records; `sort ascending` requires `sort by field`).

tools.name: Search sequences
tools.description: Searches for sequences (e.g., automated email campaigns) in apollo.io.

tools.name: Search tasks
tools.description: Searches for tasks in apollo.io using filters like keywords, date ranges (due, created, updated), priorities, types, assigned users, associated contacts/accounts, supporting sorting and pagination.

tools.name: Update an Apollo account
tools.description: Updates specified attributes of an existing account in apollo.io.

tools.name: Update Apollo contact
tools.description: Updates specified attributes of an existing apollo.io contact, identified by `contact id`; requires at least one other attribute to be provided for modification.

tools.name: Update contact ownership
tools.description: Updates the ownership of specified apollo contacts to a given apollo user, who must be part of the same team.

tools.name: Update contact stage
tools.description: Updates the stage for one or more existing contacts in apollo.io to a new valid contact stage, useful for managing sales funnel progression.

tools.name: Update contact status in sequence
tools.description: Updates a contact's status within a designated apollo sequence, but cannot set the status to 'active'.

tools.name: Update Apollo deal
tools.description: Updates specified fields of an existing apollo.io deal (opportunity), requiring a valid `opportunity id`.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Apollo API key for authentication. Obtain it from your Apollo settings.

name: Semrush
description: Semrush is a popular SEO tool suite that specializes in keyword research, competitor analysis, and Google Ad campaign optimization.

tools.name: Get ad copies
tools.description: Retrieves unique ad copies semrush has observed for a specified domain from a regional database, detailing ads seen in google's paid search results.

tools.name: Get anchor texts
tools.description: Use this action to get a csv report of anchor texts for backlinks pointing to a specified, publicly accessible domain, root domain, or url.

tools.name: Get authority score profile
tools.description: Retrieves the authority score (as) profile for a specified target, showing the count of referring domains that link to the target for each as value from 0 to 100.

tools.name: Get backlinks
tools.description: Fetches backlinks for a specified domain or url as a csv-formatted string, allowing customization of columns, sorting, and filtering; ensure `display limit` surpasses `display offset` when an offset is used, and note the `urlanchor` filter may have limitations for targets with extensive backlinks.

tools.name: Backlinks overview
tools.description: Provides a csv-formatted summary of backlinks, including authority score and link type breakdowns, for a specified and publicly accessible domain, root domain, or url.

tools.name: Batch comparison
tools.description: Compares backlink profiles for multiple specified targets (domains, subdomains, or urls) to analyze and compare link-building efforts.

tools.name: Batch keyword overview
tools.description: Fetches a keyword overview report from a semrush regional database for up to 100 keywords, providing metrics like search volume, cpc, and keyword difficulty.

tools.name: Broad match keyword
tools.description: Fetches broad match keywords for a given phrase; `display sort` and `display filter` parameters are defined but currently not utilized by the api call.

tools.name: Get categories
tools.description: Retrieves categories and their 0-1 confidence ratings for a specified domain, subdomain, or url, with results sorted by rating.

tools.name: Get categories profile
tools.description: Retrieves a profile of content categories from referring domains for a specified target, analyzing its first 10,000 referring domains and sorting results by domain count.

tools.name: Get competitor data
tools.description: Retrieves a customizable csv report of competitors for a specified target (root domain, domain, or url) based on shared backlinks or referring domains, ensuring the target is valid and its type is correctly specified.

tools.name: Get competitors in organic search
tools.description: Use to get a domain's organic search competitors from semrush as a semicolon-separated string; `display date` requires 'yyyymm15' format if used.

tools.name: Get competitors in paid search
tools.description: Retrieves a list of a domain's competitors in paid search results from a specified regional database.

tools.name: Get domain ad history
tools.description: Retrieves a domain's 12-month advertising history from semrush (keywords bid on, ad positions, ad copy) for ppc strategy and competitor analysis; most effective when the domain has ad history in the selected database.

tools.name: Get domain organic pages
tools.description: Fetches a report on a domain's unique organic pages ranking in google's top 100 search results, with options for specifying database, date, columns, sorting, and filtering.

tools.name: Get domain organic search keywords
tools.description: Retrieves organic search keywords for a domain from a specified semrush regional database; `display positions` must be set if `display daily=1` for daily updates.

tools.name: Get domain organic subdomains
tools.description: Retrieves a report on subdomains of a given domain that rank in google's top 100 organic search results for a specified regional database.

tools.name: Get domain paid search keywords
tools.description: Fetches keywords driving paid search traffic to a specified, existing domain using a supported semrush regional database.

tools.name: Get PLA search keywords for a domain
tools.description: Retrieves product listing ad (pla) search keywords for a specified domain from a semrush regional database.

tools.name: Compare domains
tools.description: Analyzes keyword rankings by comparing up to five domains to find common, unique, or gap keywords, using specified organic/paid types and comparison logic in the `domains` string.

tools.name: Get historical data
tools.description: Retrieves monthly historical backlink and referring domain data for a specified root domain, returned as a time series string with newest records first.

tools.name: Get indexed pages
tools.description: Retrieves a list of indexed pages from semrush for a specified `target` (root domain, domain, or url) and `target type`, ensuring `target` is publicly accessible, semrush-analyzable, and correctly matches `target type`.

tools.name: Get keyword difficulty
tools.description: Determines the keyword difficulty (kd) score (0-100, higher means greater difficulty) for a given phrase in a specific semrush regional database to assess its seo competitiveness.

tools.name: Keyword overview all databases
tools.description: Fetches a keyword overview from semrush for a specified phrase, including metrics like search volume, cpc, and competition.

tools.name: Get keyword overview for one database
tools.description: Fetches a keyword summary for a specified phrase from a chosen regional database.

tools.name: Get keywords ads history
tools.description: Fetches a historical report (last 12 months) of domains advertising on a specified keyword in google ads, optionally for a specific month ('yyyymm15') or the most recent period, returning raw csv-like data.

tools.name: Get organic results
tools.description: Retrieves up to 100,000 domains and urls from google's top 100 organic search results for a keyword and region, returning a raw string; use `display date` in 'yyyymm15' format (day must be '15') for historical data.

tools.name: Get paid search results
tools.description: Fetches domains ranking in google's paid search results (adwords) for a specified keyword and regional database.

tools.name: Phrase questions
tools.description: Fetches question-format keywords semantically related to a given query phrase for a specified regional database, aiding in understanding user search intent and discovering content ideas.

tools.name: Get PLA competitors
tools.description: Retrieves domains competing with a specified domain in google's product listing ads (pla) from a given semrush regional database.

tools.name: Get PLA copies
tools.description: Fetches product listing ad (pla) copies that semrush observed for a domain in google's paid search results.

tools.name: Get referring domains
tools.description: Retrieves a report as a text string (e.g., csv) listing domains that link to a target, with options to filter by type (not value).

tools.name: Get referring domains by country
tools.description: Generates a csv report detailing the geographic distribution of referring domains (by country, determined via ip address) for a specified, publicly accessible target.

tools.name: Referring i ps
tools.description: Fetches ip addresses that are sources of backlinks for a specified target domain, root domain, or url.

tools.name: Find related keywords
tools.description: Call this to find related keywords (including synonyms and variations) for a target phrase in a specific regional database; `display date` (if used for historical data) must be 'yyyymm15' for a past month.

tools.name: Get TLD distribution
tools.description: Fetches a report on the top-level domain (tld) distribution of referring domains for a specified target, useful for analyzing geographic or categorical backlink diversity.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: API key for the Semrush API

name: Mem0
description: Mem0 is an universal, self-improving memory layer for LLM applications.

tools.name: Add member to project
tools.description: Adds an existing user to a project (identified by `project id` within organization `org id`), assigning a valid system role.

tools.name: Add new memory records
tools.description: Stores new memory records from a list of messages, optionally inferring structured content; requires association via `agent id`, `user id`, `app id`, or `run id`.

tools.name: Add organization member
tools.description: Adds a new member, who must be a registered user, to an organization, assigning them a specific role.

tools.name: Create a new agent
tools.description: Creates a new agent with a unique `agent id` and an optional `name`; additional metadata may be assigned by the system.

tools.name: Create a new agent run
tools.description: Creates a new agent run in the mem0.ai system.

tools.name: Create a new application
tools.description: Creates a new application, allowing metadata to be passed in the request body (not an explicit field in this action's request model); ensure `app id` is unique to avoid potential errors or unintended updates.

tools.name: Create a new organization entry
tools.description: Creates a new organization entry using the provided name and returns its details.

tools.name: Create a new user
tools.description: Creates a new user with the specified unique `user id` and supports associating `metadata` (not part of the request schema fields).

tools.name: Create an export job with schema
tools.description: Initiates an asynchronous job to export memories, structured by a schema provided in the request body and allowing optional filters.

tools.name: Create memory entry
tools.description: Lists/searches existing memory entries with filtering and pagination; critically, this action retrieves memories and does *not* create new ones, despite its name.

tools.name: Create project
tools.description: Creates a new project with a given name within an organization that must already exist.

tools.name: Delete an organization
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing organization identified by its unique id.

tools.name: Delete memory by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific memory by its unique id; ensure the `memory id` exists as this operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete entity by type and id
tools.description: Call to permanently and irreversibly hard-delete an existing entity (user, agent, app, or run) and all its associated data, using its type and id.

tools.name: Delete memories
tools.description: Deletes memories matching specified filter criteria; omitting all filters may result in deleting all memories. required: at least one of agent id, user id, app id, or run id must be provided.

tools.name: Delete memory batch with uuids
tools.description: Deletes a batch of up to 1000 existing memories, identified by their uuids, in a single api call.

tools.name: Delete project
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific project and all its associated data from an organization; this action cannot be undone and requires the project to exist within the specified organization.

tools.name: Delete project member
tools.description: Removes an existing member, specified by username, from a project, immediately revoking their project-specific access; the user is not removed from the organization.

tools.name: Export data based on filters
tools.description: Retrieves memory export data, optionally filtered by various identifiers (e.g., user id); without filters, it may return all accessible or recent exports based on default behavior.

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: Retrieves a summary list of organizations for administrative oversight; returns summary data (names, ids), not exhaustive details, despite 'detailed' in the name.

tools.name: Fetch details of a specific organization
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for an organization using its `org id`; the `org id` must be valid and for an existing organization.

tools.name: Get list of entity filters
tools.description: Retrieves predefined filter definitions for entities (e.g., by type, creation/modification date); returns definitions only, not filtered entity data.

tools.name: Get entity by id
tools.description: Fetches detailed information for an existing entity (user, agent, app, or run) identified by its type and unique id.

tools.name: Get organization members
tools.description: Fetches a list of members for a specified, existing organization.

tools.name: Get project details
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specified project within an organization.

tools.name: Get project members
tools.description: Retrieves all members for a specified project within an organization.

tools.name: Get projects
tools.description: Retrieves all projects for a given organization `org id` to which the caller has access.

tools.name: Get user memory stats
tools.description: Retrieves a summary of the authenticated user's memory activity, including total memories created, search events, and add events.

tools.name: List entities
tools.description: Retrieves a list of entities, optionally filtered by organization or project (prefer `org id`/`project id` over deprecated `org name`/`project name`), noting results may be summaries and subject to limits.

tools.name: Perform semantic search on memories
tools.description: Searches memories semantically using a natural language query (required if `only metadata based search` is false) and/or metadata filters. required: at least one of agent id, user id, app id, or run id must be provided. when `only metadata based search` is true, the `metadata` parameter is required.

tools.name: Remove a member from the organization
tools.description: Removes a member, specified by their username, from an existing organization of which they are currently a member.

tools.name: Retrieve all events for the currently logged in user
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of events for the authenticated user, filterable and paginable via url query parameters. this is a read-only operation that does not modify data. supported query parameters (applied directly to the request url): - `event type` (str, optional): filters events by their type (e.g., 'add', 'search'). - `start date` (str, optional): filters events on or after this date (format: yyyy-mm-dd). - `end date` (str, optional): filters events on or before this date (format: yyyy-mm-dd). - `page` (int, optional): specifies the page number for paginated results. - `page size` (int, optional): number of events per page (default: 50, max: 100).

tools.name: Retrieve entity-specific memories
tools.description: Retrieves all memories (e.g., user preferences, chat history) for a specific entity from the mem0 platform, using its `entity type` and `entity id`; ensure the entity exists.

tools.name: Retrieve list of memory events
tools.description: Retrieves a chronological list of all memory events (e.g., user inputs, ai responses) from the mem0 platform, providing interaction history and context for ai assistants.

tools.name: Retrieve memory by id
tools.description: Retrieves a complete memory entry by its unique identifier; `memory id` must be valid and for an existing memory.

tools.name: Retrieve memory history by id
tools.description: Retrieves the complete version history for an existing memory, using its unique `memory id`, to inspect its evolution or audit changes.

tools.name: Retrieve memory list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of memories, supporting pagination and diverse filtering (e.g., by ids, metadata, keywords, date ranges); ensure dates are iso 8601 and `page`/`page size` (if used) are positive integers. required: at least one of agent id, user id, app id, or run id must be provided.

tools.name: Search memories with filters
tools.description: Semantically searches memories using a natural language query and mandatory structured filters, offering options to rerank results and select specific fields; any provided `org id` or `project id` must reference a valid existing entity.

tools.name: Update memory batch with uuid
tools.description: Updates text for up to 1000 memories in a single batch, using their uuids.

tools.name: Update memory text content
tools.description: Updates the text content of an existing memory, identified by its `memory id`.

tools.name: Update organization member role
tools.description: Updates the role of an existing member to a new valid role within an existing organization.

tools.name: Update project
tools.description: Updates a project by `project id` within an `org id`, modifying only provided fields (name, description, custom instructions, custom categories); list fields are fully replaced (cleared by `[]`), other omitted/null fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update project member role
tools.description: Updates the role of a specific member within a designated project, ensuring the new role is valid and recognized by the system.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Mem0 API key for authentication. Obtain it from your Mem0 settings.

name: Neon

tools.description: Creates and sends invitations to join an organization in the neon b2b saas integration platform. this endpoint allows administrators to invite multiple users simultaneously, specifying their email addresses and intended roles within the organization. it should be used when expanding the organization's membership or when assigning new roles to incoming members. the endpoint does not verify if the email addresses are associated with existing neon accounts; it simply sends out invitations to the specified email addresses.

tools.name: Set branch as default
tools.description: Sets a specified branch as the default branch for a given project in neon. this endpoint allows users to designate a particular branch as the primary or main branch for a project, which can be useful for organizing workflows and setting default behaviors. the operation is performed using a post request, indicating that it modifies the state of the project. use this endpoint when you need to change the default branch of a project, such as after creating a new branch or deciding to switch the main development focus. it's important to note that this action may affect how other operations interact with the project, as many systems use the default branch as a reference point for various functionalities.

tools.name: Start endpoint for project
tools.description: Initiates a specific process or workflow associated with a particular endpoint within a project in the neon b2b saas integration platform. this endpoint is used to start automated tasks, data synchronization jobs, or other predefined processes that have been configured for the specified project and endpoint. it's particularly useful for triggering scheduled or on-demand integrations between different business applications. the endpoint should be used when you need to manually start a process that is usually automated or when restarting a failed process. it's important to note that this endpoint only starts the process; it does not provide information about the process status or results. separate endpoints may be required to monitor the progress or retrieve the outcomes of the started process.

tools.name: Suspend project endpoint by id
tools.description: Suspends a specific endpoint within a project in the neon b2b saas integration platform. this operation temporarily disables the endpoint, preventing it from processing further requests until it is resumed. use this endpoint when you need to conserve resources, perform maintenance, or temporarily halt operations for a particular integration point. the suspension is reversible, allowing you to resume the endpoint's functionality when needed. this tool is particularly useful for managing resource utilization and costs in your neon project by allowing fine-grained control over individual endpoints.

tools.name: Transfer user projects to organization
tools.description: Transfers multiple projects from the authenticated user's personal account to a specified organization within the neon b2b saas integration platform. this endpoint allows for bulk transfer of projects, enabling efficient management of project ownership and organization. it should be used when reorganizing project structures or when moving projects from individual ownership to team or company-wide access. the endpoint is limited to transferring a maximum of 400 projects in a single request, which helps maintain system performance and prevents abuse. it's important to note that this operation is likely irreversible, so users should exercise caution and confirm the transfer details before execution.

tools.name: Update organization member role
tools.description: Updates the role of a specific member within an organization in the neon b2b saas integration platform. this endpoint allows changing a member's role between 'admin' and 'member', which affects their permissions and access levels within the organization. use this endpoint when you need to promote a regular member to an admin role or demote an admin to a regular member role. it's crucial for managing access control and permissions within your organization. note that this operation may have significant implications on the member's ability to manage resources and other members within the organization.

tools.name: Update project compute endpoint settings
tools.description: Updates the configuration of a specific compute endpoint within a neon project. this endpoint allows fine-tuning of various settings such as autoscaling limits, provisioner type, connection pooling, and auto-suspend behavior. it's particularly useful for optimizing performance, resource allocation, and cost management of your neon compute endpoints. the endpoint should be used when you need to modify the behavior or resources of an existing compute endpoint to better suit your application's needs or to implement changes in your infrastructure strategy. note that some parameters are deprecated, and care should be taken to use the most current features and settings.

tools.name: Update project settings by id
tools.description: Updates the configuration and settings of a specific neon project. this endpoint allows fine-grained control over various aspects of a project, including resource quotas, security settings, maintenance windows, and default endpoint configurations. it's particularly useful for adjusting project parameters to optimize performance, enhance security, or comply with specific operational requirements. the endpoint should be used when changes to project-wide settings are necessary, such as modifying resource limits, adjusting ip access controls, or reconfiguring maintenance schedules. note that some changes, like enabling logical replication, may have significant impacts on project operations and cannot be reversed. care should be taken when modifying critical settings to avoid unintended consequences on project functionality or availability.
