tools.name: Retrieve project event details by id
tools.description: Retrieve details for a specific event by id within a project. supports csv or json format. requires project id in path and adheres to personalapikeyauth for security.

tools.name: Retrieve project event values
tools.description: Retrieve event values for a specific project by id. supports querying in csv or json format. requires a project id and personal api key with query:read permission. responds with event details such as id, distinct id, properties, etc.

tools.name: Retrieve project experiment results
tools.description: Retrieve experiment results within a project by project and experiment id. requires project id and experiment id in the path. returns experiment details in json, with authentication via personalapikeyauth.

tools.name: Retrieve project export details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed info on a specific export of a project using its unique id. requires project id and supports various export formats like png, pdf, csv, and xlsx. auth: personalapikeyauth with export:read scope.

tools.name: Retrieve project funnel correlation insights
tools.description: Retrieve insights about funnel correlations for a specific project by id, offering results in json or csv. supports querying and output formatting, with a focus on fast loading of large datasets.

tools.name: Retrieve project group details by key and type
tools.description: Retrieves specified group details within a project by group key and type index. requires 'group key', 'group type index', and 'project id'. responds with group details, including creation timestamp.

tools.name: Retrieve project insight activity data
tools.description: Retrieve insights activity for a specific project and insight id, offering data in json or csv format. requires project id and insight id in the path, with optional data format query. secure access via personalapikeyauth.

tools.name: Retrieve project insight details
tools.description: Retrieve details for a specific project insight by id, with options to format as json/csv, request refresh, and specify dashboard context. supports personalapikeyauth with insight read access. responses include metadata, results, and caching info.

tools.name: Retrieve project insights details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed insights for a specific project using its id. queries can be made in csv or json format. requires 'insight:read' permission. results include various metadata like creation, last refresh, and associated dashboard info.

tools.name: Retrieve project insights with pagination
tools.description: The get `/api/projects/{project id}/insights/` endpoint retrieves a paginated list of insights for a specified project. filter by creator, response format (csv/json), and use limit/offset for result batching. requires `insight:read` permission.

tools.name: Retrieve project member details by uuid
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific user's membership level and status within a project by their uuid. access project members' data, roles, and timestamps. (get /api/projects/{project id}/explicit members/{uuid})

tools.name: Retrieve project person activity
tools.description: This endpoint allows reading and deleting individuals. for creating or updating, use the capture api, `$set`/`$unset` properties, or sdks.

tools.name: Retrieve project person cohorts
tools.description: This endpoint allows reading and deletion of persons; for creation or updates, use the capture api, `$set`/`$unset` properties, or sdks.

tools.name: Retrieve project person stickiness
tools.description: This endpoint allows for reading and deleting persons. for creations or updates, use the capture api, set/unset properties, or sdks.

tools.name: Retrieve project pipeline plugin config
tools.description: Retrieve configuration details of a specific plugin for a given project pipeline by id. requires a valid project id and plugin config id. supports personalapikeyauth for 'plugin:read' access. responds with json containing configuration data.

tools.name: Retrieve project session values
tools.description: Retrieve session values for a specified project. pass the project id in the url path to obtain the information. only the project's id is required as a parameter. no response body for the 200 ok status code.

tools.name: Retrieve project subscription details
tools.description: Retrieve a specific subscription for a project, identified by 'project id' and 'id'. requires valid api key with read access. supports get method, returns subscription details including frequency, type, and creator info.

tools.name: Retrieve project trend insights
tools.description: Retrieve trend insights for a specific project, supporting csv or json formats. mandatory project id required. provides details on insight cache status, creator, and associated dashboards. auth: personalapikeyauth.

tools.name: Retrieve properties and events association
tools.description: Allows a caller to provide a list of event names and a single property name returns a map of the event names to a boolean representing whether that property has ever been seen with that event name

tools.name: Retrieve property definition details
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific property definition by uuid within a project. requires project id and property definition id. security: personalapikeyauth with read access. no response body provided.

tools.name: Retrieve proxy record details
tools.description: Retrieve a specific proxy record's details by id within an organization. requires path parameters 'organization id' and 'id'. returns json data including domain, status, and timestamps. auth: personalapikeyauth with 'organization:read'.

tools.name: Retrieve related project groups
tools.description: Retrieve related groups for a specific project and user. requires 'project id' (path), 'group type index', and user 'id' (query). returns group details with type, key, and creation date.

tools.name: Retrieveretentioninsights
tools.description: Retrieve retention insights for a specified project. options to output in csv or json format. requires a project id and supports query customization. authenticated access with 'insight:read' permission necessary.

tools.name: Retrieve session property definitions
tools.description: Retrieve property definitions for a specific project by providing the project's id. access this get endpoint at `/api/projects/{project id}/sessions/property definitions/`. project id is mandatory. no response body is returned upon a successful call.

tools.name: Retrieve session recording details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific session recording by providing the session's uuid and associated project id. the response includes metrics such as duration, activity, timestamps, and user data. authentication is required.

tools.name: Retrieve session recording error clusters
tools.description: Retrieve error clusters from session recordings for a specified project. this endpoint provides details on user interactions, console logs, and activity times in json format, requiring the project id in the path.

tools.name: Retrieve session recording playlist details
tools.description: Retrieve session recording playlists for a specified project and playlist short id. returns details like name, creator info, and recordings. access by making a get request to `/api/projects/{project id}/session recording playlists/{short id}/recordings/`.

tools.name: Retrieve session recording properties
tools.description: Retrieve properties of session recordings for a given project by id, including activity metrics, timestamps, and participant details. requires project id in the path. returns json data with recording details.

tools.name: Retrieve session recording snapshots
tools.description: Snapshots for a session can be loaded from s3 (if old) or redis (if recent). clients call the api without a source to get supported sources, then per source for snapshots. api v1 is deprecated; clickhouse support removed.

tools.name: Retrieve similar session recordings
tools.description: Retrieve similar session recordings for a given session by uuid within a project. details include session activity data, user info, and timestamps. requires `project id` and session `id`.

tools.name: Retrieve specific batch export details
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific batch export for an organization by its uuid. requires a personalapikeyauth with 'batch export:read' permission. responses include export details like name, model, destination, interval, and more.

tools.name: Retrieve specific batch export run details
tools.description: Retrieve details for a specific batch export run within a project by id. requires a uuid for batch export id and run id. provides run status, record count, timestamps, latest error, and intervals. security: personalapikeyauth.

tools.name: Retrieve specific domain details
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific domain within an organization using its uuid. authorized users can check domain verification status and saml configuration. requires the `personalapikeyauth` with `organization:read` scope.

tools.name: Retrieve specific exported asset content
tools.description: Retrieve the content of a specific exported asset by id within a project. requires 'export:read' permission. supports fetching details like creation time, format (png, pdf, csv, excel), etc.

tools.name: Retrieve specific historical plugin export
tools.description: Retrieve historical export data for a specific plugin configuration within a project. requires project, plugin config, and export item ids. auth via personalapikeyauth. no body in 200 response.

tools.name: Retrievespecificpipelinefrontendappconfig
tools.description: Retrieve the configuration details of a specific pipeline frontend app by providing its unique id and the associated project id. permissions: 'plugin:read'. response includes plugin config info like enabled state and creation timestamp.

tools.name: Retrieve specific project dashboard details
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific dashboard within a project. requires a dashboard id & project id, and returns information such as dashboard properties, owner, and access levels. auth: personalapikeyauth[dashboard:read].

tools.name: Retrieve survey activity logs
tools.description: Retrieve activity logs for specific survey in a project, identified by uuids. requires valid api key with 'activity log:read' permissions. supports json response detailing survey's properties, types, and creator info.

tools.name: Retrieve survey details with uuid and project id
tools.description: Retrieve survey details using survey uuid and associated project id. supports secure access with 'personalapikeyauth'. returns survey name, type, linking, targeting flags, creator info, and questions with branching logic descriptions.

tools.name: Retrieve survey responses count by project id
tools.description: Retrieve the count of survey responses for a specific project by its id. it requires the project id parameter and returns details like the survey type, linked flags, and creator info.

tools.name: Retrieve unsubscribed pipeline configs
tools.description: Retrieve config details for unsubscribed pipeline destinations in an organization. requires 'organization id' (uuid). returns plugin info, name, description, and more in json format.

tools.name: Retrieve unused organization plugins
tools.description: Retrieve a list of unused plugins for a specified organization by its uuid. the response includes plugin details such as type, name, and configuration. access restricted to the specified organization's context.

tools.name: Retrieveunusedpipelinedestinations
tools.description: Retrieve unused pipeline destinations for a specified organization by id. this get endpoint returns a json object with details like destination id, plugin type, and url, among other attributes. (uuid for organization id is required.)

tools.name: Retrieve user details for initiating 2fa setup
tools.description: The endpoint `get /api/users/{uuid}/start 2fa setup/` fetches details for initiating 2fa setup for a user, providing information like email status, password presence, and more. fields are mostly read-only.

tools.name: Retrieve user profile and team details
tools.description: Fetch user info like profile, team, org, and notifications via uuid using personalapikeyauth ('user:read'). returns json with name, email, teams, and status.

tools.name: Revoke organization invite
tools.description: Delete an organization invite by its uuid. requires a valid personalapikeyauth with organization member write permission. no response body returned on success (http 204).

tools.name: Set insight deletion flag
tools.description: Hard delete of this model is not allowed. use a patch api call to set "deleted" to true

tools.name: Soft delete a specific cohort by id
tools.description: Hard delete of this model is not allowed. use a patch api call to set "deleted" to true

tools.name: Soft delete feature flag by setting status
tools.description: Hard delete of this model is not allowed. use a patch api call to set "deleted" to true

tools.name: Soft delete project dashboard
tools.description: Hard delete of this model is not allowed. use a patch api call to set "deleted" to true

tools.name: Split person entities in project
tools.description: This endpoint allows reading and deleting persons; for creation or updates, use the capture api, `$set`/`$unset` properties, or sdks.

tools.name: Trigger project export with format option
tools.description: The `/api/projects/{project id}/exports/` endpoint triggers a project export, requiring `project id` and `export format`. it accepts json, form-encoded, and multipart data, responding with a 201 code and export information.

tools.name: Update annotation details
tools.description: Create, read, update and delete annotations. [see docs](https://posthog.com/docs/user-guides/annotations) for more information on annotations.

tools.name: Update early access project feature
tools.description: This patch endpoint updates a specific early access project feature. it requires `project id` and `id` (uuid) as path parameters. the body can include feature details like `name`, `description`, and `stage`. security: `personalapikeyauth`.

tools.name: Update event definition by uuid
tools.description: Update an event definition by sending a put request to '/api/projects/{project id}/event definitions/{id}/' using the uuid and project id, provided you have 'event definition:write' authorization.

tools.name: Update experiment details
tools.description: Update an experiment by sending a put request with `project id` and `id`, including new details as json/form data. changes to name, description, dates, etc., allowed. `experiment:write` permission needed.

tools.name: Update feature flag configuration
tools.description: Manage feature flags for your app with creation, reading, updating, and deletion options. utilize posthog's js library or endpoint for flag status. more info in docs.

tools.name: Update organization details by uuid
tools.description: Update specific details of an organization using its uuid. allows patch requests with json, form data, or multipart. requires `organization:write` permission. returns updated organization info.

tools.name: Update organization domain info and saml config
tools.description: Update a domain's info for a specific organization by id, including verification status and saml configuration. requires uuid path params and supports json, form-data content types.

tools.name: Update organization domain properties
tools.description: Updates selected properties of a domain in an organization via patch request, supports various data formats but saml fields are immutable. authentication needed.

tools.name: Update organization member by uuids
tools.description: Patch '/api/organizations/{id}/members/{uuid}': updates org member with user and org uuids. supports json/form/multipart. returns member data. secured by personalapikeyauth.

tools.name: Update organization member details
tools.description: Update member details in an organization by id and user uuid. requires org member write permission. accepts json, form, or multipart. responses reflect member info, including roles and security settings.

tools.name: Update organization s proxy record domain
tools.description: Update a proxy record's domain details for a specified organization and proxy record id using put. requires organization and record ids, supports json, form, and multipart data. responses include status and timestamps. auth required.

tools.name: Update partial project cohort details
tools.description: Update partial cohort details for a specific project. requires a cohort id and project id, supports json, form data, and accepts patch changes like name or description. returns updated cohort data. auth required.

tools.name: Update partial role details in organization
tools.description: Patch /api/organizations/{organization id}/roles/{id}/: update partial details of a role by id within an organization, including name and feature flag access level. requires uuids for both organization and role. supports json, form, and multipart data.

tools.name: Update partial subscription details
tools.description: Patch /api/projects/{project id}/subscriptions/{id}/: update partial details of a specific project subscription by id. modify target, frequency, and more. requires subscription:write permission.

tools.name: Update partial survey details
tools.description: Update partial survey details by patch to /api/projects/{project id}/surveys/{id}/ with uuid. edit attributes like name, type, questions, targeting, and flags. needs personalapikeyauth for write access.

tools.name: Update person properties
tools.description: Request data's "properties" will be updated on a person using "$set" event, affecting only listed properties without deletion or other changes. for property removal, use 'delete property' endpoint.

tools.name: Update person property endpoint
tools.description: This endpoint allows for reading and deleting individuals. use the capture api, `$set` and `$unset` properties, or sdks for creating or updating persons.

tools.name: Update pipeline destination config
tools.description: Update the configuration for a pipeline destination in a project. accepts a json, form-urlencoded, or multipart data payload to modify plugin settings by providing project and config ids. requires plugin:write authority. responds with updated data.

tools.name: Update pipeline frontend app config
tools.description: Update configuration for a specific pipeline frontend app by providing its id and the project id. configure details like activation, order, and optional parameters via json or form data. authentication required.

tools.name: Update pipeline plugin config
tools.description: Update a project-specific pipeline plugin configuration by supplying the project id and config id. this put request expects details like plugin state, order, and more in json, form data, or url-encoded format. authentication is required.

tools.name: Update pipeline transformation config
tools.description: Update a pipeline transformation configuration for a specific project and config id. requires project id and config id in the path and json payload. supports plugin activation and order changes.

tools.name: Update plugin config for project
tools.description: Update a plugin config's partial details in a project by its id using patch. requires project id, config id. accepts json/form data. authenticated with personalapikeyauth. returns updated config.

tools.name: Update project action by id
tools.description: Put endpoint '/api/projects/{project id}/actions/{id}/' updates actions in a project by id, accepts json/form data, supports 'format' query, and needs 'action:write' authentication.

tools.name: Update project action with partial data
tools.description: Update an action within a project with a specified id. supports partial updates. accepts json, form-data, and query parameters including 'project id' and 'id'. formats response in csv or json. requires 'action:write' permission.

tools.name: Update project cohort details
tools.description: Update cohort details of a specific project by id. requires project and cohort id in the path and a json, form-encoded, or multipart form body. permissions: cohort:write. returns updated cohort data.

tools.name: Update project dashboard details
tools.description: Endpoint to update an existing dashboard within a project. provide `project id` and `dashboard id` in path, send json or form data with dashboard details. requires `dashboard:write` permission; responds with updated dashboard data.

tools.name: Update project early access feature
tools.description: Update a specific early access feature of a project by providing the `project id` and feature `id` (uuid). requires a json body with feature details and responds with the updated status. authentication via personalapikeyauth is mandatory.

tools.name: Update project event definition
tools.description: Update an existing event definition for a specified project using its uuid. requires a project id and event definition write permissions. responds without a body on success.

tools.name: Update project group type metadata
tools.description: Patch /api/projects/{project id}/groups types/update metadata: update group type metadata for a specific project using its project id. can modify name singular and name plural fields up to 400 characters each.

tools.name: Update project insight details
tools.description: Endpoint "/api/projects/{project id}/insights/{id}/" allows for updating an insight's details for a given project and insight id, supporting json and csv formats, with fields like name, query, and various timestamps. requires insight write permission.

tools.name: Update project member role by uuid
tools.description: Update a project member's role using their uuid in a specific project. accepts partial data to modify membership details such as role level, provided the member's uuid and project id.

tools.name: Update project member s role by uuid
tools.description: Update explicit project membership using uuids. this put endpoint modifies a project member's role, where '1' stands for member and '8' for administrator. requires `project id` and `parent membership  user  uuid`.

tools.name: Update project notebook details
tools.description: The api for interacting with notebooks. this feature is in early access and the api can have breaking changes without announcement.

tools.name: Update project pipeline destination config
tools.description: Update a project's pipeline destination config by id via patch api request. supports json/form requests, with fields like plugin & order. requires personalapikeyauth.

tools.name: Update project pipeline transformation config
tools.description: Update a specific pipeline transformation configuration for a project by providing a `project id` and configuration `id`. this patch request can modify properties like `plugin`, `enabled`, and `order`. authentication via a personal api key is required.

tools.name: Update project plugin configuration
tools.description: Update project plugin config using its integer id and project string id; accepts json, url-encoded, or form-data. requires authentication; returns the updated config.

tools.name: Update project property definition
tools.description: Update a property definition in a project by its uuid. requires a project id and definition id, both as path parameters. security: personalapikeyauth with write access. no body in the response.

tools.name: Update project session recording playlist
tools.description: Update an existing session recording playlist for a project with the specified project id and playlist short id. requires json or form data input to modify the playlist's properties like name, description, and status.

tools.name: Update project subscription details
tools.description: Update a subscription for a specific project. provide project id and subscription id in the path and use mime types like application/json with fields like frequency, target type, etc. requires `subscription:write` permission.

tools.name: Update project survey details
tools.description: The `/api/projects/{project id}/surveys/{id}/` put endpoint updates survey details in a project using survey uuid and project id, accepts json/form/multipart data, needs `survey:write` permission, and returns the updated survey.

tools.name: Update role details in organization
tools.description: Update an organization role by submitting its uuid and organization id in uuid format. role details must be in json or form-data. only users with 'organization:write' can do this. returns updated role data.

tools.name: Update session recording playlist partially
tools.description: Update session recording playlists using patch on the endpoint with `project id` and `short id`. accepts json and forms data for detail amendments. partial updates allowed. `personalapikeyauth` needed.

tools.name: Update specific proxy record fields
tools.description: Patch `/api/organizations/{organization id}/proxy records/{id}/`: update specific fields of a proxy record by id within an organization. supports json, form data, and multipart. requires `organization:write` permission. returns updated proxy record.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: The subdomain for your PostHog instance. US Cloud: "us.i" (public) or "us" (private). EU Cloud: "eu.i" (public) or "eu" (private). For self-hosted, use your custom subdomain. Confirm yours by checking your PostHog instance URL.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: You can find your API key in your project settings.

name: ClickUp
description: ClickUp unifies tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform, allowing teams to plan, organize, and collaborate across projects with customizable workflows

tools.name: Add dependency
tools.description: Adds a 'waiting on' or 'blocking' dependency to a task, requiring either `depends on` (task becomes waiting on) or `dependency of` (task becomes blocking), but not both; `team id` is required if `custom task ids` is true.

tools.name: Add guest to folder
tools.description: Adds a guest to a folder with specified permissions; requires a clickup enterprise plan.

tools.name: Add guest to list
tools.description: Shares a clickup list with an existing guest user, granting them specified permissions; requires the workspace to be on the clickup enterprise plan.

tools.name: Add guest to task
tools.description: Assigns a guest to a task with specified permissions; requires clickup enterprise plan, and `team id` if `custom task ids` is true.

tools.name: Add tags from time entries
tools.description: Associates a list of specified tags with one or more time entries within a given team (workspace).

tools.name: Add tag to task
tools.description: Adds an existing tag to a specified task; team id is required if custom task ids is true.

tools.name: Add task link
tools.description: Links two existing and accessible clickup tasks, identified by `task id` (source) and `links to` (target).

tools.name: Add task to list
tools.description: Adds an existing task to an additional clickup list; the "tasks in multiple lists" clickapp must be enabled in the workspace for this.

tools.name: Create task attachment
tools.description: Deprecated: use `create task attachment` to upload a file to a task; requires `multipart/form-data`.

tools.name: Get access token
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get access token` instead. exchanges a clickup oauth 2.0 authorization code for an access token.

tools.name: Get authorized teams workspaces
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get authorized teams workspaces` instead to retrieve workspaces (teams) accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get authorized user
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get authorized user` instead. retrieves details of the authenticated user's clickup account.

tools.name: Change tag names from time entries
tools.description: Updates the name, background color, and/or foreground color for an existing time entry tag, identified by its current `name` and `team id`.

tools.name: Create a time entry
tools.description: Creates a new time entry for a specified team.

tools.name: Create chat view comment
tools.description: Posts a new comment to a specified clickup chat view; the 'view id' must correspond to an existing and accessible chat view.

tools.name: Create checklist
tools.description: Creates a new checklist with a specified name within an existing task, which can be identified by its standard id or a custom task id (if `custom task ids` is true, `team id` is also required).

tools.name: Create checklist item
tools.description: Creates a new checklist item within a specified, existing checklist, optionally setting the item's name and assigning it to a user.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Creates a new clickup folder within the specified space, which must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: Create folderless list
tools.description: Creates a new folderless list (a list not part of any folder) directly within a specified clickup space.

tools.name: Create folder view
tools.description: Creates a new, highly customizable view within a specific clickup folder using its `folder id`.

tools.name: Create goal
tools.description: Creates a new goal in a clickup team (workspace).

tools.name: Create key result
tools.description: Creates a new key result (target) for a specified goal in clickup to define and track measurable objectives towards achieving that goal.

tools.name: Create list
tools.description: Creates a new list in clickup within a specified, existing folder.

tools.name: Create list comment
tools.description: Adds a new comment with specific text to an existing and accessible clickup list, assigns it to a user, and sets notification preferences for all list members.

tools.name: Create list view
tools.description: Creates a new, customizable view (e.g., list, board, calendar) within a specified clickup list, requiring an existing list id accessible by the user.

tools.name: Create space
tools.description: Creates a new space in a clickup team, with customizable name, privacy, color, and feature settings.

tools.name: Create space tag
tools.description: Creates a new tag (name, foreground color, background color) in an existing clickup space.

tools.name: Create space view
tools.description: Creates a customizable view (e.g., list, board, gantt) within a specified clickup space, allowing configuration of grouping, sorting, filtering, and display settings.

tools.name: Create a task
tools.description: Creates a new clickup task in a specific list, optionally as a subtask if a `parent` task id (which cannot be a subtask itself and must be in the same list) is provided.

tools.name: Create task attachment
tools.description: Uploads a file as an attachment to a specified clickup task, requiring `multipart/form-data` for file upload.

tools.name: Create task comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to a clickup task; `team id` is required if `custom task ids` is true.

tools.name: Create task from template
tools.description: Creates a new task in a specified clickup list from a task template, using the provided name for the new task.

tools.name: Create team
tools.description: Creates a new team (user group) with specified members in a workspace; member ids must be for existing users, and be aware that adding view-only guests as paid members may incur extra charges.

tools.name: Create webhook
tools.description: Creates a clickup webhook for a team (workspace) to notify a public url on specified events (at least one, or '*' for all), optionally scoped to a space, folder, list, or task; the endpoint must accept requests from dynamic ips.

tools.name: Create workspace Everything level view
tools.description: Creates a new, customizable view (e.g., list, board) at the 'everything' level for a specified team (workspace id), encompassing all tasks within that workspace.

tools.name: Delete a time entry
tools.description: Deletes an existing time entry, specified by `timer id`, from a workspace identified by `team id`.

tools.name: Delete checklist
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing checklist identified by its `checklist id`.

tools.name: Delete checklist item
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing item, identified by `checklist item id`, from an existing checklist, identified by `checklist id`.

tools.name: Delete comment
tools.description: Deletes an existing comment from a task using its `comment id`.

tools.name: Delete dependency
tools.description: Removes two dependency links for `task id`: one where `task id` is blocked by `depends on`, and another where `dependency of` is blocked by `task id`; `team id` is required if `custom task ids` is true.

tools.name: Delete folder
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specified folder and all its contents (lists, tasks) if the folder id exists.

tools.name: Delete goal
tools.description: Permanently removes an existing goal, identified by its `goal id`, from the workspace.

tools.name: Delete key result
tools.description: Deletes an existing key result, also referred to as a target within a goal, identified by its `key result id`.

tools.name: Delete list
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing list and all its contents; this action is destructive and irreversible via the api.

tools.name: Delete space
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specified space in clickup; this action is irreversible as the space cannot be recovered via the api.

tools.name: Delete space tag
tools.description: Deletes a tag from a space, identified by `tag name` in path; precise matching of tag details in the request body (`tag name 1`, `tag tag fg`, `tag tag bg`) is generally required for successful deletion.

tools.name: Delete task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a task, using its standard id or a custom task id (requires `custom task ids=true` and `team id`).

tools.name: Delete task link
tools.description: Deletes an existing link, effectively a dependency or relationship, between two clickup tasks; set `custom task ids=true` and provide `team id` if using custom task ids.

tools.name: Delete team
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing team (user group) from the workspace using its `group id`.

tools.name: Delete time tracked
tools.description: Deletes a time-tracked interval from a task; use this legacy endpoint for older time tracking systems.

tools.name: Delete view
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes an existing view in clickup, identified by its `view id`.

tools.name: Delete webhook
tools.description: Permanently removes an existing webhook, specified by its id, thereby ceasing all its event monitoring and notifications.

tools.name: Edit checklist
tools.description: Updates an existing checklist's name or position, identified by its `checklist id`.

tools.name: Edit checklist item
tools.description: Updates an existing checklist item, allowing modification of its name, assignee, resolution status, or parent item for nesting.

tools.name: Edit guest on workspace
tools.description: Modifies the details and permissions of an existing guest user within a specific workspace.

tools.name: Edit key result
tools.description: Updates an existing key result's progress or note in clickup, where the key result measures progress towards a goal.

tools.name: Edit space tag
tools.description: Updates an existing tag's name and colors in a clickup space; requires current tag name for identification, and new values for tag name, foreground color, and background color, all of which are mandatory for the update.

tools.name: Edit time tracked
tools.description: Edits a legacy time-tracked interval for a task (identified by `task id` and `interval id`) to update its start/end times and duration; `team id` is required if `custom task ids` is true.

tools.name: Edit user on workspace
tools.description: Updates a user's username, admin status, or custom role in a workspace; requires the workspace to be on an enterprise plan.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Deprecated: creates a new folder in a clickup space; use `create folder` instead.

tools.name: Get folders
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get folders`. retrieves folders within a specified clickup space, ensuring `space id` is valid, with an option to filter by archived status.

tools.name: Get folder
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves detailed information about a specific folder in clickup; use `get folder` instead.

tools.name: Get accessible custom fields
tools.description: Retrieves all accessible custom field definitions for a specified clickup list using its `list id`.

tools.name: Get access token
tools.description: Exchanges a clickup oauth 2.0 authorization code (obtained after user consent) for an access token.

tools.name: Get all tags from time entries
tools.description: Retrieves all unique tags applied to time entries within a specified clickup team (workspace).

tools.name: Get authorized teams workspaces
tools.description: Retrieves a list of workspaces (teams) the authenticated user can access.

tools.name: Get authorized user
tools.description: Retrieves the details of the currently authenticated clickup user.

tools.name: Get bulk tasks time in status
tools.description: Retrieves the time spent in each status for multiple tasks; requires the 'total time in status' clickapp to be enabled in the workspace.

tools.name: Get chat view comments
tools.description: Retrieves comments from a specified chat view in clickup, supporting pagination via `start` and `start id` to fetch comments older than the default 25 most recent.

tools.name: Get custom roles
tools.description: Retrieves all custom roles, which allow granular permission configurations, for a specified workspace (team).

tools.name: Get custom task types
tools.description: Retrieves all custom task types available within a specified workspace (team id).

tools.name: Get filtered team tasks
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tasks (up to 100 per page) from a specified team (workspace id in `team id`) based on various filter criteria, respecting user access permissions.

tools.name: Get folder
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific folder in clickup.

tools.name: Get folderless lists
tools.description: Retrieves all lists within a specified space that are not located in any folder.

tools.name: Get folders
tools.description: Retrieves folders within a specified clickup space, ensuring `space id` is valid, with an option to filter by archived status.

tools.name: Get folder views
tools.description: Retrieves all configured views (like list, board, calendar) for a specified, existing folder in clickup.

tools.name: Get goal
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing clickup goal, specified by its unique `goal id`.

tools.name: Get goals
tools.description: Retrieves goals for a specified clickup workspace (team); the `team id` must be valid and accessible.

tools.name: Get guest
tools.description: Call this to retrieve detailed information for a specific guest within a team (workspace), ensuring the `guest id` is valid for the given `team id`; this action requires the clickup enterprise plan.

tools.name: Get list
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing list in clickup, identified by its unique `list id`.

tools.name: Get list comments
tools.description: Retrieves comments for a specific clickup list, supporting pagination using `start` (timestamp) and `start id` (comment id) to fetch earlier comments; omits them for the latest 25.

tools.name: Get list members
tools.description: Retrieves all members of a specific, existing clickup list by its id.

tools.name: Get lists
tools.description: Retrieves all lists within a specified, existing clickup folder, optionally filtering by archived status.

tools.name: Get list views
tools.description: Retrieves all task and page views for a specified and accessible clickup list.

tools.name: Get running time entry
tools.description: Retrieves the currently active time entry for a user in a workspace; a negative 'duration' in its data indicates it's running, and the response may be empty if no entry is active.

tools.name: Get singular time entry
tools.description: Fetches a specific time entry by its id for a given team; a negative duration in the response indicates an active timer.

tools.name: Get space
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing space in a clickup workspace, identified by its unique space id.

tools.name: Get spaces
tools.description: Retrieves spaces for a team id; member information for private spaces is returned only if the authenticated user is a member.

tools.name: Get space tags
tools.description: Retrieves all tags for tasks within a specified clickup space, requiring a valid `space id`.

tools.name: Get space views
tools.description: Retrieves all task and page views for a specified space id in clickup.

tools.name: Get task
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a clickup task by its id, supporting standard or custom task ids (requires `team id` for custom ids).

tools.name: Get task comments
tools.description: Retrieves up to 25 comments for a specified task, supporting pagination using `start` and `start id` to fetch older comments.

tools.name: Get task members
tools.description: Retrieves users with explicit access (directly assigned or shared) to a specific existing task, excluding users with inherited permissions.

tools.name: Get tasks
tools.description: Retrieves tasks from a specified clickup list; only tasks whose home is the given list id are returned.

tools.name: Get task s time in status
tools.description: Retrieves the duration a task has spent in each status, provided the 'total time in status' clickapp is enabled for the workspace.

tools.name: Get task templates
tools.description: Retrieves task templates for a specified workspace (team id), supporting pagination.

tools.name: Get teams
tools.description: Retrieves user groups (teams) from a clickup workspace, typically requiring `team id` (workspace id), with an option to filter by `group ids`.

tools.name: Get time entries within a date range
tools.description: Retrieves time entries for a specified team (workspace id) within a date range (defaults to the last 30 days for the authenticated user if dates are omitted); active timers are indicated by negative durations in the response.

tools.name: Get time entry history
tools.description: Retrieves the modification history for an existing time entry within a specific clickup team (workspace).

tools.name: Get tracked time
tools.description: Retrieves tracked time for a task using a legacy endpoint; prefer newer time tracking api endpoints for managing time entries.

tools.name: Get user
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific user within a clickup workspace (team), available only for workspaces on the clickup enterprise plan.

tools.name: Get view
tools.description: Fetches details for a specific clickup view, identified by its `view id`, which must exist.

tools.name: Get view tasks
tools.description: Retrieves all tasks visible in a specified clickup view, respecting its applied filters, sorting, and grouping.

tools.name: Get webhooks
tools.description: Fetches webhooks for a team (workspace), returning only those created by the authenticated user via api, for a `team id` they can access.

tools.name: Get workspace everything level views
tools.description: Retrieves all task and page views at the 'everything level' (a comprehensive overview of all tasks across all spaces) for a specified clickup workspace.

tools.name: Get workspace plan
tools.description: Retrieves the details of the current subscription plan for a specified clickup workspace.

tools.name: Get workspace seats
tools.description: Retrieves seat utilization (used, total, available for members/guests) for a clickup workspace (team) id, which must be for an existing workspace.

tools.name: Invite guest to workspace
tools.description: Invites a guest by email to a clickup workspace (team) on an enterprise plan, setting initial permissions and optionally a custom role; further access configuration for specific items may require separate actions.

tools.name: Invite user to workspace
tools.description: Invites a user via email to a clickup workspace (team), optionally granting admin rights or a custom role; requires an enterprise plan for the workspace.

tools.name: Get lists
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get lists` instead. retrieves lists from a specified, existing clickup folder.

tools.name: Get list members
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves users with access to a specific list; use `get list members` instead.

tools.name: Remove custom field value
tools.description: Removes an existing value from a custom field on a specific task; this does not delete the custom field definition or its predefined options.

tools.name: Remove guest from folder
tools.description: Revokes a guest's access to a specific clickup folder, optionally unsharing items explicitly shared with them within it; requires an enterprise plan.

tools.name: Remove guest from list
tools.description: Revokes a guest's access to a specific list, provided the guest currently has access to this list and the workspace is on the clickup enterprise plan.

tools.name: Remove guest from task
tools.description: Revokes a guest's access to a specific task; only available for workspaces on the clickup enterprise plan.

tools.name: Remove guest from workspace
tools.description: Permanently removes a guest from a specified workspace, revoking all their access; this destructive operation requires the workspace to be on the clickup enterprise plan.

tools.name: Remove tag from task
tools.description: Removes a tag from a specified task by disassociating it (does not delete the tag from workspace), succeeding even if the tag is not on the task.

tools.name: Remove tags from time entries
tools.description: Removes tags from specified time entries in a team, without deleting the tags from the workspace.

tools.name: Remove task from list
tools.description: Removes a task from an extra list (not its home list); the 'tasks in multiple lists' clickapp must be enabled.

tools.name: Remove user from workspace
tools.description: Deactivates a user from a specified clickup workspace, revoking their access (user can be reactivated later); requires the workspace to be on an enterprise plan.

tools.name: Set custom field value
tools.description: Sets or updates a custom field's value for a task; the new value (with type-dependent structure, e.g., `{"value": "text"}` or `{"value": 123, "value options": {"currency type":"usd"}}`) is provided in the json request body.

tools.name: Shared hierarchy
tools.description: Retrieves the hierarchy of tasks, lists, and folders shared with the authenticated user within an existing clickup team (workspace), identified by its `team id`.

tools.name: Get space
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves detailed information about a specific space; use the getspace action instead.

tools.name: Get spaces
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get spaces` instead; retrieves spaces, with member info for private spaces accessible only if the user is a member.

tools.name: Start a time entry
tools.description: Starts a new time entry (timer) in the specified team (workspace), optionally associating it with a task, adding a description, setting billable status, or applying tags (tags feature requires business plan or higher).

tools.name: Stop a time entry
tools.description: Stops the authenticated user's currently active time entry in the specified team (workspace), which requires an existing time entry to be running.

tools.name: Create checklist
tools.description: (deprecated: use `create checklist` instead) creates a new checklist with a specified name within an existing task, identifiable by standard id or custom task id (if `custom task ids` is true, `team id` is also required).

tools.name: Get task
tools.description: Retrieves details for a task by its id, supporting standard or custom ids (requires `team id` for custom ids). <<deprecated: this action is deprecated. please use 'get task' instead.>>

tools.name: Create team
tools.description: Deprecated: use 'create team'. creates a team (user group) in a workspace; adding a view-only guest as a paid member may incur extra charges.

tools.name: Get workspace plan
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves the current plan for the specified workspace; use `get workspace plan` instead.

tools.name: Get workspace seats
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get workspace seats` to retrieve seat utilization for a clickup workspace (team) id.

tools.name: Track time
tools.description: Records a time entry for a task using clickup's legacy time tracking system; newer endpoints are generally recommended.

tools.name: Update a time entry
tools.description: Updates an existing clickup time entry; provide `start` and `end` times together, and include `team id` as a query param (request field `team id 1`) if `custom task ids` is true.

tools.name: Update comment
tools.description: Updates an existing task comment's text, assignee (who must be a valid workspace member), or resolution status, requiring a valid existing comment id.

tools.name: Update folder
tools.description: Updates the name of an existing folder in clickup.

tools.name: Update goal
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing clickup goal, identified by its `goal id`.

tools.name: Update list
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing clickup list, such as its name, content, due date, priority, assignee, or color status, identified by its `list id`.

tools.name: Update space
tools.description: Updates an existing clickup space, allowing modification of its name, color, privacy, and feature settings (clickapps).

tools.name: Update task
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing task; `team id` is required if `custom task ids` is true, use a single space (" ") for `description` to clear it, and provide at least one modifiable field.

tools.name: Update team
tools.description: Updates an existing clickup user group (team) using its `group id`; note that adding a view-only guest as a paid member may incur charges.

tools.name: Update view
tools.description: Updates an existing clickup view's settings such as name, type, grouping, or filters; ensure `parent id` and `parent type` define a valid hierarchy, and that specified field names (e.g. for sorting, columns) are valid within the clickup workspace.

tools.name: Update webhook
tools.description: Updates the endpoint url, monitored events, and status of an existing webhook, identified by its `webhook id`.

tools.name: Get workspace everything level views
tools.description: Deprecated: retrieves task and page views at the everything level of a workspace; use `get workspace everything level views` instead.

tools.name: Get space views
tools.description: (deprecated: use get space views instead) retrieves all task and page views for a specified space id in clickup.

name: Brevo
description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is an all-in-one email and SMS marketing platform that provides transactional messaging, marketing automation, contact management, and CRM tools to help businesses communicate and engage with their customers.

tools.name: Create a company
tools.description: This tool allows you to create a new company in your brevo account.

tools.name: Create or Update Email Template
tools.description: This tool creates a new email template or updates an existing one in brevo. if a 'templateid' is provided, it performs an update; otherwise, it creates a new template.

tools.name: Create SMS Campaign
tools.description: This tool allows you to create a new sms campaign in brevo. you can specify the campaign name, sender, content, recipients (by providing list ids, exclusion list ids, or segment ids), and optionally schedule the campaign for a specific time. you can also enable unicode characters, add an organization prefix, and include unsubscribe instructions.

tools.name: Delete a company
tools.description: Deletes a company from brevo using its unique identifier.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Deletes a contact from brevo using its unique identifier.

tools.name: Delete Email Template
tools.description: This tool deletes an inactive email template from brevo. you need to provide the 'templateid' of the email template you want to delete. only inactive templates can be deleted.

tools.name: Delete SMS Campaign
tools.description: This tool deletes an existing sms campaign.

tools.name: Find Contact
tools.description: This tool checks if a contact exists in brevo. it searches for a contact using either an email address or mobile number, with the email being prioritized if both are provided.

tools.name: Get Account Information
tools.description: This tool retrieves information about the brevo account, including account holder's email, first name, last name, company name, and address, as well as details about the current plan such as type, credits, start date, and end date.

tools.name: Get all contacts
tools.description: This tool retrieves all contacts from your brevo account. it allows for pagination and filtering based on modification/creation dates, list ids, segment ids, and contact attributes.

tools.name: Get all email templates
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all email templates created in your brevo account. it corresponds to the get /v3/smtp/templates endpoint as per the brevo api documentation, with optional parameters for filtering (templatestatus), pagination (limit, offset), and sorting (asc/desc).

tools.name: Get All Senders
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all senders associated with the brevo account. senders are the email addresses or domains that are authorized to send emails through brevo. this action can be useful for managing and verifying sender identities.

tools.name: Get Company Details
tools.description: This tool retrieves the details of a specific company by its unique id.

tools.name: Get Contact Details
tools.description: This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific contact in brevo. you can identify the contact using their email address (url-encoded), their unique contact id, or their sms attribute value.

tools.name: Get SMS Campaign Details
tools.description: Retrieves the details of a specific sms campaign.

tools.name: Get SMS Campaigns
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all sms campaigns created in brevo. it supports filtering by status, start date, and end date, and also allows controlling the number of results returned (limit), the starting point in the list (offset), and the sort order (asc or desc).

tools.name: List All Companies
tools.description: This action retrieves a list of all companies stored in the brevo crm. it supports pagination and filtering by name and other attributes.

tools.name: List Email Campaigns
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all email campaigns associated with the user's brevo account. it allows filtering by campaign type, status, start date, and end date. the response includes the total count of campaigns and an array of campaign objects, each containing details like id, name, subject, type, status, scheduled date/time, sender information, and optionally, campaign statistics.

tools.name: Update Email Campaign
tools.description: Updates an email campaign in brevo using its unique identifier.

name: Stripe
description: Stripe offers online payment infrastructure, fraud prevention, and APIs enabling businesses to accept and manage payments globally

tools.name: Cancel subscription
tools.description: Cancels a customer's active stripe subscription at the end of the current billing period, with options to invoice immediately for metered usage and prorate charges for unused time.

tools.name: Confirm payment intent
tools.description: Confirms a stripe paymentintent to finalize a payment; a `return url` is necessary if the payment method requires customer redirection.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Creates a new customer in stripe, required for creating charges or subscriptions; an email is highly recommended for customer communications.

tools.name: Create an invoice
tools.description: Creates a new draft stripe invoice for a customer; use to revise an existing invoice, bill for a specific subscription (which must belong to the customer), or apply detailed customizations.

tools.name: Create payment intent
tools.description: Creates a stripe paymentintent to initiate and process a customer's payment; using `application fee amount` for a connected account requires the `stripe-account` header.

tools.name: Create a price
tools.description: Creates a new stripe price for a product, defining its charges (one-time or recurring) and billing scheme; requires either an existing `product` id or `product data`.

tools.name: Create product
tools.description: Creates a new product in stripe, encoding the request as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` by flattening nested structures.

tools.name: Create Refund
tools.description: Creates a full or partial refund in stripe, targeting either a specific charge id or a payment intent id.

tools.name: Create subscription
tools.description: Creates a new, highly configurable subscription for an existing stripe customer, supporting multiple items, trials, discounts, and various billing/payment options.

tools.name: Delete customer
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing stripe customer; this irreversible action also cancels their active subscriptions and removes all associated data.

tools.name: List Charges
tools.description: Retrieves a list of stripe charges with filtering and pagination; use valid cursor ids from previous responses for pagination, and note that charges are typically returned in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: List Stripe coupons
tools.description: Retrieves a list of discount coupons from a stripe account, supporting pagination via `limit`, `starting after`, and `ending before`.

tools.name: List customer payment methods
tools.description: Retrieves a list of payment methods for a given customer, supporting type filtering and pagination.

tools.name: List customers
tools.description: Retrieves a list of stripe customers, with options to filter by email, creation date, or test clock, and support for pagination.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Retrieves a list of stripe invoices, filterable by various criteria and paginatable using invoice id cursors obtained from previous responses.

tools.name: List payment intents
tools.description: Retrieves a list of stripe paymentintents, optionally filtered and paginated using paymentintent ids as cursors.

tools.name: List payment links
tools.description: Retrieves a list of payment links from stripe, sorted by creation date in descending order by default.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Retrieves a list of stripe products, with optional filtering and pagination; `starting after`/`ending before` cursors must be valid product ids from a previous response.

tools.name: List Refunds
tools.description: Lists stripe refunds, sorted by creation date descending (newest first), with optional filtering by charge or payment intent and pagination support.

tools.name: List Stripe shipping rates
tools.description: Retrieves a list of stripe shipping rates, filterable by active status, creation date, and currency; useful for managing or displaying shipping options.

tools.name: List subscriptions
tools.description: Retrieves a list of stripe subscriptions, optionally filtered by various criteria such as customer, price, status, collection method, and date ranges, with support for pagination.

tools.name: List tax codes
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of globally available, predefined stripe tax codes used for classifying products and services in stripe tax.

tools.name: List tax rates
tools.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates, which are returned sorted by creation date in descending order.

tools.name: Retrieve Balance
tools.description: Retrieves the complete current balance details for the connected stripe account.

tools.name: Retrieve Charge Details
tools.description: Retrieves full details for an existing stripe charge using its unique id.

tools.name: Retrieve customer
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing stripe customer using their unique customer id.

tools.name: Retrieve payment intent
tools.description: Retrieves a paymentintent by its id; `client secret` is required if a publishable api key is used.

tools.name: Retrieve a refund
tools.description: Retrieves details for an existing stripe refund using its unique `refund id`.

tools.name: Retrieve subscription
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing stripe subscription using its unique id.

tools.name: Search Stripe customers
tools.description: Retrieves a list of stripe customers matching a search query that adheres to stripe's search query language.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Updates an existing stripe customer, identified by customer id, with only the provided details; unspecified fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Payment Intent
tools.description: Updates a stripe paymentintent with new values for specified parameters; note that if `currency` is updated, `amount` might also be required, and certain updates (e.g., to `payment method`) can necessitate re-confirmation by the customer.

tools.name: Update Subscription
tools.description: Updates an existing, non-canceled stripe subscription by its id, ensuring all referenced entity ids (e.g., prices, coupons) are valid and automatic tax liability is correctly specified if enabled.

triggers.name: Charge Failed Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a direct charge fails in Stripe's legacy Charges API

triggers.name: Checkout Session Completed Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a checkout session is completed in Stripe

triggers.name: Invoice Payment Succeeded Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when an invoice payment is successful in Stripe

triggers.name: Payment Intent Failed Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a payment intent fails in Stripe

triggers.name: Product Created Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a product is created in Stripe

triggers.name: Subscription Added Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a subscription is added in Stripe

triggers.name: Subscription Deleted Trigger
triggers.description: Triggered when a subscription is deleted in Stripe

name: Klaviyo
description: Klaviyo is a data-driven email and SMS marketing platform that allows e-commerce brands to deliver targeted messages, track conversions, and scale customer relationships

tools.name: Add Profile to List
tools.description: Add profiles to a klaviyo list by profile ids or email addresses. this action subscribes profiles to a marketing list, which is ideal for giving marketing consent. you can add up to 1000 profiles per call using either their klaviyo profile ids or email addresses. rate limits: 10/s burst, 150/m steady. required scopes: `lists:write` and `profiles:write`. preconditions: - either profile ids or emails must be provided (not both) - maximum 1000 profiles per call - email addresses must be valid format - the list must exist and be accessible

tools.name: Assign campaign message template
tools.description:
Creates a non-reusable version of the template and assigns it to the message.

*rate limits*:
burst: `10/s`
steady: `150/m` **scopes:** `campaigns:write`

tools.name: Bulk create client events
tools.description: Use the client-side endpoint with a public api key to track profile activity. it accepts up to 1000 events/request with rates of 10/s burst and 150/m steady. for server-side, use the bulk create event endpoint.

tools.name: Bulk create events
tools.description: This api endpoint creates or updates profiles by batching up to 1,000 events, with a 5mb payload limit. minimum required: a profile id and metric name. it has rate limits of 10 events per second burst and 150 events per minute. scope is `events:write`.

tools.name: Create back in stock subscription
tools.description: Use the server-side endpoint to subscribe to restock alerts, following the back in stock api guide. for client-side, use the post endpoint provided. rate limits: 350/s burst and 3500/m steady. required scopes: catalogs:write, profiles:write.

tools.name: Create campaign
tools.description:
Creates a campaign given a set of parameters, then returns it.

*rate limits*:
burst: `10/s`
steady: `150/m` **scopes:** `campaigns:write`

tools.name: Create campaign clone
tools.description:
Clones an existing campaign, returning a new campaign based on the original with a new id and name.

*rate limits*:
burst: `10/s`
steady: `150/m` **scopes:** `campaigns:write`

tools.name: Create Campaign Recipient Estimation Job
tools.description: Start an asynchronous task to estimate the number of recipients for a campaign. this action creates a background job that calculates how many profiles would receive the campaign based on its current audience settings. use the job id returned to track progress with the 'get campaign recipient estimation job' action, and get the final count via 'get campaign recipient estimation' action. rate limits: 10/s burst, 150/m steady. required scope: `campaigns:write`. preconditions: - valid api key with campaigns:write scope - campaign id must exist and be accessible - campaign must have audience settings configured

tools.name: Create campaign send job
tools.description:
Trigger a campaign to send asynchronously

*rate limits*:
burst: `10/s`
steady: `150/m` **scopes:** `campaigns:write`

tools.name: Create catalog category
tools.description:
Create a new catalog category.

*rate limits*:
burst: `75/s`
steady: `700/m` **scopes:** `catalogs:write`

tools.name: Create catalog category relationships items
tools.description:
Create a new item relationship for the given category id.

*rate limits*:
burst: `75/s`
steady: `700/m` **scopes:** `catalogs:write`

tools.name: Create catalog item
tools.description:
Create a new catalog item.

*rate limits*:
burst: `75/s`
steady: `700/m` **scopes:** `catalogs:write`

tools.name: Create catalog item relationships categories
tools.description:
Create a new catalog category relationship for the given item id.

*rate limits*:
burst: `75/s`
steady: `700/m` **scopes:** `catalogs:write`

tools.name: Create catalog variant
tools.description:
Create a new variant for a related catalog item.

*rate limits*:
burst: `75/s`
steady: `700/m` **scopes:** `catalogs:write`

tools.name: Create client back in stock subscription

name: Attio
description: Attio is a fully customizable workspace for your team's relationships and workflows.

tools.name: Create Note
tools.description: This tool creates a new note on a given record in attio. the note can be attached to any record type (like person, company, or deal) and includes a title and content. it requires parameters such as parent object, parent record id, title, and content, with an optional created at timestamp.

tools.name: Create Record
tools.description: This tool creates a new record in attio for a specified object type (people, companies, deals, users, workspaces, etc.). it requires the object type and a values dictionary containing the attributes for the new record.

tools.name: Delete Note
tools.description: This tool allows users to delete a specific note in attio by its id. it is implemented via delete https://api.attio.com/v2/notes/{note id} and handles note deletion by validating the provided note id. it complements attio create note functionality, providing complete note management capabilities within the attio platform.

tools.name: Delete Record
tools.description: This tool allows you to delete a record from attio permanently. the deletion is irreversible, and the data will eventually be removed from the system.

tools.name: Find Record
tools.description: This tool allows users to find a record in attio by either its unique id or by searching using unique attributes. it provides two methods: one for directly retrieving a record by its id with the get /v2/objects/{object}/records/{record id} endpoint, and another for searching by attributes using the post /v2/objects/{object}/records/query endpoint.

tools.name: Get Object Details
tools.description: This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific object type in attio, including all its attributes and their properties. this is useful for understanding what fields are available when creating or updating records of this type.

tools.name: List Lists
tools.description: This tool retrieves all lists available in the attio workspace. the lists are returned sorted as they appear in the sidebar. this tool is essential for managing and navigating lists, and is a prerequisite for many list-related operations. it requires the list configuration:read permission scope.

tools.name: List Notes
tools.description: This tool lists all notes associated with a specific record in attio. notes are returned in reverse chronological order (newest first).

tools.name: List Objects
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all available objects (both system-defined and user-defined) in the attio workspace. it makes a get request to the /v2/objects endpoint and returns a json response containing key metadata about each object, which is fundamental for understanding and accessing the workspace's structure.

tools.name: List Records
tools.description: This tool lists records from a specific object type in attio. it provides simple pagination support and returns records in the order they were created. for complex filtering, use the findrecord action instead. standard object types include: people, companies, deals, users, workspaces. if you get a 404 error, verify the object type exists using the list objects action first.

tools.name: Update Record
tools.description: This tool updates an existing record in attio for a specified object type (people, companies, deals, users, workspaces, etc.). it uses patch to partially update only the provided fields, leaving other fields unchanged.

tools.name: Create group
tools.description: Creates a new group in the shortcut system with customizable properties. this endpoint allows you to set up a group with a unique mention name, display name, optional description, and various customization options. use this when you need to establish a new team, department, or any other collective within your shortcut workspace. the created group can include members, associated workflows, and visual customizations like color and icon. this endpoint is particularly useful for organizing your shortcut workspace structure, facilitating team collaboration, and streamlining workflow management. note that while member and workflow associations can be set during creation, they can also be modified later using separate endpoints.

tools.name: Create iteration
tools.description: The createiteration endpoint allows you to create a new iteration in shortcut, which represents a time-boxed period for completing a set of stories or tasks. this endpoint is crucial for teams using agile methodologies, enabling them to plan and track progress over specific time periods. use this endpoint when setting up sprint cycles, planning releases, or organizing work into manageable timeframes. the endpoint requires essential information such as the iteration's name and date range, while also offering options to add followers, associate groups, and attach labels for better organization and tracking. it's important to note that while multiple groups can be added via the api, the current web ui only displays one group association. this endpoint should not be used for modifying existing iterations; instead, use the dedicated update endpoint for such changes.

tools.name: Create story link
tools.description: Story links (called story relationships in the ui) allow you create semantic relationships between two stories. the parameters read like an active voice grammatical sentence: subject -> verb -> object. the subject story acts on the object story; the object story is the direct object of the sentence. the subject story "blocks", "duplicates", or "relates to" the object story. examples: - "story 5 blocks story 6” -- story 6 is now "blocked" until story 5 is moved to a done workflow state. - "story 2 duplicates story 1” -- story 2 represents the same body of work as story 1 (and should probably be archived). - "story 7 relates to story 3”

tools.name: Search Content
